<VERSION NUMBER="5.00" DATE="12/25/2025">
<TITLE>Matthew 1</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN><I>This is</I> a scroll of birth history, <I>a genealogy</I> of Jesus, the Anointed King, a son of David, a son of Abraham.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Abraham fathered Isaac. Isaac fathered Jacob. Jacob fathered Judah and his brothers.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Judah fathered <I>twins</I>: Phares and Zerah, from Tamar <I>(his daughter-in-law)</I>. Phares fathered Hezron. Hezron fathered Aram.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Aram fathered Aminadab. Aminadab fathered Nahshon. Nahshon fathered Salmon.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Salmon fathered Boaz from Rahab. Boaz fathered Obed from Ruth. Obed fathered Jesse.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Jesse fathered David, the king. David fathered Solomon from the <I>widow</I> of Uriah.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Solomon fathered Rehoboam. Rehoboam fathered Abijah. Abijah fathered Asa.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Asa fathered Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat fathered Joram. Joram fathered Uzziah.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Uzziah fathered Jotham. Jotham fathered Ahaz. Ahaz fathered Hezekiah.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Hezekiah fathered Manasseh. Manasseh fathered Amos. Amos fathered Josiah.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Josiah fathered Jeconiah<I>'s father</I> and his brothers before Babylon's resettlement <I>of them to Babylon</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>After Babylon's resettlement, Jeconiah fathered Shealtiel. Shealtiel fathered Zerubbabel.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Zerubbabel fathered Abiud. Abiud fathered Eliakim. Eliakim fathered Azor.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>Azor fathered Zadok. Zadok fathered Achim. Achim fathered Eliud.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Eliud fathered Eleazar. Eleazar fathered Matthan. Matthan fathered Jacob.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Jacob fathered Joseph, the husband of Mary. Jesus was born from her. He is the One that is called Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>So there are fourteen generations from Abraham until David. And there are fourteen generations from David until Babylon's resettlement. And there are fourteen generations from Babylon's resettlement until the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>This is what the birth history of Jesus, the Anointed King, was like when His mother Mary was promised to Joseph. Before they even came together, she was found to be pregnant by the Sacred Spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Joseph (her man) was someone who did what is right. Since he didn't want to shame Mary publicly, he intended to dismiss her in a way that no one would notice.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>When he contemplated these things, look, the Master's angel appeared to him in a dream. He said, "Joseph, son of David, you shouldn't be afraid to take Mary, your woman, along with you. You see, the baby in her was born from the Sacred Spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>She will deliver a son, and you will call His name Jesus <I>(which means Yahweh rescues)</I>. You see, He will rescue His ethnic group from their sins."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>This whole thing happened so that what the Master stated through His preacher Isaiah might be accomplished. <I>Isaiah</I> said,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>"Look, the virgin will be pregnant and deliver a son. They will call His name Immanuel which is <I>Hebrew</I> and translated as 'God with us'" <I>(Isaiah 7:14)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>When Joseph got up, he did what the Master's angel specified for him to do. He took his woman along.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 1:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>He wasn't knowing her <I>(being intimate with her)</I> until she gave birth to a son. He called His name Jesus.</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 2</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>When Jesus was born in Bethlehem, Judea (in the days of Herod the king), look, Magian gurus from eastern regions showed up in Jerusalem.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>They were asking, "Where is the Jewish people's king that was just born? You see, we saw His star in the east, and we came to bow down to Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>When King Herod heard this, he was uneasy and all of Jerusalem <I>was uneasy</I> with him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>He gathered all of the head priests and the ethnic group's Old Testament transcribers together, and in a private meeting, he was inquiring where the Anointed King should be born.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>"In Bethlehem, Judea," they said. You see, the preacher wrote about this:</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>"And you, Bethlehem, land of Judah, you are by no means the least among Judah's leaders. You see, a leader will come out of you, someone who will shepherd My ethnic group Israel" <I>(Micah 5:2)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>At that time, Herod called for the gurus in a way that no one would notice. In a private meeting, he verified when they saw the shining star.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>When he sent them to Bethlehem, he said, "After traveling there, question specifically about the young child. Whenever you find him, report it to me so that I also might go there and bow down to him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>The gurus listened to the king and traveled <I>to Bethlehem</I>. And, look, the star that they saw in the east was leading the way ahead of them until it came and stood up above where the young child was.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>When they saw the star, they were terribly happy with great happiness.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>And when they went into the house, they saw the young child with Mary, His mother. They got down and bowed to Him. Then they opened their stockpiles of supplies and offered up contributions to Him: gold, incense from the frankincense tree, and myrrh <I>(an expensive fragrant resin)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>They were divinely instructed in a dream not to double back to Herod. So they took a back way through another road to their own country.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>After the <I>gurus</I> took a back way out, look, the Master's angel appeared to Joseph in a dream. He said, "When you get up, escape into Egypt. Take the young child and His mother along, and stay there until I tell you. You see, Herod is going to look for the young child <I>because he wants</I> to destroy Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>Joseph got up and took the young child and his mother along with him at night. They took a back way into Egypt.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>He was there until Herod passed away so that what the Master had stated before through the preacher might be accomplished: "Out of Egypt I called My Son" <I>(Hosea 11:1)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>At that time, when Herod saw that the gurus disrespected him <I>(because they didn't do what he had told them to do)</I>, he was very angry. So he sent soldiers out to Bethlehem and the surrounding area to execute all the boys two years old and under. He chose those ages based on the time that he had verified with the gurus in his private meeting with them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>At that time, what God had stated before through Jeremiah, His preacher, was accomplished. He said,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>"A sound was heard in Ramah, much crying and mourning. Rachel is crying for her children. She doesn't want to be comforted because they are gone" <I>(Jeremiah 31:15)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>After Herod passed away, look, the Master's angel appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>He said, "When you get up, take along the young child and His mother, and travel into Israel's land. The people looking for the soul of the young child are dead."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>After Joseph got up, he took the young child and His mother along and went into Israel's land.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>When he heard that Archelaus was king of Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go away to there. After they were divinely instructed in a dream, they took a back way into certain parts of Galilee.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 2:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>They ended up living in the city of Nazareth in order that what God had stated before through His preachers might be accomplished: "He will be called a Nazarene."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 3</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>In those days <I>when Jesus was living in Nazareth</I>, John the Submerger showed up in Judea's backcountry speaking publicly.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>He was saying, "Change your ways. Heaven's monarchy has come near."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>You see, this is what God stated through Isaiah, His preacher, when he said, "A voice is shouting in the backcountry, get the Master's road ready. Make His paths straight" <I>(Isaiah 40:3)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>John wore <I>the same attire that Elijah and some old-time preachers wore</I>: attire made of camel's hair and a leather strap around his waist. His meals consisted of grasshoppers and wild honey.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>At that time, people were traveling out to him from Jerusalem, from all around Judea, and from all around the rural area surrounding the Jordan River.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>He was submerging them in the Jordan River as they admitted their sins out loud. <I>Submersion is a Jewish tradition that ritually cleans the person being submerged.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>When he saw many of the Separatists and Sadducees coming out to his submersions, he told them, "You children of poisonous snakes, who put the warning in front of your face to escape the punishment that is going to come? <I>You don't see it, do you? So why are you here?</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Produce fruit that is deserving of the change <I>in you that God requires</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Don't even think about saying among yourselves, 'Our father is Abraham. <I>God needs us to carry on Abraham's lineage.</I>' I tell you, God is able from these stones to raise up children for Abraham.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN><I>God has already taken the ax out and</I> laid it facing the root of the trees. Every tree that doesn't produce nice fruit gets chopped down and is thrown into the fire.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I certainly submerge you in water when you change your ways, but the One coming behind me is stronger than me. I am unfit to haul <I>His</I> sandals around. He will submerge you in the Sacred Spirit and fire <I>(the Sacred Spirit for those who trust Him, fire for those who don't)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>His shovel is in His hand. He will completely clear off His processing floor. He will gather His grain together into the grain bin, but the husks will be burned up with unextinguished fire."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Then Jesus showed up there. He had traveled from Galilee to John at the Jordan River <I>for one reason</I>, to be submerged by him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>John was flatly refusing and saying, "I need to be submerged by You. How are You coming to me?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>"Allow it for now," Jesus responded. "You see, this is the appropriate way for us to accomplish every bit of the right way." Then John allowed it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>After Jesus was submerged, as he stepped up out of the water, look, the sky opened to Him. He saw God's Spirit stepping down as if it were a dove and coming over Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 3:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>And look, a voice spoke from the sky. It said, "This is My loved Son. I am delighted with Him."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 4</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>At that time, the Spirit led Jesus up into the backcountry to be harassed by the Accuser.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>After not eating for forty days and forty nights, later, He was hungry.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>The one who harasses people came up to Him and said, "If you are a son of God, say that these stones should become bread."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>When Jesus responded, He said, "The Bible says, 'A person won't live on bread alone. But he will live on every statement traveling out of God's mouth' <I>(Deuteronomy 8:3)</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Then the Accuser took Him along with him into the sacred city and stood Him on the winglet of the temple grounds.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>"If you are a son of God, jump," he told Him. "You see, the Bible says, 'He will demand that His angels take care of You, and they will pick You up in their arms to keep You from ever stubbing Your foot on a stone' <I>(Psalm 91:11-12)</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Jesus was declaring to him, "Again the Bible says, 'You will not intentionally harass the Master, your God' <I>(Deuteronomy 6:16)</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The Accuser took Him along with Him again onto a very high mountain and showed Him all the world's monarchies and their magnificence.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>"I will give you all these," he said, "if you will get down on the ground and bow down to me." </P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>At that time, Jesus told him, "Make your way out of here, Opponent. The Bible says, 'You will bow down to the Master, your God, and minister to Him alone' <I>(Deuteronomy 6:13)</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Then the Accuser left, and, look, angels came and were serving Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>When Jesus heard that John had been taken into custody, He took a back way into Galilee</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>and left Nazareth behind. He went and lived in Capernaum. Capernaum was beside the Sea <I>of Galilee</I> on the border of Zebulon and Naphtali.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>He did this so that what God stated through His preacher Isaiah might be accomplished:</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>"Land of Zebulon and land of Naphtali, a road along the sea next to the Jordan River, the part of Galilee where non-Jews live,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>the ethnic group <I>(the Jews)</I> who were sitting in darkness saw a great light. A light came up over the people sitting in a rural area and in death's shadow" <I>(Isaiah 9:1-2)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>From then on, Jesus began speaking publicly and saying, "Change your ways. You see, heaven's monarchy has come near."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN><I>One day</I> as He was walking around along the Sea of Galilee, He saw two brothers, Simon and Andrew. Simon is the one they call Peter. They were throwing a throw net into the sea. They were fishermen.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>"Come follow Me," Jesus told them, "and I will make you fishermen of people."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Right away, the brothers left their nets and followed Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>When He walked further down the shore, He saw two other brothers, James and John, in a boat with their father Zebedee. They were mending their nets. Jesus invited them <I>to follow Him</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Right away, the brothers left their boat and their father and followed Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>He was taking them all around Galilee. He was teaching in the synagogues, speaking publicly about the good news of God's monarchy, and healing every illness and every minor ailment in the group.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN><I>People started talking.</I> The talk went off into all of <I>the large area north of there,</I> Syria. People brought Jesus everyone who had something wrong with them: people who had various illnesses, people who were constrained by excruciating pain, people who had lesser deities, people who were struck by the moon <I>(that is, people who had seizures)</I>, and people who were disabled. Jesus healed them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 4:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Large crowds followed Him from Galilee, Decapolis, Greater Jerusalem, Judea, and the Jordan River area.</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 5</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>When He saw the crowds, He climbed up the mountain and sat down <I>like rabbis do when they teach their students</I>. His students came up to Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>When He opened His mouth, He was teaching them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>He said, "The people who see how <I>spiritually</I> poor they are have a blessing because they are a part of heaven's monarchy.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>The grieving people have a blessing because they will be comforted.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>The submissive people have a blessing because they will inherit the earth.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>The people hungering and thirsting for the right way have a blessing because they will be adequately fed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>The kind forgiving people have a blessing because they will receive forgiving kindness.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The people who keep their heart clean have a blessing because they will see God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>The people creating peaceful solutions have a blessing because they will be called God's sons.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>The people who have been persecuted because they did what is right have a blessing because they are a part of heaven's monarchy.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>When people criticize you, when people persecute you, when people lie and say every evil thing against you, <I>when they do these things</I> because you are Mine, you are blessed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Be happy and excited because when you get to heaven, you will be paid well for those abuses. You see, the preachers that came before you were persecuted like that too.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You are the earth's salt. <I>You must have the flavor that I give.</I> What good is salt if it has no flavor? What will be salted with it? It isn't good for anything anymore except to be thrown outside so that people can trample on it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>You are the world's light. A city lying up on top of a mountain can't be hidden.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>They don't put a burning lamp under the two gallon measuring basket either. No, they put it up high on a stand. There it shines for everyone in the house.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>This is how your light must shine in front of people so that they might see your nice actions and praise the magnificence of your Father in the heavens.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>You shouldn't assume that I came to tear the Law or the Preachers down. I didn't come to tear <I>them</I> down. No, I came to accomplish <I>what they say</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>You see, amen, I tell you, as long as the sky and the earth are here, one small letter or even one hook of a letter will not in any way leave the Law until all the things written in it happen.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>So whoever breaks even one of the Law's smallest demands and teaches the people to do the same thing, he will be called 'smallest' in heaven's monarchy. But whoever will do and teach the Law's demands will be called 'great' in heaven's monarchy.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>You see, <I>the Old Testament transcribers know every little detail of the Old Testament because they copy it letter-by-letter. And the Separatists have many rules to ensure that they keep the Law. But</I> I tell you that unless your right way overflows to be more right than the right way of the Old Testament transcribers and Separatists, you won't in any way enter heaven's monarchy. <I>(Jesus follows this up with some examples of how His right way completes and exceeds the Law.)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>You have heard that <I>in the Law God</I> stated to the original people, 'You will not murder.' Because of this whoever murders will be eligible for sentencing in court.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>But I tell you that everyone who is enraged at his brother will be eligible for sentencing in court. Whoever says to his brother 'You good-for-nothing!' will be eligible for sentencing in <I>the highest court</I>, the council. And whoever says, 'You foolish person!' will be eligible for sentencing in the fires of the Hinnom Valley.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>So <I>maintain good relations with your brother.</I> If you are <I>at the temple in Jerusalem</I> offering up your contribution on the altar and there you remember that your brother has something against you,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN><I>stop what you are doing,</I> leave your contribution there in front of the altar, and make your way back to that brother. First, settle the problem with him. Then go back and offer up your contribution.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>You <I>also</I> must maintain good relations with your opponent in a court case. Quickly agree to his demands all the way up to the time for you to stand before the judge. That way perhaps he won't turn you over to the judge, the judge won't turn you over to the underling, and you won't be thrown in jail.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>Amen, I tell you, if you get thrown in jail, you won't in any way come out of there until you have paid back every last penny.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>You heard that <I>in the Law God</I> stated, 'You won't cheat on your spouse.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>But I tell you that every husband who looks at a woman with the specific goal of desiring her has already cheated on his wife in his heart with that woman.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>If your right eye is causing you to stumble, take it out, and throw it away. You see, it is to your advantage to destroy one of your body parts and prevent your whole body from being thrown into Hinnom Valley. <I>(The Hinnom Valley ran along the southwestern edge of Jerusalem. At one time children were burned to death there as sacrifices to idols. It is symbolic of the eternal lake of fire.)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>And if your right hand is causing you to stumble, chop it off, and throw it away. You see, it is to your advantage to destroy one of your body parts and prevent your whole body from going off into Hinnom Valley."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN><I>(Some people had been dismissing their wives without divorcing them.) "In the Law, God</I> stated, 'Whoever dismisses his wife must give her a divorce.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>But I tell you that everyone who dismisses his wife <I>without divorcing her</I>, besides and outside of a matter of sexual sin, <I>is violating the 'you won't cheat on your spouse' demand because he</I> is making his wife cheat on him. And whoever marries a dismissed wife is also violating that demand.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>Again you have heard that <I>in the Law God</I> stated to the original people, 'You will not lie when you make or take an oath, but you will pay back your oath to the Master.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN><I>(When some people guaranteed something with an oath, they didn't invoke the Master's name because they didn't want to violate His name when they broke that promise. So their guarantee invoked other things, like the sky, the earth, and Jerusalem.)</I> "But I tell you not to guarantee at all. Don't invoke the sky because it is God's throne.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>Don't invoke the earth because it is a footrest for His feet. And don't invoke Jerusalem because it is the city of the great King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>Don't invoke your head either when you guarantee something <I>because your head is controlled by God</I>. You aren't able to make one hair white or black. <I>God does that.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>Your answer must be yes or no. Anything more than that is from the evil one.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>You heard that <I>in the Law God</I> stated, 'An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.'" <I>(That means that if someone intentionally injures his neighbor's eye, that neighbor must injure the attacker's eye, and if someone intentionally breaks his neighbor's tooth, that neighbor must break the attacker's tooth.)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>"But I tell you, don't stand in opposition to the evil person. If someone slaps you on the right cheek, turn your head and give him access to your other cheek.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>If someone wants to sue you and take your shirt, allow him to take your coat too.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>If <I>a Roman soldier</I> sequesters help from you for one mile, lead the way with him for two.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>Give to the person who asks. If anyone wants to get an interest loan from you, don't turn him away.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>You heard that <I>in the Law God</I> stated, 'You will love the person near you and'" <I>(as some rabbis had added)</I> "'hate your enemy.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>But I tell you, love your enemies. Pray for the people persecuting you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>When you do this, you become sons of your Father in the heavens because He brings His sun up on evil people and on good people. He gives rain to both the people who do what is right and the people who do what is wrong.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>You see, if you love the people who love you, what distinction does that earn you? Don't even the tax collectors do the same thing?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>And if you say hello only to your brothers, how is that such a wonderful thing? Don't even the non-Jews" <I>(a group of people that they considered to be sinful)</I> "do the same thing?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 5:48"></A><SPAN class="verseno">48 </SPAN><I>Go beyond that.</I> Become complete people. Do everything completely right, just as your Heavenly Father does everything completely right."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 6</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>"When you are doing the things that are right, make sure that you aren't doing them in front of people with the specific goal of being seen by them. If you are doing that, <I>that is the only pay you will get.</I> Your Father in the heavens will definitely not pay you for doing them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN><I>For example,</I> when you make a charitable donation, don't blow a trumpet in front of you <I>so everyone will see you giving</I>. This is what the fakers do in the synagogues and in the streets so that people might elevate them to a place of magnificence. Amen, I tell you, they have all of their pay.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>But as you make a charitable donation<I>, do it in a hidden way.</I> Your left hand must not know what your right hand is doing.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>That will allow your charitable donation to be in a hidden world <I>that no one sees, no one except the Father</I>. The Father, who sees what goes on in the hidden world, will give back to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN><I>(Another example is prayer.)</I> When you all pray, don't pray like the fakers. They are fond of praying standing in the synagogues and in the corners of the plazas so that people will see them. Amen, I tell you, they have all of their pay.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>But when you pray, go into your storage room. After you close the door, pray to your Father in the hidden world, and your Father, who sees in the hidden world, will give back to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>As you all pray, don't babble words like the non-Jews do. You see, they think that they'll be heard if they say many words.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Don't be like them. You see, your Father knows what you need before you ask Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>So this is how you must pray: 'Our Father in heaven, Your name <I>and who You are</I> must be made sacred.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Your monarchy must come. What You want must happen. As <I>it must happen</I> in heaven, <I>it must</I> also <I>happen</I> on earth.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Give us the next day's bread today.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>And forgive us for the times when we don't do what we ought to do. Forgive us in the same way that we forgive the people who don't do what we think they ought to do.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You won't carry us into trouble, but save us from the evil one.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN><I>(Do you see what this prayer says about forgiveness?)</I> If you forgive people of their infractions, your Heavenly Father will also forgive you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>But if you won't forgive people, your Father won't forgive you either.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN><I>(Something else that should be done privately is fasting.)</I> When you go on a fast, don't become like the sad-faced fakers. You see, they make their <I>true</I> faces disappear. <I>Even though they aren't sad, they put on a sad face</I> so that people will know that they are fasting. Amen, I tell you, they have all of their pay.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>But as you are fasting, dab perfume on your head, and wash your face.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>That way people won't know that you are fasting, but your Father in the hidden world <I>will know</I>. And your Father, who sees in the hidden world, will give back to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Don't stockpile stockpiles of stuff for yourselves on the earth where a moth and a dinner make them disappear and where thieves break in and steal.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>But stockpile stockpiles of stuff for yourselves in heaven where a moth or a dinner does not make them disappear and where thieves don't break in or steal.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>You see, your heart will also be there where your stockpile is.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>The eye is the lamp that brings light into your body. If your eye is dedicated <I>to its job of seeing</I>, your whole body will be lit up.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>But if your eye is evil <I>and refuses to do its job correctly</I>, your whole body will be dark. If the light entering your body is darkness, how great that darkness is! <I>(So be dedicated to looking at God and looking at what is good and right, or you will end up stumbling around in extreme darkness not knowing what is going on.)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>No one can be a slave to two masters. You see, either he will hate the one <I>master</I> and love the other one, or he will keep the one <I>master</I> in front of him and ignore the other one. You can't be a slave to God and to wealth.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Because of this, I tell you, don't worry about your soul (what you will eat or drink) or your body (what you will put on). Isn't your soul more than the meal <I>it eats</I> and your body more than the attire <I>it puts on</I>?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>Look at the birds in the sky. They don't plant seeds. They don't harvest crops. They don't gather <I>crops</I> into grain bins. Yet your Heavenly Father provides for them. Aren't you much more substantial than they?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>Who from among you can add half a meter to your height by worrying?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>And why do you worry about your attire? Carefully study how the wild flowers in the field grow. They don't labor. They don't make thread or fabric.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>But I tell you that not even Solomon in all of his magnificence put clothes around himself like one of these.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>If God decks out the grass of the field like this, that exists today and tomorrow is thrown into a fire pit, won't He do much more for you, you people who seldom trust Him?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>So don't worry and say, 'What will we eat?', or 'What will we drink?', or 'What <I>clothes</I> will we put around ourselves?'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>The non-Jews search for all these things. <I>Why do you? You have a Heavenly Father.</I> Your Heavenly Father knows absolutely everything that you need.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>Look for God's monarchy first and His right way, and all of these things will be added to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 6:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>You shouldn't worry about what will happen tomorrow. Tomorrow will worry about that. <I>It doesn't need your help.</I> It has enough problems <I>without you adding to them</I>."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 7</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>"Don't judge people so that people won't judge you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>You see, the judgment you judge others with is the judgment others will judge you with, and the amount of judging that you give is the amount you will receive.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Why do you see the wood chip in your brother's eye <I>(his tiny fault)</I>, but you refuse to take a close look at the log in your eye <I>(your huge fault)?</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Or how will you make this statement to your brother, 'Let me take the wood chip out of your eye,' when, look, there's a log in your eye?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Faker, first take the log out of your eye, and then you'll be able to clearly see the wood chip in your brother's eye so that you can take it out.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Don't give what is sacred to the dogs, and don't throw your pearls down in front of hogs. That way they won't trample on them with their feet, turn around, and rip you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Ask, and it will be given to you. Look, and you will find. Knock, and <I>a door</I> will open to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>You see, everyone asking receives. The person looking finds. And <I>a door</I> will open to the person knocking.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Or who from among you is a person who will give a stone to his son when he asks for bread?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Or <I>who is a father</I> who will give him a snake when he asks for a fish?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>So if you, who are evil, know that you should give good presents to your children, how much more <I>will it be, that</I> your Father in heaven will give good things to those who ask Him?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN><I>(This is also how you should treat other people.)</I> However many things that you may want people to do for you, do all that for them. You see, this is what the Law and the Preachers tell you to do.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Go in through the narrow gate because the wide gate and its spacious road lead off to ruin. Many are going in through it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>How narrow is the gate and road that winds its way through hard times as it leads people off to life! Few people are finding it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Be cautious of the counterfeit preachers that are coming to you. They are wearing sheep costumes, but on the inside, they are vicious wolves.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>You can correctly understand them by looking at their fruits<I>, what they produce. (Grapes and figs are fruits.)</I> You don't gather grape clusters from plants that have thorns, do you? And you don't pick figs from plants that have thistles, do you?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>And so every good tree produces nice fruit. But every defective tree produces evil fruit.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>A good tree can't produce evil fruit. And a defective tree can't produce nice fruit either.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Every tree that doesn't produce nice fruit is chopped down and is thrown into a fire.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Clearly, by their fruits, you will definitely correctly understand them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Not everyone who says to Me, 'Master, Master,' will enter heaven's monarchy. Only those who do what My Father in heaven wants will enter.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Many will make this statement to Me in that day, 'Master, Master, didn't we preach using Your name? Didn't we throw lesser deities out using Your name? Didn't we do many abilities using Your name?'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>At that time, I will acknowledge to them, 'I never ever knew you. Get away from Me. You are the ones working on the crime.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Everyone who listens to My messages and does them will be like the attentive man who built his house on bedrock.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>When the rain poured, the rivers overflowed, and the wind blew, they pushed against that house, but it didn't fall. You see, its foundation had been laid on bedrock.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>But everyone who listens to My messages and doesn't do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on sand.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>When the rain poured, the rivers overflowed, and the wind blew, they pushed against that house, and it fell. Its fall was great."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>When Jesus completely finished these messages, the crowds were impressed with His teaching.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 7:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>You see, He was teaching them as someone with authority would <I>(as a king or a master would teach the people under him)</I>. Their Old Testament transcribers didn't teach like that.</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 8</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>When He walked down from the mountain, large crowds followed Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And look, a man with a skin disease came and bowed down to Him. "Master," he said, "if you want, you can clear up my skin."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Jesus put out His hand and touched him. "I want to," He said. "Be cleared up." Right away his skin disease cleared up.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>"Make sure that you don't tell anyone," Jesus told him, "but make your way back to the priest, show yourself to him, and offer the contribution stipulated by Moses. That will be a witness to them <I>of what happened to you</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>When Jesus went into Capernaum, a lieutenant came up to Him urging Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>"Master," he said, "my servant boy has been confined <I>to bed</I> in the house. He is disabled and being tortured dreadfully."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>"I will come and heal him," said Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>When the lieutenant responded, he was declaring, "Master, I am unfit for you to come in under the roof of my house. Just say a word, and my servant boy will be cured.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>You see, I am a person under the authority <I>of the Roman Emperor</I>. I have soldiers under me. To this soldier, I say, 'Travel,' and he travels. To another, I say, 'Go,' and he goes. To my slave, I say, 'Do this,' and he does it. <I>I know that You also can say a word, and your unseen soldiers will cure my servant boy.</I>"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>When Jesus heard this, He was amazed. He told the people following Him, "Amen, I tell you, I haven't found this much trust beside anyone in Israel.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I tell you that many will arrive <I>from outside of the Jewish nation,</I> from eastern regions and the western regions. They will recline with <I>the Jewish fathers</I> (Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob) in heaven's monarchy,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>but <I>the Jews,</I> the sons of the monarchy, will be thrown out into the darkness that is outside and further away. There they will cry and grind their teeth <I>because they missed out on what was rightfully theirs</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Jesus told the lieutenant, "Make your way back home. It must happen as you trusted." In that hour, his servant boy was cured.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>After Jesus went into Peter's house, He saw that Peter's mother-in-law had been confined <I>to bed</I> with a fever.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Jesus touched her hand and the fever left. She got up and started serving Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>In the evening, they brought many people to Him, people who had lesser deities and people who had something wrong with them. He threw the spirits out with a word and healed all the others.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN><I>He did this</I> in order that what God stated through Isaiah, the preacher, might be accomplished, "He took our weaknesses and hauled the illnesses away" <I>(Isaiah 53:4)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>When Jesus saw the crowd surrounding Him, He gave the order to go off to the other side <I>of the Sea of Galilee</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>An Old Testament transcriber came up to Him and said, "Teacher, I will follow You wherever You go off to."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>"Foxes have burrows to live in," Jesus told him, "and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of the Person doesn't even have a place to rest His head." <I>("The Son of the Person" is a generic term Jesus used of Himself. Ezekiel and Daniel were called "son of a person." "Son of a person" is also in Psalm 80:17.)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>A different one of His students said to Him, "Master, give me permission to first go off and bury my father <I>after he dies</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>But Jesus told him, "Follow Me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>He climbed on board the boat and His students followed Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>As they were going to the other side, look, a large quake happened in the sea in such a way for the boat to be covered by the swells, but Jesus was sleeping.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>They went and got Him up. "Master, rescue us," they said. "These swells are ruining us."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>"Why are you cowards?" He asked them. "Why do you seldom trust?" Then He got up and told the winds and the sea to stop. They stopped, and it became very calm.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>The people were amazed. "What kind of person is this," they were saying, "that even the winds and the sea obey Him?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>When they got to the other side, they came to the rural area of the Gadarenes. Two people who had lesser deities came out of the cemetery to meet Him. They were very fierce, so fierce that no one felt safe using the road that passed by there.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>And look, they yelled, "Son of God, why are you interfering with us? Did you come here before the appointed time to torture us?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>A long way away from them, a large herd of hogs was grazing.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>The lesser deities were urging Him, "If you throw us out, send us into the herd of hogs."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>"Make your way out," said Jesus. When they went out, they went off into the hogs. And look, the entire herd rushed down the steep slope into the sea and died in the water.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>The people grazing them escaped <I>from the stampede</I> and went off into the city. There they reported everything, even the things about the two with lesser deities.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 8:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>And look, the entire city came out to meet with Jesus. <I>(They most likely were non-practicing Jews who made their living by raising hogs. Jews were not supposed to eat or even touch hogs.)</I> After seeing Him, they urged Him to go somewhere else away from their borders.</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 9</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>He climbed on board the boat and crossed all the way back over. Then He went to His own city.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And look, people brought a disabled man to Him on a cot who had been confined <I>to bed</I>. When Jesus saw their trust, He said to the disabled man, "Be courageous, child. Your sins are forgiven."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And look, some of the Old Testament transcribers said to each other, "This Man is insulting God."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>When Jesus saw what they were contemplating, He said, "Why are you contemplating evil in your hearts?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>You see, which is easier to say, 'Your sins are forgiven,' or 'Get up and walk around?'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>But so that you may see that the Son of the Person has authority on earth to forgive sins," at that time, He turned to the disabled man and said, "Get up, pick up your cot, and make your way back to your house."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>The man got up and went off to his house.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>When the crowds saw this, they were afraid and praised the magnificence of the God that gave this type of authority to people.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>As Jesus passed by there, He saw a man sitting at the tax booth. His name was Matthew. "Follow Me," He told him. Matthew stood up and followed Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Later, it happened that He was chatting and feasting in Matthew's house. And look, many tax collectors and sinful people came and were chatting and feasting together with Jesus and His students.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>When the Separatists saw it, they were asking His students, "Why is your teacher eating with the tax collectors and sinful people?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>When Jesus heard it, He said, "The people who are healthy and well don't need a doctor, but the people who have something wrong with them do.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>As you travel home, learn what <I>the Bible means when it says</I>, 'I want forgiving kindness and not sacrifice' <I>(Hosea 6:6)</I>. You see, I didn't come to invite people who do what is right <I>to live for God</I>. I came to invite sinful people."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>At that time, John's students came up to Him and asked, "Why do we and the Separatists often abstain from eating, but Your students don't?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Jesus told them, "The 'sons of the bridal room' <I>(the people negotiating with the groom for the bride and helping her with the wedding)</I> can't be grieving as long as the groom is present, can they? <I>No, they are the bride's friends and are representing her to the groom. They must be happy.</I> But days will come when the groom is gone, then they will abstain from eating.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>No one puts a patch of unprocessed cloth on a well-worn robe. You see, <I>if they do that</I>, the patch that fills in <I>the hole</I> lifts away from the robe and the tear becomes worse.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>They don't put wine that is in the early stages of fermentation in worn-out leather bags either. If they were to do that, the leather bags definitely would rip open, the wine would spill out, and the leather bags would be ruined. No, they put wine that is in the early stages of fermentation in new leather bags. That way both the wine and the bag are preserved."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>As He was speaking, look, one of the head people came forward and bowed down to Him, "My daughter passed away just now," he said, "but if You come and place Your hand on her, she will live."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Jesus got up. He and His students followed the man.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>And look, a woman came up from behind and touched the fringe of His robe. This woman had been bleeding for twelve years.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>She was saying to herself, "If only I could touch His robe, I will be rescued <I>from this bleeding</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>When Jesus turned and saw her, He said, "Daughter, be courageous, your trust has rescued you." From that hour, the woman was rescued <I>(her bleeding stopped)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Jesus came into the head person's house and saw flute players and a crowd of people causing a disturbance <I>as they mourned for the girl</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>"Make room for us." Jesus said. "The girl has not died. She is sleeping." They laughed at Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>When the crowd was thrown out, He went in the room where the girl was. He took hold of her hand, and she got up.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>This news went out into all of that land.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>As Jesus passed by there, two blind men started following Him. They were yelling, "Show forgiving kindness to us, Son of David." <I>(Son of David is a less specific term for Anointed King or Messiah.)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>After He went into a house, the blind men came up to Him. "Do you trust that I am able to do this?" Jesus asked. "Yes, Master," they said.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>Then He touched their eyes. "It must happen to you aligned with your trust," He said.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>Their eyes were opened. <I>They could see.</I> Jesus was stern with them, "Look. No one must know."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>But after the <I>two</I> left, they thoroughly spread the news about Him in all of that land.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>As they were going out, look, a person who couldn't speak and who had a lesser deity was brought to Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>After the lesser deity was thrown out, the person who couldn't speak spoke. The crowds were amazed. They were saying, "Nothing like this has ever been shown in Israel."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>But the Separatists were saying, "He is using the head of the lesser deities to throw the lesser deities out."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>Jesus took His students around to all of the cities and villages. He was teaching in their synagogues, speaking publicly about the good news of the monarchy, and healing every illness and every minor ailment.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>When He saw the crowds, He had sympathy concerning them because they had been irritated and tossed around. It was as if they were sheep that didn't have a shepherd.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>At that time, He told His students, "There certainly is a big harvest, but there are <I>only</I> a few workers.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 9:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>So plead with the master of the harvest so that he might put workers out into his harvest."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 10</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>He called His twelve students together and gave them authority over spirits that are not clean. <I>This gave them the ability</I> to throw them out and to heal every illness and every minor ailment.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>These are the names of the twelve missionaries: first, Simon (the one called Peter), Andrew (Peter's brother), James (Zebedee's son), and John (James' brother);</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Philip and Bartholomew; Thomas and Matthew (the tax collector); James (Alpheus' son) and Thaddeus;</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Simon (the Zealot) and Judas (the one from Kerioth, the one who also turned Him in).</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Jesus sent these twelve out on missions <I>(this is why they were called missionaries). For this mission,</I> He gave these orders to them, "You won't walk down a road that goes to non-Jews, and you won't go off to even a city of Samaritans.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Instead, travel to the lost sheep of Israel's house <I>(the Jews who aren't on the right path)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>As you travel, speak publicly. Say, 'Heaven's monarchy has come near.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Heal the weak. Bring the dead back to life. Clear up skin diseases. Throw lesser deities out. You received this for free, give it out for free. <I>Do not charge for your services.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN><I>You shouldn't take money with you.</I> Don't get gold, silver, or copper for your money belts.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Don't pack a tote bag for the road, or two shirts, or sandals, or a staff. You see, the worker deserves to be fed with a meal.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Whatever city or village you go into, question <I>people</I> about who in it deserves <I>to be blessed</I>. Stay there until you go out.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>As you go into the house, say hello to everyone.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>If the house is certainly deserving, stay there in peace. But if it isn't deserving, your peace must return to you <I>(in other words, you must leave without arguing, without fighting, and without getting upset--leave in peace)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>Whoever doesn't accept you or listen to your messages, as you go outside of the house or outside of that city, shake the dust off your feet.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Amen, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah on the day of sentencing than for that city.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Look, I am sending you out on this mission as sheep in the middle of wolves. Be attentive like snakes and unpolluted like doves.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Be cautious of people. You see, they will turn you into councils and whip you in their synagogues.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>You will also be led before leaders and kings on account of Me for a witness to them and the non-Jews.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>When they turn you in, don't worry about how or what you will speak. That will be given to you in the hour that you speak.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>You won't be the ones speaking. Your Father's Spirit will be speaking in you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>A brother will turn a brother in to be put to death, and a father will turn a child in. Children will stand up against their parents and have them put to death.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>You will be hated by all kinds of people because of My name. The person who persists to do what is right to the conclusion will be rescued.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>When they pursue you in this city, escape to a different city. Amen, I tell you, you will not in any way finish the cities of Israel until the Son of the Person comes.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>A student is not over his teacher, and a slave is not over his master either.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>It is enough for a student to become like his teacher and a slave to become like his master. If they also called the homeowner Beelzebub <I>(the head of the lesser deities)</I>, how much more will they do the same thing to the people living in His house.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>But don't be afraid of them. You see, everything that is covered up will be uncovered, and everything that is hidden will be known.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>What I tell you in the dark, say in the light, and what you hear in the ear speak publicly on top of the houses.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>Don't be afraid of the one who kills the body, but can't kill the soul. Instead be afraid of the One who can ruin both the soul and the body in Hinnom Valley.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>Aren't two little sparrows sold for a few dollars? Yet one from them won't fall to the earth unaccompanied by your Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>Even the hairs of your head have all been numbered.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>So don't be afraid, you are more substantial than many little sparrows.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>So everyone who will acknowledge being in Me in front of people, I will also acknowledge being in him in front of My Father in heaven.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>But whoever denies Me in front of people, I also will deny him in front of My Father in heaven.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>Don't assume that I came to put peace on the earth. I didn't come to put peace, but a dagger.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>You see, I came to pit a son against his father, a daughter against her mother, and a bride against her mother-in-law.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>A person's enemies will be the people in his own house.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>Anyone who is fond of a father or mother more than he is fond of Me doesn't deserve Me. And anyone who is fond of a son or daughter more than he is fond of Me doesn't deserve Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>A person who doesn't take up his cross <I>(or in other words, isn't ready to die for Me)</I>, and follow behind Me is not deserving of Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>The person who finds his soul will lose it, but the person who loses his soul on account of Me will find it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>The person who accepts you accepts Me, and the person who accepts Me accepts the One who sent Me out on this mission.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>The person who accepts a preacher simply because he is a preacher will receive a preacher's pay. And the person who accepts someone who does what is right simply because he is someone who does what is right will receive the pay of someone who does what is right.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 10:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>And whoever gives one of these little ones a cup of cold drink simply because he is a student, amen, I tell you, he won't in any way lose his pay."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 11</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Jesus finished by specifically assigning <I>where each of</I> His twelve students <I>would go</I>. Then He happened to walk somewhere else so that He could teach and publicly speak in other cities.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>John the Submerger was in prison. From there, he heard about what the Anointed King was doing. <I>It wasn't what he had expected.</I> So He sent his students to Him with this message:</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>"Are you the One coming, or should we expect a different person?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Jesus answered John's students with these words, "After you travel back to John, report to him what you have heard and seen here.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Blind people see, crippled people are walking around, people with skin diseases are cleared up, hearing-impaired people hear, dead people get up, and good news is shared with poor people.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Also tell him that whoever does not stumble on Me is blessed."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>As John's students traveled back, Jesus began to talk to the crowds about John, "What did you go out into the backcountry to watch, a stick disturbed by wind?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>But what did you go out to see? Someone decked out in elegant clothes? Look, the people wearing the elegant clothes are in kings' houses.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>But what did you go out to see? A preacher? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a preacher.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>This is what has been written <I>in the Bible</I> about him, 'Look, I am sending My messenger out on a mission before Your face. He will construct Your road in front of You' <I>(Malachi 3:1)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Amen, I tell you, a greater person than John the Submerger has not gotten up among all the people born to women. Yet the littler person in heaven's monarchy is greater than him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>From the days of John the Submerger until now, people are forcing heaven's monarchy <I>down their road</I>. Forceful people are snatching it. <I>They are against God's new road.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You see, all the Preachers and the Law preached until John. <I>That was the old system. But now a change has come.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>If you want to accept it, John is the Elijah that is going to come. <I>This is mentioned in the last two verses of the Old Testament (Malachi 4:5,6). There it says that Elijah is going to come before the Master's great and dreadful day and that He will bring in a change.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>The person who has ears must listen.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>What will I liken this generation to? It is like when young children sit in the marketplaces and holler to different children.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>'We played the flute for you,' they holler, 'and you didn't dance. We wailed, and you didn't beat your chests in grief.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>You see, when John came, he wasn't eating or drinking, and they said, 'He has a lesser deity.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>When the Son of the Person came, he was eating and drinking. But they said, 'Look, an excessive eater and a wine drinker, a friend of tax collectors and sinful people.' Insight is proven to be right by its actions. <I>Or in other words, what these people do gives insight into who they really are.</I>"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>At that time, He began to criticize the cities that most of His abilities happened in because they didn't change their ways.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>"What a tragedy it is to you, Chorazin! What a tragedy it is to you, Bethsaida! because if the abilities that happened in you had happened in Tyre and Sidon, they would have changed their ways a long time ago wearing sackcloth <I>(cloth that grieving people wear)</I> and throwing ashes on themselves <I>to express their grief</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>More importantly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of sentencing than for you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>And you, Capernaum, you won't be put up high, up to heaven, <I>as you think you will, just because I was often in your city</I>. You will be walked down to Hades <I>(the underworld of the dead)</I> because if the abilities that happened in you happened in Sodom, it would still be here today.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>More importantly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of sentencing than for you."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Some time around then, Jesus responded and said, "Father, Master of heaven and earth, I admire the way You hid these things away from the scholars and scientists and uncovered them to infants.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>Yes, Father, as You have seen, this has worked out quite well.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>My Father turned everything over to Me. No one correctly understands the Son except the Father. And no one correctly understands the Father except the Son and whoever the Son intends to uncover the Father to.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>Come to Me, everyone who labors and is loaded down. And I will get you to relax.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>Strap yourself into My harness and learn from Me because I am submissive and lowly to the core. You will find relief for your souls.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 11:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>You see, My harness is kind, and My load is light."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 12</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Some time around then, Jesus traveled through croplands on the Sabbaths. His students were hungry, so they began to pull off the heads of grain and eat them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>When the Separatists saw it, they told Him, "Look, your students are doing what they are not allowed to do on the Sabbath. <I>They are working. Work is not allowed on the Sabbath.</I>"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>But Jesus told them, "Haven't you read what David did when he and the people with him were hungry?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN><I>Haven't you read</I> how he went into God's house and they ate the display bread that he and the people with him were not allowed to eat? Only the priests were allowed to eat it. <I>Yet, the head priest gave it to them and they ate. Do you condemn David for doing that? No.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Or haven't you read in the Law that on the Sabbaths the priests on the temple grounds profane the Sabbath, <I>they work on the Sabbath,</I> and they are innocent?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>I tell you that something greater than the temple grounds is here.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>But if you had known what <I>this part of the Bible</I> is, 'I want forgiving kindness and not sacrifice' <I>(Hosea 6:6)</I>, you wouldn't have found the innocent guilty.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>You see, there is a master over the Sabbath. It is the Son of the Person."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>He walked somewhere else away from there and went into their synagogue.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>And look, a man was there who had a deformed hand. They asked <I>Jesus about</I> him by saying, "<I>Tell us</I> if healing on the Sabbaths is allowed." <I>They were trying to get Him to say something</I> that they could use against Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>"Who from among you will be a person who has one sheep," said Jesus, "and if this sheep should fall into a hole on the Sabbaths, will not grab it and get it up <I>out of the hole?</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>So isn't a person much more substantial than a sheep? When it comes to things like this, you are allowed to do nice things on the Sabbaths."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Then He told the person with the deformed hand, "Put your hand out." He put it out, and it was established back healthy as the other hand.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>After the Separatists left, they sought legal counsel against Him <I>that they could use</I> to ruin Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>When Jesus knew it, He took a back way out of there. Large crowds followed Him. He healed everyone who needed healing</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>and shushed them so that they wouldn't show who He is.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>This was so that what God stated through Isaiah, the preacher, might be accomplished:</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>"Look, My Servant Boy that I picked, My Loved <I>Servant Boy</I>. My soul is delighted with Him. I will put My Spirit on Him. He will report a judgment to the nations.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>He won't fight, He won't yell, no one will hear His voice in the plazas,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 12:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>He won't break a crushed stick, and He won't extinguish a smoldering wick until He will throw out the judgment for victory.</P>
