<TITLE>Matthew 13</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>During that day, Jesus went out of the house and sat beside the Sea <I>of Galilee</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Large crowds gathered to Him. So He climbed on board a boat and sat down. The crowd stood on the beach.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>He told them many illustrations. He said, "Look, the person who plants crops went out to plant. <I>His method of planting was flinging handfuls of seeds on the ground throughout the whole field.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>As he flung out seeds, some fell along the road. When the birds came, they ate them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Others fell on the rocky areas where there wasn't much soil. Right away plants sprang up from the rocks because they didn't have any depth of soil.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>But when the sun came up and it got hot, they dried up and died because they didn't have roots.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Others fell where there were thorns. The thorns climbed up and choked them out.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Others fell on the nice soil. They grew up and produced fruit. Some produced a hundred fruit, some sixty, some thirty.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>The person who has ears must listen."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>His students came up to Him and asked, "Why are you telling them illustrations?"</P>

<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>"You see, anyone who has will get, and it will overflow, but anyone who does not have, even what he has will be taken away from him.</P>

<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>This fills up Isaiah's preaching that says, 'You will hear what you hear and not in any way understand, and as you look, you will look and not in any way see.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>You see, the heart of this ethnic group <I>(the Jews)</I> became fat. <I>They were given much.</I> But they hardly heard with their ears. <P><A NAME="Matthew 13:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN><I>It shows different responses that people have to the monarchy's message.</I> With everyone who hears the monarchy's message and doesn't understand, the evil one comes and snatches up that seed that was planted in their heart. This is the seed that was flung along the road.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>The seed that was flung on the rocky areas, this is the person who hears the message and right away happily receives it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>But it doesn't have any root in him. It is for the time being. When the message brings hard times or persecution, right away he stumbles.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>The seed that was flung into the thorns, this is the person who hears the message <I>but it is surrounded by worry and wealth. The message has root and grows.</I> But worry <I>about the things that happen in this</I> span of time and wealth's fraud are also there. They come together and choke off the message. <I>The message is still in him, but</I> it is fruitless.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>The seed that was flung on to the nice soil, this is the person who hears and understands the message <I>and who isn't overtaken by worry or wealth</I>. <P><A NAME="Matthew 13:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>He laid out another illustration for them, "Heaven's monarchy is like a person who planted high quality seed out in his field.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN><I>One night</I> when people were sleeping, his enemy came, flung ryegrass seeds out in the middle of the field up on top of the wheat, and left.</P>

<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>He was declaring to them, 'My enemy did this.' 'Do you want us to go off and gather up the ryegrass?' the slaves asked.</P>

<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>Leave both of them. Let them grow together until the harvest. <P><A NAME="Matthew 13:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>He told them another illustration, "Heaven's monarchy is like yeast. A woman took it and hid it in three loads of dough until all of it was raised."</P>

<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>He did this so that what God stated through the preacher might be accomplished, "I will open my mouth in illustrations. I will utter things that have been hidden since the world was formed" <I>(Psalm 78:2)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>At that time, He left the crowds and went into the house. His students came up to Him. "Explain the meaning of the illustration of the ryegrass in the field," they said.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>Jesus answered by saying, "The person planting the high quality seed is the Son of the Person.</P>

<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>So even as the ryegrass is gathered up and burned with fire, so will it be at the very conclusion of this span of time.</P>

<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>Heaven's monarchy is like a stockpile of treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it. And because he was so happy, he made his way back home, sold everything that he had, and purchased that field.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>Again heaven's monarchy is like a man, a wholesaler, looking for nice pearls.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>When he found a very valuable pearl, he went off, put everything he had up for sale, and purchased it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>Again heaven's monarchy is like a trawl net that was thrown into the sea and gathered all kinds of things together.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:48"></A><SPAN class="verseno">48 </SPAN>When it was full, they hauled it up on the beach, sat down, and went through what was in it. They gathered up the nice things into buckets, but threw out the defective things.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 13:49"></A><SPAN class="verseno">49 </SPAN>This is how it will be at the very conclusion of this span of time. The angels will go out and isolate the evil people out from the middle of the people who did what is right.</P>

<TITLE>Matthew 14</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Some time around then, Herod (the head of one of Palestine's four regions) heard the talk about Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>"This is John the Submerger," he told his servant boys. "He has come back to life from the dead. That's why the abilities are active in Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>You see, after Herod arrested John, he chained him up and put him away in jail because of Herodias. Herodias was his brother Philip's wife.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>John had been telling him that he is not allowed to have her.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>And as Herod wanted to kill him, he was afraid of what the crowd would do because they considered John to be a preacher.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>When <I>one of the many</I> birthday celebrations for Herod happened, Herodias' daughter danced in the middle <I>of the room</I>, and Herod liked it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>So he acknowledged from there with an oath to give her whatever she asked for.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>She was forced forward by her mother. "Give me," she declares, "here and now on a plate, John the Submerger's head."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>This saddened the king, but because of the oath and the people chatting and feasting together with him, he gave the order for it to be done.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>The order was sent to the jail, and John was beheaded.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>His head was carried on a plate and given to the girl. She carried it to her mother.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>His students went to the jail, took the corpse, and buried it. Then they went and reported it to Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>When Jesus heard it, He took a back way from there to a boat and sailed to an uninhabited place to be by Himself. When the crowds heard that Jesus had left, they came out of the cities and followed Him on foot.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>When He got out of the boat, there was a big crowd. When He saw them, He had sympathy for them and healed their sick.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>In the evening, His students came up to Him and said, "This place is uninhabited, and it is already getting late. Dismiss the crowds so that they can go off into the villages and buy food for themselves."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>"They don't need to go away," said Jesus. "Give them something to eat."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>"We don't have anything here," His students said, "except five loaves of bread and two fish."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>"Bring them here to Me," said Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>He told the crowds to recline on the grass. He took the five loaves of bread and the two fish, looked up into the sky, and conferred a blessing on them. He split them and gave the pieces to His students. His students passed them out to the crowds.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Everyone was adequately fed. They picked up the pieces that were left over. There were twelve full baskets.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>There were about five thousand men eating there, not counting the women and children.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Right away He compelled His students to climb on board the boat and lead the way ahead of Him to the other side while He dismissed the crowds.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>After dismissing the crowds, He climbed up into the mountain by Himself to pray. When evening came, He was there alone.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>The boat was already several thousand feet away from land, and it was being tortured by the swells. You see, the wind was against them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>In the fourth guard shift of the night <I>(3 a.m. - 6 a.m.)</I>, He went to them walking around on the sea.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>When His students saw Him walking around on the sea, they were uneasy. "It's a ghost," they yelled. They were afraid.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>Right away Jesus spoke, "Be courageous. It's Me. Don't be afraid."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>"Master, if it is You," Peter responded, "tell me to come to You on the water."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>"Come," said Jesus. Peter stepped down out of the boat and walked around on the water to Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>But when he saw the strong wind, he was afraid. He began to sink down. "Master," he yelled, "rescue me."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>Right away Jesus put out His hand and latched on to him. "You seldom trust. Why did you doubt?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>They climbed up into the boat and the wind stopped blowing.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>The people in the boat bowed down to Him. "You truly are God's son," they said.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>After they crossed all the way over, they were in the land of Gennesaret.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>When the men of that place recognized Him, they sent people out into all of the surrounding rural area. They brought Him all the people who had something wrong with them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 14:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>They were urging Jesus to just let them touch the fringe of His robe. As many as touched were completely restored.</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 15</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>At that time, the Separatists and Old Testament transcribers from Greater Jerusalem came up to Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>"Why are your students violating the older men's tradition?" they asked. "You see, they aren't washing their hands whenever they eat bread."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>When Jesus answered, He said, "And why do you violate God's demand with your tradition?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>You see, God demanded, 'Value the father and the mother' <I>(Deuteronomy 5:16)</I>, and, 'The person who says bad things to a father or mother must pass away in death' <I>(Exodus 21:17)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>But you say, 'Whoever tells the father or mother, "<I>the money</I> that I should have supported you with is a contribution to God,"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>won't ever have to value his father.' You nullified God's message with your tradition.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Fakers, what Isaiah preached about you fits nicely. He said,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>'This ethnic group values Me with their lips, but their heart keeps itself far away from Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Their worship of Me is futile, because the instructions that they teach are people's regulations, <I>not Mine</I>'" <I>(Isaiah 29:13)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Jesus called the crowd together and told them, "Hear, and understand.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>What goes into the mouth doesn't contaminate a person, but what travels out of the mouth, this is what contaminates a person."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>At that time, His students came up to Him and said, "Do you realize that the Separatists who heard what You said were offended?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Jesus answered by saying, "Every plant that My Heavenly Father didn't plant will be uprooted.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>Leave them alone. They are blind guides of blind people. If a blind person guides a blind person, both will fall into a hole."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>When Peter responded, he said, "Explain the meaning of this illustration to us."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>"Are you also still clueless?" said Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>"Aren't you aware that everything traveling into the mouth, takes up room in the belly, and is thrown out into the sewer?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>But the things traveling out of the mouth come out of the heart. Those things contaminate a person.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>You see, evil ponderings, murders, times when someone cheats on a spouse, sexual sins, thefts, lies about what a person witnessed, and insults, all come from the heart.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>They contaminate a person, but eating with hands that haven't been washed does not contaminate him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Jesus went out from there and took a back way into parts of Tyre and Sidon.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>And look, a Palestinian woman came out from the border area yelling, "Show forgiving kindness to me, Master, Son of David. My daughter has a lesser deity in a bad way."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>But Jesus didn't respond with even a word to her. His students came up to Him. They were asking Him, saying, "Dismiss her because she keeps yelling behind us."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>When He responded, He said, "I was only sent out to the lost sheep of Israel's house, <I>to the Jews who aren't on the right path</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Then the woman came and bowed down to Him. "Master, help me," she said.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>When Jesus replied, He said, "It is not nice to take bread away from the children and throw it to the puppies."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>"Yes, Master, <I>you are right,</I>" said the woman. "But even the puppies eat the crumbs that fall from their masters' table."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>"O ma'am," responded Jesus, "your trust is great. It must happen as you want." Her daughter was cured within that hour.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>After Jesus walked somewhere else away from there, He went along the Sea of Galilee. Then He climbed up a mountain and sat down.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>Large crowds came up to Him. They had crippled people with them, blind people, physically wounded people, speech-impaired people, and many different ones. They tossed them at His feet, and He healed them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>The crowd was amazed seeing speech-impaired people speaking, physically wounded people well, crippled people walking around, and blind people seeing. They praised the magnificence of Israel's God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>Jesus called for His students and said, "I have sympathy for the crowd because they have stayed with me already for three days even though they don't have anything to eat. I don't want to dismiss them without food so that they won't ever have a hard time on the road <I>as they return home</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>"Where will we get enough bread to adequately feed such a big crowd out here in this uninhabited place?" His students asked.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>"How much bread do you have?" asked Jesus. "Seven loaves and a few small fish," they said.</P>

<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>Then He took the seven loaves of bread and the fish and was thankful. He split them and gave them to His students. His students passed them out to the crowds.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>They all were adequately fed. Then they picked up the pieces that were left over. There were seven full large baskets.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 15:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>Four thousand men had eaten, not counting the women and children.</P>

<TITLE>Matthew 16</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>The Separatists and Sadducees came up to Jesus to harass Him. They asked Him to show them proof from the sky <I>that He is from God</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>When He answered, He told them, "When evening comes, you say, 'Nice weather. You see, the sky is fiery.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And in the morning, you say, 'It will storm today. You see, the sky is fiery, yet disappointing. <I>There are dark clouds.</I>' You certainly know when something is wrong with the sky's appearance, but <I>when you are surrounded by</I> the proofs of the times, you can't <I>see them</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>An evil and cheating generation searches for proof. No proof will be given to it except the proof of Jonah." He left them there and went away.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>When they went to the other side <I>of the Sea of Galilee</I>, the students forgot to get <I>more</I> bread.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>"See and be cautious of the Separatists and Sadducees' yeast," Jesus said.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>They were pondering <I>this</I> among themselves. "It is because we didn't bring <I>enough</I> bread," they said.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>When Jesus knew about it, He said, "Why are you pondering among yourselves, you people who seldom trust <I>God</I>, that you don't have <I>enough</I> bread?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Aren't you aware yet <I>of what happened?</I> Don't you even remember the five loaves of bread among the five thousand and how many baskets you took up?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Don't you even remember the seven loaves of bread among the four thousand and how many large baskets you took up?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>How aren't you aware that what I said was not about bread? Be cautious of the Separatists and Sadducees' yeast."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Then they understood that He didn't say to be cautious of the bread's yeast, but of the Separatists and Sadducees' teaching. <I>Yeast seems harmless, yet it spreads quickly to all of the dough and changes it. When the Separatists and Sadducees's teaching is bad, it is seldom seen as bad--it quickly spreads and causes ruin.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>When Jesus came into parts of Philip's Caesarea, He was asking His students, "Who do people say that the Son of the Person is?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>"Some, John the Submerger," they said, "others, Elijah; different ones, Jeremiah or one of the preachers."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>"What about you?" Jesus asked. "Who do you say that I am?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>"You are the Anointed King," Simon Peter answered, "the Son of the living God."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>"You are blessed, Simon, son of Jonah," Jesus responded, "because <I>a living physical being</I> (a physical body and blood) didn't uncover this to you. No, My Father in the heavens did.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>I also will tell you that you are a rock. I will build My assembly on the rock <I>of your statement that I am the Anointed King, the Son of the living God</I>. The gates of Hades <I>(the underworld of the dead)</I> will not be strong against it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>I will give you the keys of heaven's monarchy. Whatever you lock up on the earth will be locked up in heaven, and whatever you unlock on the earth will be unlocked in heaven."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>At that time, He warned the students not to tell anyone that He is the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>From then on, Jesus began to show His students that He would have to go off to Jerusalem, suffer many injuries from the older men, head priests, and Old Testament transcribers, be killed, and be gotten up on the third day.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Peter took Him aside and began to tell Him to stop. "<I>God has</I> a remedy for You, Master," he said. "That will never happen to You."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Jesus turned and told Peter, "Make your way back behind Me, opponent. You are an obstacle to Me because you don't focus on God's things. You only focus on what people focus on."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Then Jesus told His students, "If anyone wants to come behind Me, he must flatly deny himself, pick up his cross <I>(or in other words, be ready to die for Me)</I>, and follow Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>You see, whoever wants to rescue his soul will lose it, but whoever loses his soul on account of Me will find it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>You see, what benefit is it for a person to gain the whole world but sustain loss to his soul? Or what will a person give in exchange for his soul?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>The Son of the Person is going to come in His Father's magnificence with His angels. At that time, He will give back to each person the kind of things that person repeatedly did during his life.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 16:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>Amen, I tell you that some of the people standing here won't in anyway taste death until they see the Son of the Person coming in His monarchy."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 17</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>After six days, Jesus took Peter, James, and John (James' brother) with Him up into a high mountain by themselves.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>His appearance changed in front of them. His face shined as bright as the sun. His clothes became as white as light.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And, look, they saw Moses and Elijah speaking together with Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>When Peter responded, he told Jesus, "Master, it's nice for us to be here. If you want, I'll make three tents here: one for You, one for Moses, and one for Elijah."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>As he was still speaking, look, a lit-up cloud shined over them, and look, a voice spoke from the cloud, "This is My loved Son. I am delighted with Him. Listen to Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>When the students heard the voice, they fell on their face and were terribly afraid.</P>

<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus alone.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>As they walked down from the mountain, Jesus gave them a demand. He said, "You will tell no one what you have seen until the Son of the Person is gotten up from the dead."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN><I>Since</I> the students <I>had just seen Elijah, they</I> asked, "So why are the Old Testament transcribers saying that Elijah must come first?"</P>

<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>At that time, the students understood that He was talking about John the Submerger.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>When they came to the crowd, a man came up to Him. He kneeled and said,</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>"Master, show forgiving kindness to my son because he is struck by the moon <I>(that is, he has seizures)</I> and suffers in a bad way. You see, many times he falls into the fire or into the water.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>I brought him to your students, and they weren't able to heal him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>"O untrusting and twisted generation," Jesus responded, "how long must I be with you? How long must I tolerate you? Bring him here to Me."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Jesus told the lesser deity to stop, and it came out. The boy was healed within that hour.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Then Jesus' students came to Him by themselves. "Why couldn't we throw it out?" they asked.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>"Because you seldom trust," Jesus said. "You see, amen, I tell you, if you had a small amount of trust, as small as a kernel of mustard, you would state to this mountain, 'Walk from here to there,' and it would walk. Nothing would be impossible for you."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>[[["But this kind doesn't travel out except in prayer and a time of fasting."]]] <I>Proper prayer and fasting aligns a person with what God wants to do and how. Then that person will do and trust what God has shown him.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>As they were huddled together in Galilee, Jesus said to them, "The Son of the Person is going to be taken into custody by the people.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>They will kill Him, and He will be gotten up on the third day." This made them terribly sad.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>After they came into Capernaum, the people who collect the double drachmas <I>(the temple tax)</I> came to Peter and said, "Isn't your teacher paying the double drachmas?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>"Yes," he said. When he came into the house, Jesus went up to him before he could say anything and said. "What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth collect taxes and require an enrollment? From their sons or from others?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>"From others," said Peter. "So the sons are definitely free," declared Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 17:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>"But so that we won't cause them to stumble, travel to the sea, throw in a hook, and keep the first fish that steps up <I>to attack the hook</I>. When you open its mouth, you will find a silver coin. Give that to them for Me and you."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 18</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>In that hour, the students came to Jesus saying, "So who is greater in heaven's monarchy?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>He called for a young child and stood him up in the middle of them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>"Amen, I tell you, if you won't turn and become as young children," He said, "you won't in any way enter heaven's monarchy.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>So the one who is greater in heaven's monarchy is anyone who will put himself down low, as low as this young child.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>And whoever accepts one young child of this type based on My name accepts Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>But whoever causes one of these little ones who trust in Me to stumble, it would've been to his advantage if instead a large millstone, the kind turned by a donkey, had been hung around his neck and he had been dropped in the deep part of the sea.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>What a tragedy this world experiences from obstacles! You see, there is an obligation that obstacles come. But worse than that, what a tragedy it is to the person who is setting up the obstacle!</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, chop it off, and throw it away. Which is better, to go through life physically wounded or crippled, or to be thrown into the fire that spans all time having two hands and two feet?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>If your eye causes you to stumble, take it out, and throw it away. Which is better, to go through life one-eyed, or to be thrown into the Hinnom Valley of fire having two eyes?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Look, no one should ignore one of these little ones. You see, I tell you that through every situation their angels in heaven see the face of My Father in heaven.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>[[[You see, the Son of the Person came to rescue the lost <I>sheep</I>.]]]</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>What do you think? If it happened that a certain person had a hundred sheep and one sheep from them wandered off, wouldn't he leave the ninety-nine in the mountains, travel off, and look for the one that wandered off?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>And if he happened to find it, amen, I tell you that he would be happier about that than he would about the ninety-nine that have not wandered off.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>In the same way, your Father in heaven doesn't want to see any of these little ones ruined.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>If your brother does something sinful to you, make your way back to him and reprimand him. <I>Keep it</I> only between you and him. If he listens to you, you got your brother back.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>But if he doesn't listen, take one or two people along with you <I>and talk to him about what he did.</I> That way every statement will be established by the mouth of two or three witnesses. <I>They can verify what is said and what his response is.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>If he disregards them, talk to the assembly. If he also disregards the assembly, <I>don't have any type of relationship with him.</I> He must be like a non-Jew and tax collector to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Amen, I tell you, whatever you all lock up on earth will be locked up in heaven, and whatever you unlock on earth will be unlocked in heaven.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Again, <I>concerning what I just said,</I> amen, I tell you that if two from among you on the earth harmoniously agree about every item of whatever they ask for, it will happen to them directly from My Father in heaven.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>You see, where there are two or three that have been gathered together in My name, I am there in the middle of them."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>At that time, Peter came up to Him and said, "Master, how many times will my brother do something sinful to me and I will forgive him? Seven times?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>"I don't say to you seven times," Jesus said. "I say seventy times, times seven.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Because of this, heaven's monarchy is like a person, a king, who wanted to settle his account with his slaves.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>After he began to settle <I>with them</I>, one was brought to him who owed ten thousand 75-pound bags <I>of silver (worth six billion dollars)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Since he couldn't pay it back, the master ordered that he, his wife, his children, and everything that he had be put up for sale so that he could be paid back.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>The slave got down on his knees and was bowing to him. 'Be patient with me,' he said, 'and I will give everything back to you.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>The master of that slave had sympathy. He dismissed him and forgave him of the debt.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>But after that slave left, he found one of his fellow slaves who owed him five thousand dollars. He grabbed him and began choking him. 'Pay me back,' he said, 'if you owe me anything.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>His fellow slave got down on his knees and urged him, 'Be patient with me, and I will pay you back.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>He didn't want to. Instead, he went off and threw him in jail until he paid back what was owed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>When his fellow slaves saw what happened, they were terribly sad. They went to their master and explained to him everything that had happened.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>At that time, his master called for him and said, 'Evil slave, I forgave every bit of what you owed me since you urged me to.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>Wasn't it necessary for you to be kind and forgive your fellow slave the same way I was kind and forgave you?'</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>His master was enraged and turned him over to the torturers until he paid back every bit of what he owed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 18:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>My Heavenly Father will also do the same thing to each one of you if you don't forgive your brother from your heart."</P>
<TITLE>Matthew 19</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 19:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>When Jesus finished these messages, He took off out of Galilee and went to the borders of Judea on the other side of the Jordan River.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 19:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Large crowds followed Him, and He healed them there.</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 19:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Separatists came up to Him to harass Him. "Tell us if a person is allowed to dismiss his wife for any type of accusation that he might have against her."</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 19:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>When Jesus responded, He said, "Didn't you read that the One who created them from the beginning made them male and female?</P>
<P><A NAME="Matthew 19:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>And, 'On account of this, a person will leave his father and mother, stick like glue to his wife, and the two will be one physical body?' <I>(Genesis 2:24)</I></P>
