Their yeast is faked behavior. <I>(Yeast is unseen, yet it spreads quickly to all of the dough that it is in and changes it. The Separatists seem to be good, and their bad is unseen, but it quickly spreads and causes ruin.)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 12:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>There is nothing that has been covered up well that will not be uncovered, and nothing hidden that will not be known.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 12:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>I tell you, everyone who acknowledges being in Me in front of people, the Son of the Person will also acknowledge being in him in front of God's angels.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 12:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>He told an illustration to them: "A certain wealthy man's farmland was productive.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 12:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>"Because of this," He told His students, "I tell you, don't worry about the soul (what you will eat). And don't worry about the body (what you will put on) either.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 12:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>Take a close look at the wild flowers, how they grow. They don't labor. They don't make thread or fabric. But, I tell you, not even Solomon in all his magnificence put <I>clothes</I> around himself like one of these.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 12:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>If God decks out the grass in a field like this, that exists today and tomorrow is thrown into a fire pit, will He not do much more for you, you people who seldom trust Him?</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 12:49"></A><SPAN class="verseno">49 </SPAN>I came to throw fire on the earth. And what do I want? If only it had already been started.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 12:50"></A><SPAN class="verseno">50 </SPAN>There is a submersion that I have to be submerged in. How I am constrained by it until it is finished!</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 12:51"></A><SPAN class="verseno">51 </SPAN>Do you think that I showed up here to give peace in the earth? Definitely not, I tell you, but rather bitter division.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 12:54"></A><SPAN class="verseno">54 </SPAN>He also was saying to the crowds, "When you see clouds coming up over the western regions, right away you say, 'Severe weather is coming,' and that is what happens.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 13:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Some people beside there were reporting to Him at the same time about certain Galileans whose blood Pilate mixed with their sacrifices <I>(or in other words, that Pilate killed while they were offering their sacrifices at the temple)</I>.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 13:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Definitely not, I tell you, but if you don't change your ways, you will all be ruined in a similar way.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Or those eighteen that the tower in the Siloam <I>area</I> fell on and killed, do you think that they somehow ended up owing <I>God</I> more than all the <I>other</I> people living in Jerusalem?</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Definitely not, I tell you, but if you don't change your ways, you will all be ruined in a similar way." <I>(Less than forty years after this, Roman soldiers brutally slaughtered all the Jews in Jerusalem.)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>He told this illustration, "A certain person had a fig tree that he had planted in his vineyard. He went looking for fruit on the fig tree, but he didn't find any.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>'Look,' he told the vineyard worker, 'I have come looking for fruit in this fig tree for three years, and I have found none. So chop it down. Why keep it and prevent the ground from being used for something else?'</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>'Master,' responded the vineyard worker, 'leave it alone for this year too until after I excavate around it and put manure down.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Then if it produces fruit, that certainly <I>is good</I> for the future, but if not, you definitely will chop it down.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbaths.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 13:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>The synagogue's head ruler responded because he was frustrated with Jesus healing on the Sabbath. <P><A NAME="Luke 13:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>"Fakers," responded the Master, "doesn't each of you on the Sabbath untie his cow or donkey from the feed trough and lead it off <I>to where the water is</I> to give it a drink?</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>But this woman, who is a daughter of Abraham, whom the Opponent tied up for, look, eighteen years, isn't it necessary for her to be untied from this restraint on the day of the Sabbath?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>As He said these things, all the people who opposed Him were ashamed, and the entire crowd was happy for all the magnificent things that were happening through Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>"What is God's monarchy like?" He was asking. "And what will I liken it to?</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>It is like a kernel of mustard that a man took and threw into his garden. It grew, turned into a tree, and the birds of the sky nested in its branches."</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 13:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>"It is like yeast that a woman took and hid in three loads of dough until it all was raised."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>He was traveling along through cities and villages teaching and making a journey into Jerusalem.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Someone said to Him, "Master, tell us if it is true that only a few people are rescued." But Jesus said to them,</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>"Struggle to go in through the narrow door, because many, I tell you, will look for <I>an easy way</I> to go in and won't muster up the strength <I>to go in</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>But after the homeowner got up and closed the door, you all began to stand outside and knock on the door, saying, 'Master, open the door for us.' He will respond by stating to you, 'I don't know you <I>or even</I> where you are from.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>At that time, you will begin to tell him, 'We ate and drank in your sight. You taught in our plazas.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>He will state to you, 'I don't know you <I>or even</I> where you are from. Stay away from Me, all you workers of wrong.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>There you will cry and grind your teeth when you see <I>the Jewish fathers</I> (Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob) and all the Jewish preachers in God's monarchy, but you being thrown outside.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 13:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>People will arrive <I>from outside of the Jewish nation,</I> from the eastern regions and the western regions, from the north and the south. They will recline in God's monarchy.</P>

<TITLE>Luke 14</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>He happened to go into the house of one of the head people of the Separatists on the Sabbath to eat bread. They were closely watching Him during the time that He was there.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And look, in front of Him was a certain person whose body was swollen.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Jesus responded by saying to the law experts and Separatists, "Is it permitted to heal on the Sabbath or not?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>They remained calm. He latched on to him, cured him, and dismissed him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>"If your son or cow falls into a well," He told them, "won't you pull him up right away even during the Sabbath?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>They couldn't <I>think of any way</I> to respond against Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>He was giving the people who had been invited some advice as He was fixing His attention on how they were selecting the front reclining spots <I>(the place of honor)</I>. He told them,</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>"When someone invites you to wedding events, you shouldn't recline in the front reclining spot. What if perhaps someone more important than you has also been invited?</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>The one who invited both of you will come to you and state, 'Give your spot to this person.' Then with shame you will begin to move back to the last spot <I>in the back</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>But when you arrive at wedding events that you were invited to, settle down in the last spot <I>in the back</I> so that when the person who has invited you comes to you, he will state, 'Friend, move further up toward the front.' Then it will be magnificent for you, and all the people reclining together with you will see it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Every person who puts himself up high will be put down low, and the person who puts himself down low will be put up high."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>He also was saying to the person who had invited Him, "When you have a lunch or a feast, don't holler for your friends, brothers, relatives, or wealthy neighbors. That way it won't ever become a thing where they repay you in return by inviting you to one of their meals.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>But whenever you have a reception, invite poor, badly wounded, crippled, and blind people.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>You will be blessed because they don't have a way to repay you. You see, it will be repaid to you in the <I>next life</I> when the people who do what is right return back to life."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>When someone who was feasting and chatting together with Him heard these things, he told Him, "Anyone who will eat bread in God's monarchy, <I>as we Jews will,</I> is blessed."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Jesus told him, "A certain person was having a large feast and invited many.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>He sent his slave out an hour before the feast to tell the people who had been invited, 'Come, the meal is already ready.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>They all began, <I>starting</I> from one <I>consensus,</I> to come up with excuses. The first told him, 'I purchased a field, and I am obligated to go out and see it. I ask you to excuse me.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>A different one said, 'I purchased five pairs of cows and have to go check them. I ask you to excuse me.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>And a different one said, 'I <I>just</I> married a woman. That's why I can't come.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>When the slave showed up, he reported these things back to his master. At that time, the property owner was enraged and told his slave, 'Go out quickly into the plazas and streets of the city, and bring the poor, badly wounded, blind, and crippled in here.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 14:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>'Master,' said the slave, 'what you ordered has already happened and there are still empty places.'</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 15:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>When he finds it, he places it on his shoulders and is happy.</P>

<TITLE>Luke 21</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Luke 21:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>He looked up and saw wealthy people throwing their contributions into <I>the collection boxes in</I> the treasury area.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 21:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>You see, all these people for their contributions threw in part of what they had left over, but she, even though she didn't make enough to live on, threw in everything that she had, her whole life savings."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 21:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Some were telling Him about the nice stones and donations that decorated the temple grounds.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 23:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>One of the outlaws hanging there was insulting Him. "Are You not the Anointed King?" he said. "Rescue Yourself and us."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>The other outlaw responded by shushing him and declaring, "Are you not afraid of God either? Because you have the same sentence. <I>You also are nailed to a cross,</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>and we, certainly rightly so. You see, we are receiving what we deserve for the things that we constantly did. But this man constantly did nothing out of place."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>He was telling Jesus, "Remember me when You come into Your monarchy."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>"Amen, I tell you," Jesus told him, "today you will be with Me in paradise."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>It already seemed like noon, <I>and the sun stopped shining</I>. It became dark over the whole earth until 3 p.m.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>After the sun quit, the temple's curtain tore down the middle.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>"Father," Jesus hollered with a loud voice, "I place My spirit directly in Your hands." When He said this, He breathed out <I>His last breath</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>When the lieutenant saw what happened, he was praising God's magnificence and saying, "This Man really was doing what is right."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:48"></A><SPAN class="verseno">48 </SPAN>All the crowds that came out together to watch this event, after watching what happened, were returning home hitting their chests.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:49"></A><SPAN class="verseno">49 </SPAN>All of the people He knew and the women who followed along with Him out of Galilee had stood off at a distance viewing these things.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:50"></A><SPAN class="verseno">50 </SPAN>And look, there was a man named Joseph, an advisor, who was also a good man and did what is right.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:51"></A><SPAN class="verseno">51 </SPAN>This man was on the council, but he had not voted in agreement with what they intended <I>to do</I> or any of the things they were repeatedly doing against Jesus. He was from Arimathaea, a Jewish city, and was awaiting God's monarchy.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:52"></A><SPAN class="verseno">52 </SPAN>This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus' body.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:53"></A><SPAN class="verseno">53 </SPAN>He took it down off the cross, wound a linen cloth around it, and placed Him in a grave cut out of rock. No one had been laid in it yet.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:54"></A><SPAN class="verseno">54 </SPAN>It was a preparation day <I>(the day before a Sabbath that is spent preparing food and setting up for the next day, a day of rest)</I>, and a sabbath <I>(the first day of the Yeast-free Festival)</I> was emerging.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:55"></A><SPAN class="verseno">55 </SPAN>Some of the women who had come together from Galilee followed behind Joseph. They saw the burial vault and how His body was placed in it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 23:56"></A><SPAN class="verseno">56 </SPAN>They returned <I>to where they were staying</I> and prepared fragrant resins and perfumes for His body. They certainly calmed down on the Sabbath <I>(not wailing and beating their chests as it was customary to do after a death). This was</I> aligned with the demand <I>about keeping the Sabbath holy</I>.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 24:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>On Day One <I>(which is Sunday)</I> after the Sabbaths, long before daybreak, they went to the grave carrying the fragrant resins that they had prepared.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>But they found that the stone had been rolled away from the burial vault's door.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 24:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>And look, on the same day two of them were traveling to a village 60 track laps <I>(7 1/2 miles)</I> away from Jerusalem. Its name is Emmaus.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 24:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>When the one named Cleopas answered, he said to Him, "Are you just a tourist in Jerusalem? Don't you know the things that happened there in the last several days?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>"What kind of things?" He asked. "The things about Jesus, the Nazarene," they told Him, "a man who became a capable preacher in His work and message directly in front of God and all the ethnic group,</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>and how the head priests and our head people turned Him over <I>to the Romans</I> for a death sentence and nailed Him to a cross.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>We were anticipating that He is the One who is going to be paying for Israel's release. But definitely together with all these things, <I>God</I> is also bringing this third day since these things happened.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>But also some of our women astounded us who went to the burial vault early in the morning.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>When they didn't find His body, they came and said that they had also seen a sighting of angels, angels that said He is alive.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Some of the people who were together with us went off to the burial vault and found it just as the women had said, but they didn't see Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>"O you people who are unobservant and slow to heartily trust everything that the preachers spoke," Jesus told them.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 24:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>Beginning with Moses and all the Preachers, He thoroughly interpreted to them the passages about Himself in all the <I>Old Testament</I> writings.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>When they were near the village that they were traveling to, He pretended to be traveling farther.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>"Stay with us," they implored Him, "because it is getting late in the afternoon and most of the day has already gone." He went in and stayed with them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>While He was reclining with them, He happened to take the bread, confer a blessing on it, split it, and give it to them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>Their eyes were completely opened, they recognized Him, and He disappeared.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>"Was our heart not burning in us," they said to each other, "as He was speaking to us on the road, as He was completely opening the <I>Old Testament</I> writings to us?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>That same hour they got up and returned to Jerusalem. They found the eleven and those who had gathered together with them.</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 24:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>As they were speaking about these things, He stood in the middle of them and said to them, "Peace to you."</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 24:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>Look at My hands and My feet because it is Me, Jesus. Feel Me. Look at Me because a spirit doesn't have a physical body and bones just as you can see that I have."</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 24:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>They were so happy and amazed that they still did not trust their <I>eyes</I>. "What do you have here to eat?" He asked.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>They gave Him part of a cooked fish.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>He took it and ate it in their sight.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>"My very words that I spoke to you," He told them, "while I was together with you were, 'All the things that have been written about Me in the Law of Moses, the Preachers, and Psalms must be accomplished.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>At that time, He completely opened their way of thinking to understand the <I>Old Testament</I> writings.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>"This is how the Old Testament has been written," He told them, "to show that the Anointed King would suffer, that He would come back to life from the dead the third day,</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>that a change of ways for forgiveness of sins would be spoken about publicly based on His name, and that this would head out from Jerusalem and go to all the nations.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:48"></A><SPAN class="verseno">48 </SPAN>You are witnesses of these things.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:49"></A><SPAN class="verseno">49 </SPAN>Look, I am sending My Father's promise out on you. You must be seated in the city until you put on ability from a high place."</P>

<P><A NAME="Luke 24:52"></A><SPAN class="verseno">52 </SPAN>They bowed down to Him and returned to Jerusalem with great happiness.</P>
<P><A NAME="Luke 24:53"></A><SPAN class="verseno">53 </SPAN>Through every situation, they were going onto the temple grounds conferring blessings on God for what He had done.</P>
<TITLE>John 1</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 1:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>The Message was at the beginning, the Message was pointed toward God, and the Message was God.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>This Message was pointed toward God at the beginning.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Everything came to be through <I>the Message</I>, and without <I>the Message</I> not even one thing that has come to be came to be.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>There was life in <I>the Message</I>, and the life was the people's light.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>The light shines in the dark, and the dark doesn't take it down.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>A man came on the scene who was sent out on a mission directly from God. His name was John.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>This John came to be a witness. That way he would tell what he witnessed about the Light so that all might trust through him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>He was not the Light, but his purpose was to tell what he witnessed about the Light.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>The true Light that lights things up for every person was coming into the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN><I>The Message</I> was in the world, the world came to be through <I>the Message</I>, but the world didn't know <I>the Message</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>He went to His own home, and His own people didn't receive Him in.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>But to as many as received Him, to the people trusting in His name, He gave the authority to become God's children.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN><I>They do</I> not <I>become God's children</I> from <I>having the right</I> bloodlines, or from what a physical body wants, or from what a man wants either. No, they are born from God.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>The Message became a physical body and camped among us. We viewed His magnificence, magnificence like that of an only biological child beside the Father, full of generosity and truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>John told what he witnessed about Him. He even yelled it out: "I talked about this before," he said. "The One coming behind me has become in front of me because He was first over me."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>This is true for all of us because we all received generosity upon generosity from His fullness.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Since the law was given through Moses, generosity and truth came through Jesus, the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>No one has seen God at any time. Since that only biological God was in the Father's arms, He recounted <I>to us what He knows about Him</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>The Jewish people in Greater Jerusalem sent out priests and Levites to John to ask him, "Who are you?" This is the witness account that he gave.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>He acknowledged what he had witnessed. He didn't deny it. He acknowledged it. "I am not the Anointed King."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>"So who are you?" they asked. "Are you Elijah?" "I am not," he said. "Are you the Preacher <I>that Moses told about?</I>" "No," he answered.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>So they asked him, "Who are you so that we may give an answer to the people who sent us? What do you say about yourself?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>He was declaring, "I am a voice shouting in the backcountry, 'Make the Master's road straight,' just as Isaiah, the preacher, said" <I>(Isaiah 40:3)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>They had been sent out by the Separatists.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>"So why do you submerge if you are not the Anointed King, or Elijah, or the Preacher?" they asked.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>"I submerge in water," John answered. "There has stood in the middle of you all <I>a Person</I> that you have not seen.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>He is the One coming behind me. I don't deserve to even untie His sandal strap."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>These things happened in Bethany, the Bethany next to the Jordan River where John was submerging people.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>The next day, he saw Jesus coming toward him. "Look," he said, "God's Lamb that takes away the world's sin.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>This is the One I talked about when I said, 'A Man is coming behind me who has become in front of me because He was first over me.'</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>And the thing is not that I had seen Him, but <I>I had seen</I> that God would show Him to Israel. This is why I came submerging in water."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>John told what he witnessed. He said, "I have watched the Spirit step down from heaven as a dove and stay on Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>And the thing is not that I had seen Him, but the One who sent me out here to submerge people in water, that One told me, 'If you ever see the Spirit stepping down and staying on someone, this is the One who submerges people in the Sacred Spirit.'</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>I have seen and told what I witnessed: This is God's Son."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>The next day, John and two of his students had again been standing around.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>He looked at Jesus walking around and said, "Look, God's Lamb!"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>The two students heard what he spoke and followed Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>When Jesus turned around and saw them following Him, He asked them, "What are you looking for?" They said, "Rabbi, where are You staying?" (Rabbi is <I>Hebrew</I>. It is translated as teacher and said instead of teacher.)</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>"Come, and you will see," He told them. So they went and saw where He was staying. They stayed there next to Him that day. It was the 4:00 hour.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>Andrew (Simon Peter's brother) was one person from the two who heard directly from John and followed Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>First, this Andrew found his own brother, Simon, and told him, "We have found the Messiah" (which is <I>Hebrew</I> and translated as Anointed King).</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>Andrew took him to Jesus. After Jesus looked at him, He said, "You are Simon, John's son. You will be called Cephas" (<I>Cephas is Aramaic and</I> is interpreted as Peter <I>or Rock</I>).</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>The next day Jesus wanted to go out into Galilee. He found Philip and told him, "Follow Me."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>Philip was out of Bethsaida, the same city that Andrew and Peter were from.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>Philip found Nathanael and told him, "We have found the One that Moses and the Preachers wrote about. He is Jesus, Joseph's son, the Joseph out of Nazareth."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>"From Nazareth?" Nathanael said to him. "Can anything good be from Nazareth?" "Come and see," Philip told him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>Jesus saw Nathanael coming toward Him and talked about him, "Look, an Israeli that truly has no deception in him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:48"></A><SPAN class="verseno">48 </SPAN>"Where do You know me from?" asked Nathanael. Jesus answered, "Before Philip hollered to you, I saw you under the fig tree."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:49"></A><SPAN class="verseno">49 </SPAN>"Rabbi," responded Nathanael, "You are God's Son. You are Israel's King."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:50"></A><SPAN class="verseno">50 </SPAN>Jesus responded and said, "Do you trust because I told you that I saw you underneath the fig tree? You will see greater things than these."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 1:51"></A><SPAN class="verseno">51 </SPAN>He also told him, "Amen, amen, I tell you, you will see heaven opened and God's angels stepping up into heaven and stepping down from heaven over the Son of the Person. <I>("The Son of the Person" is a generic term Jesus used of Himself. Ezekiel and Daniel were called "son of a person." "Son of a person" is also in Psalm 80:17.)</I></P>
<TITLE>John 2</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 2:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>On the third day <I>after they left the Jordan River</I>, there was a wedding in Cana, Galilee, and Jesus's mother was there.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Jesus and His students were also invited to the wedding.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>When they ran out of wine, Jesus' mother told Him, "They don't have wine."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Jesus told her, "Ma'am, what does this have to do with Me? My hour has not arrived yet."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>His mother told the servants, "Do whatever He tells you."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Six stone water jars were lying there. They each had a capacity of 18 to 27 gallons. They were used to provide water for the Jewish cleansing rituals.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>"Fill the water jars full of water," Jesus told them. They filled them full up to the top.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>"Now ladle some out and carry it to the head waiter." They carried it to him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>The head waiter tasted the water that had become wine and didn't realize where it was from (but the servants who had ladled out the water realized where it was from). The head waiter hollered for the groom</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>and told him, "Every person puts the nice wine out first, and when they are drunk, the lesser wine. You have kept the nice wine until now."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Jesus performed this beginning proof in Cana, Galilee. He showed His magnificence, and His students trusted in Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>After this, He, His mother, His brothers, and His students walked down to Capernaum and stayed there a few days.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>The Passover of the Jewish people was near, and Jesus walked up to Jerusalem.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>He found the people selling cattle, sheep, and doves, and the traders of small change sitting on the temple grounds.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>After making a Roman whip from ropes, He threw all of them off the temple grounds, even the sheep and the cattle. He spilled out the small change of the currency exchangers and overturned the tables.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>"Take these things out of here," He said to the people selling doves. "Don't make My Father's house a house of merchandise."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>His students remembered that the Bible says, "The passion of Your house will eat me up" <I>(Psalm 69:9)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>The Jewish people answered and said, "What proof are You showing us that <I>allows you to</I> do these things?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>"Break down this temple, and in three days I will get it up," answered Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>"This temple took forty-six years to build," said the Jewish people. "And you will get it up in three days?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>But that Jesus was talking about the temple of His body.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>So when He was gotten up from the dead, His students remembered that He had been saying this, and they trusted in the <I>Old Testament</I> writing and in the words that Jesus said.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Since He was in Greater Jerusalem during the Passover, many at the festival trusted in His name <I>and who He is</I> as they watched the proofs that He was doing.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>But Jesus was not trusting Himself to them because of the fact that He knew everyone.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 2:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>He didn't need anyone to tell Him what they knew about a person. You see, He knew what was in the person.</P>
<TITLE>John 3</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 3:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>There was a man from the Separatists named Nicodemus. He was one of the head Jewish people.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>This Nicodemus came to Jesus at night and said to Him, "Rabbi, we realize that You have come from God as a teacher. You see, no one can be doing these proofs that You are doing unless God is with him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>"Amen, amen, I tell you," Jesus responded, "unless someone is born all over again, he cannot see God's monarchy."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Nicodemus said to him, "How can a person be born when he is an old man? He can't get into his mother's belly a second time and be born, can he?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>"Amen, amen, I tell you," Jesus answered, "unless someone is born from water <I>(a physical birth)</I> and spirit <I>(a spiritual birth)</I>, he can't go into God's monarchy.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>The thing that has been born from the physical body is a physical body, and the thing that has been born from the Spirit is a spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>You shouldn't be amazed that I told you, you must be born all over again. <I>God and His monarchy are in the spiritual world. To be a part of the spiritual world, you must be born all over again, this time not from your mother's belly, but from the Spirit.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The Spirit blows where it wants, and you hear its voice, but you don't know where it comes from and where it is making its way back to. This is how everyone is who has been born from the Spirit."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>"How can these things happen like that?" responded Nicodemus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>"You are the teacher of Israel," Jesus answered, "and you don't know these things?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you that what we know, we speak, and what we have seen, we tell that we witnessed it, and you don't receive the account that we give.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>If I told you these things using earthly metaphors and you don't trust, how will you trust if I tell you the heavenly things?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>No one has stepped up into heaven, except the One who stepped down from heaven, the Son of the Person.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>Just as Moses put the snake up high on a stick in the backcountry, so the Son of the Person must be put up high</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>so that everyone who trusts in Him may have life that spans all time.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>You see, this is how God loved the world: He gave His only biological Son so that everyone trusting in Him wouldn't be ruined, but would have life that spans all time.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>God didn't send His Son out into the world to judge the world. No, <I>He sent Him into the world</I> so that He might rescue the world through Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>The person trusting in Him is not judged, but the person not trusting has already been judged because he hasn't trusted in the name of God's only biological Son.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>This judgment is because light has come into the world and people loved the darkness rather than the light. You see, their actions were evil.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Everyone who repeatedly does useless things hates the light and does not come to the light because they don't want their actions to be reprimanded.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>But the person who does the truth, <I>the things God says are true,</I> comes to the light so that it will show him which actions of work that he has worked on are in God."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>After this, Jesus and his students went into the Jewish land. There He was spending time with them and submerging people in the water.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>John also was in Aenon near Salim submerging people because there was a lot of water there. People were showing up and being submerged.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>You see, John hadn't yet been thrown in jail.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>So John's students ended up questioning a Jewish man about cleansing. <I>Jews ritually cleanse themselves by submerging themselves in water. John's submersion came from that practice and now Jesus was also doing it.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>They came to John and told him, "Rabbi, the One who was with you on the other side of the Jordan River--you told what you witnessed about Him--look, He is submerging people and everyone is going to Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>John responded by saying, "A person cannot receive even one thing unless it has been given to him from heaven.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>You yourselves are my witnesses that I said I am not the Anointed King, but that I have been sent out on a mission in front of that one.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>The groom has the bride. But the groom's friend, the one who stands and listens, is happy to hear the groom's voice. So this is my happiness. It is full.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>That Person must grow, but I must be made less.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>The One coming from above is up on top of everything. The one from the earth is from the earth and speaks from the earth. The One coming from heaven is up on top of everything.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>What He has seen and heard, this is what He tells that He witnessed, and no one receives the account that He gives.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>The person who received the witness account that He gives, put a seal on the fact that God is valid.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>You see, the One that God sent out on a mission speaks God's statements. God doesn't give a limited amount of the Spirit to Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>The Father loves the Son and has put everything into His hand.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 3:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>The person trusting in the Son has life that spans all time, but the person not believing the Son won't see life, but God's punishment stays on him."</P>
<TITLE>John 4</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 4:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Jesus knew that the Separatists had heard He was making and submerging more students than John.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>(And yet Jesus Himself was definitely not submerging people, but His students were.)</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>He left Judea and went off again into Galilee,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>but He had to go through Samaria.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>So He went to a city of Samaria called Sychar near the parcel of land that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Jacob's spring was there. Jesus had gotten tired from traveling on the road. So this is how it was that He was seated at the spring. It was around noon.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>A woman from Samaria came to draw out water. "Give Me a drink," Jesus said to her.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>You see, His students had gone off into the city to buy meals.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>"How is it that you, who are Jewish," the Samaritan woman said, "is asking for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?" You see, Jewish people don't associate with Samaritans.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>"If you knew God's free handout," Jesus answered, "and who is saying to you, 'Give Me a drink,' you would ask Him, and He would give you living water."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>"Master," the woman told Him, "You don't even have anything to get water out with, and the well is deep. So where are You getting the living water from?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>You aren't greater than our father Jacob who gave us this well, are You? He, his sons, and his livestock drank from this well."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>"Everyone who drinks from this water will be thirsty again," answered Jesus,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>"but whoever drinks the water that I will give him won't in any way be thirsty for the span of time. But the water that I will give him will become a spring of water in him gushing out into life that spans all time."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>"Master," said the woman, "give me this water so that I won't be thirsty or go through here to draw out <I>water</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>"Make your way back home," He told her. "Holler for your husband, and come here."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>"I don't have a husband," answered the woman. "You are nice to say, 'I don't have a husband.'" Jesus told her.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>"You see, you have had five husbands, and who you have now is not your husband. This that you have stated is valid."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>"Master," said the woman, "I see that You are a preacher.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Our fathers bowed down to God in this mountain, and you all say that the place where everyone must bow down is in Greater Jerusalem."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>"Trust Me, ma'am," Jesus told her, "because an hour is coming when you all won't bow down to the Father in this mountain or in Greater Jerusalem either.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>You bow down to what you have not seen <I>in the Old Testament</I>. We bow down to what we have seen because the rescue plan is from the Jewish people.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>But an hour is coming, and it is now, when the people who truly bow down to the Father will bow down in spirit and truth. You see, the Father is even looking for these types of people, people who are bowing down to Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>God is a spirit, and the people bowing down to Him must be bowing down in spirit and truth."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>"I realize that a messiah is coming," the woman told Him, "the One who is called Anointed King. When that messiah comes, He will announce absolutely everything to us."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>"I, the One speaking to you, am Him," Jesus told her.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>At this time, His students came and were amazed that He was speaking with a woman; however, no one said, "What are You looking for?" or "Why are You speaking with her?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>So the woman left her water jar and went off into the city. In the city, she was saying to the people,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>"Come on. Look, there's a man out at the spring who told me all kinds of things that I did. This isn't the Anointed King, is it?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>They came out of the city and were coming toward Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>In the meantime, the students were asking Him <I>to eat</I> by saying, "Rabbi, eat."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>But Jesus told them, "I have a dinner to eat that you haven't seen."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>So the students were saying to each other, "Someone didn't bring Him something to eat, did they?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>"My food is to do what the One who sent Me wants," Jesus told them, "and to complete His work.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>Don't you say that there is yet a four-month waiting period and then the harvest comes? Look, I tell you, open your eyes, and view the rural areas because they are already white for harvest.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>The person harvesting receives pay and gathers fruit for life that spans all time so that the person who planted the seed may be happy at the same time with the person who harvested it.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>You see, the saying, 'One person plants and another harvests,' is true in this situation.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>I sent you out on a mission to be harvesting what you haven't labored for. Others have labored, and you have come into their labor."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>Many of the Samaritans from that city trusted in Him because of the woman's message as she told what she experienced--"He told me all kinds of things that I did."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>So as soon as the Samaritans came out to see Him, they were asking Him to stay beside them. <I>He did.</I> He stayed there for two days.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>Many more trusted because of His message.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>They also were telling the woman, "We no longer trust because of what you spoke about Him. You see, we ourselves have heard Him, and we realize that this is truly the world's rescuer."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>After the two days, He went out from there into Galilee, <I>but not to Nazareth</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>You see, Jesus Himself told what He experienced, that a preacher doesn't have value in His own hometown.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>So when He went into Galilee, the Galileans accepted Him because they had seen all the things that He did in Greater Jerusalem during the festival. You see, they also went to the festival.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>So again He went to Cana, Galilee where He made the water wine. In Capernaum, there was a certain royal person whose son was in frail health.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>This royal person heard that Jesus had arrived in Galilee from Judea. He went off to where He was and was asking Him to walk down to Capernaum and cure his son. You see, he was going to die.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:48"></A><SPAN class="verseno">48 </SPAN>"If you all don't see proofs and incredible things, you won't in any way trust," Jesus told him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:49"></A><SPAN class="verseno">49 </SPAN>"Master, walk down to Capernaum before my young child dies," said the royal person.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:50"></A><SPAN class="verseno">50 </SPAN>"Travel back," Jesus told him. "Your son is alive." The man trusted the words that Jesus said to him, and traveled back.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:51"></A><SPAN class="verseno">51 </SPAN>When he was already walking down to Capernaum, his slaves met him and told him that his boy is alive.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:52"></A><SPAN class="verseno">52 </SPAN>So he inquired directly from them what hour of the day he got better. "His fever left yesterday in the first hour of the afternoon," they told him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:53"></A><SPAN class="verseno">53 </SPAN>The father knew that it was in that hour that Jesus told him, "Your son is alive." He and his whole house trusted.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 4:54"></A><SPAN class="verseno">54 </SPAN>This was the second proof that Jesus performed as He went again from Judea into Galilee.</P>
<TITLE>John 5</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 5:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>After these things, the Jewish people had a festival. Jesus walked up to Jerusalem.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>In Greater Jerusalem, there is a swimming pool at the sheep <I>gate</I>. Its common name in Hebrew is Bethesda <I>(house of forgiving kindness)</I>. It has five columned shelters. <I>(The Greeks had previously made it an asclepion, a shrine to the Greek god of healing, Asclepius)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>A large number of frail, blind, crippled, and deformed people were lying down in these shelters. [[[They were waiting for the water to shake.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>You see, at certain times an angel was stepping down in the swimming pool and agitating the water. The first person who climbed in after the agitation of the water became well of whatever illness he had.]]]</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>There was a certain person there who had been in his frail condition for thirty-eight years.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Jesus saw this person lying down and knew that he already had been there a long time. "Do you want to become well?" Jesus asked him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>"Master," the frail man answered, "I don't have a person to throw me into the swimming pool when the water is agitated. But as I am going to the pool, someone else steps down into the pool before me."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>"Get up," Jesus told him. "Pick up your mattress, and walk around."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Right away the man became well. He picked up his mattress and was walking around. But that day was a Sabbath.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>So the Jewish people were telling the person who had been healed, "It is a Sabbath. You are not allowed to pick up your mattress on a Sabbath."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>He responded to them by saying, "That Person who made me well told me, 'Pick up your mattress, and walk around.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>"Who is the person who told you to pick up your mattress and walk around?" they asked him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>The one who was cured didn't know who it was. You see, Jesus had slipped off into the crowd that is in that place.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>Later, Jesus found him on the temple grounds. "Look, you have become well," He told him. "Don't be sinning anymore so that something worse won't happen to you."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>That person went off and announced to the Jewish people that Jesus is the One who made him well.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>The Jewish people were pursuing Jesus because of this, because He was doing these things on a Sabbath.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Jesus responded to them, "My Father until now is working. I also am working."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>So the Jewish people were looking to kill Him more because of this, because not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was also calling God His actual Father making Himself equal to God.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>So Jesus responded by telling them, "Amen, amen, I tell you, the Son can't do anything on His own if it isn't something He sees the Father doing. You see, whatever that One does, the Son also does in a similar way.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>The Father is fond of the Son and shows Him all kinds of things that He does. And He will show Him greater actions than these so that you may be amazed.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>You see, even as the Father gets the dead up and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom He wants.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>The Father doesn't even judge anyone, but He has given every judgment to the Son.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>That way everyone may value the Son, just as they value the Father. The person who doesn't value the Son doesn't value the Father, the One who sent Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you that the person hearing My message and trusting the One who sent Me has life that spans all time and doesn't enter into judgment, but has stepped from death to life.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you that an hour is coming, and it is now, when the dead will listen to the Son of God's voice, and the ones who listen will live.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>You see, even as the Father has life in Himself, so also did He give this to the Son: to be having life in Himself.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>And He gave Him the authority to judge because He is the son of a person.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>Don't be amazed at this because an hour is coming in which everyone in the cemetery will hear His voice.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>And they will travel out: The ones who did the good things will stand up and travel to life, but the ones who constantly did the useless things will stand up and face judgment.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>I can't do anything on My own. Just as I hear, I judge. And My judgment is right because I don't look for what I want. I look for what the One who sent Me wants.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>If I am telling what I witness about Myself, My witness account is not valid.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>There is someone else who is a witness about Me, and I have seen that His witness account about Me is valid.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>You have sent people out on a mission to John to find out if he is the Anointed King, and he has told what he witnessed of the truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>I don't receive the witness account that comes directly from a person <I>as solid proof of anything</I>, but I am saying these things so that you might be rescued.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>That man was the burning and shining lamp. You wanted to be excited in his light for about an hour.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>But I have the witness account that is greater than John's. You see, the actions that the Father has given Me to complete, the very actions that I do, they are a witness about Me. They show that the Father has sent Me out on a mission.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>And the Father who sent Me, that Father has told what He witnessed about Me. You haven't heard His voice at any time or seen His visual image either.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>And you don't have His message staying in you because you don't trust this One whom that One sent out on a mission.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>Examine the <I>Old Testament</I> writings because in them it seems to you that you have life that spans all time. Those writings are the ones that tell what they witnessed about Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>And you don't want to come to Me so that you may have life.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>I don't receive magnificence directly from people.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>But I have known you. And you don't have God's love in you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>I have come in My Father's name, and you don't receive Me. If someone else comes in his own name, you will receive that person.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>How can you all trust magnificence that you receive directly from each other and not look for the magnificence that is directly from the only God?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>Don't think that I will level a complaint against you to the Father. The one leveling a complaint against you is Moses, the one you all have anticipated good from.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>You see, if you were trusting Moses, you would be trusting Me. That Moses wrote about Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 5:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>But if you don't trust that Moses' documents, how will you trust My statements?"</P>
<TITLE>John 6</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 6:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>After these things, Jesus went off to the other side of the Sea of Galilee (<I>which is also called the Sea</I> of Tiberias).</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>A big crowd was following Him because they were watching the proofs He was showing when He healed the people in frail health.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Jesus went up into the mountain and was sitting there with His students.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>It would soon be the Passover, the Jewish people's festival.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>So when Jesus looked up and saw that a big crowd was coming toward Him, He asked Philip, "Where can we buy bread so that these people can eat?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>But He was saying this to challenge him. You see, He knew what He was going to do.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>"Ten thousand dollars worth of bread," answered Philip, "is not enough to give each of them a little bit."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>One student from His students, Andrew (Simon Peter's brother), told Him,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>"There's a little boy here who has five loaves of barley bread and two Opsarius <I>(a species of fish)</I>, but what good are these for so many people?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>"Have the people settle down on the ground," said Jesus. There was a lot of grass in that place. So the men (the number was about five thousand) settled down on the ground.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Jesus took the bread, gave thanks, and passed it out to the people reclining on the ground. He did the same thing with the Opsarius. <I>He did this</I> until they had as much as they wanted.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>When they were adequately fed, He told His students, "Gather up the leftover pieces so that nothing is ruined."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>So they gathered the pieces of the five loaves of barley bread that were leftover from the people who had eaten. They filled twelve baskets full.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>When the people saw that He had shown a proof, they were saying, "This truly is the Preacher that Moses said would come into the world."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Jesus knew that they were going to come and take Him by force to make Him king, so He took a back way up into the mountain again alone.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>When evening came, His students walked down to the sea.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>They climbed on board a boat and left to go across the sea to Capernaum. It had already become dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>The sea was wide awake. A strong wind was blowing.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>So having rowed the boat three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking around on the sea and coming close to the boat. They were afraid.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>"It is Me," Jesus told them. "Don't be afraid."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>They were wanting to get Him into the boat. And right away the boat came to the land they were making their way back to.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>The next day the crowd that had been standing on the other side of the Sea <I>of Galilee</I> saw that there was no other small boat except for one and that Jesus did not get into the boat together with His students. His students had left alone.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Other small boats from Tiberias came near the place where they ate the bread after the Master gave thanks.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>So when the crowd saw that Jesus and His students weren't there, they climbed into the small boats and went to Capernaum looking for Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>When they found Him on the other side of the Sea <I>of Galilee</I>, they asked Him, "Rabbi, when did You get here?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>Jesus answered them by saying, "Amen, amen, I tell you, you all aren't looking for Me because you saw proofs <I>that I am from God</I>. No, you are looking for Me because you ate some of the bread and were adequately fed.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>Don't work for the dinner that gets destroyed. Work for the dinner that stays good for <I>life,</I> life that spans all time. The Son of the Person will give it to you. You see, God, the Father, put a seal on this Person."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>"What should we do so that we may work on the things that God wants us to work on?" they asked Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>"God's work is this," answered Jesus, "that you all should trust in the One that One sent out."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>"So what proof are you showing so that we might see it and trust You?" they asked Him. "What is the work you are doing?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>Moses made manna come down from heaven. Our fathers ate the manna that was in the backcountry, just as the Bible says, 'He gave them bread from heaven to eat' <I>(Psalm 78:24)</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>"Amen, amen, I tell you," Jesus told them, "Moses hasn't given you bread from heaven, but My Father is giving you the true bread from heaven.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>You see, God's bread is the Bread stepping down from heaven and giving life to the world."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>So they said to Him, "Master, always give us this bread."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>"I am Life's Bread," Jesus told them. "Anyone who comes to Me won't in any way be hungry, and anyone who trusts in Me won't in any way be thirsty at any time.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>But I say to you that you have even seen Me, and you don't trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>Everything that the Father gives Me will arrive to where I am. And the person who comes to Me, I won't in any way throw out</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>because I haven't stepped down out of heaven so that I may do what I want. No, <I>I have stepped down out of heaven</I> so that I may do what the One who sent Me wants.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>This is what the One who sent Me wants, that of everything that He has given Me, I wouldn't lose any, but that I will get it up during the last day.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>You see, this is what My Father wants, that everyone watching the Son and trusting in Him may have life that spans all time, and that I will get him up during the last day."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>So the Jewish people were grumbling about Him because He said, "I am the Bread that stepped down from heaven."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>"Isn't this Jesus, Joseph's son?" they were saying. "We know His father and mother. How does He now say, 'I have stepped down from heaven?'"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>"Don't grumble to each other," answered Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>"No one is able to come to Me unless the Father, the One who sent Me, draws him. I will get him up during the last day.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>It has been written in the Preachers, 'And all will be taught by God' <I>(Isaiah 54:13)</I>. Everyone who has heard directly from the Father and learned comes to Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>They come to Me because even though they have heard directly from the Father, they haven't seen Him. No one has seen the Father except the One who is directly from God. This One has seen the Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you, the person trusting has life that spans all time.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:48"></A><SPAN class="verseno">48 </SPAN>I am Life's Bread.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:49"></A><SPAN class="verseno">49 </SPAN>Your fathers ate manna in the backcountry and died.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:50"></A><SPAN class="verseno">50 </SPAN>This is the Bread that stepped down from heaven so that anyone might eat from Him and not die.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:51"></A><SPAN class="verseno">51 </SPAN>I am the Living Bread that stepped down from heaven. If anyone eats from this Bread, he will live for the span of time. But the bread is also My physical body that I will give on behalf of the life of the world."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:52"></A><SPAN class="verseno">52 </SPAN>So the Jewish people were arguing with each other. They were saying, "How can this Person give us His physical body to eat?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:53"></A><SPAN class="verseno">53 </SPAN>Jesus told them, "Amen, amen, I tell you, if you don't eat the physical body of the Son of the Person and drink His blood, you don't have life in yourselves.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:54"></A><SPAN class="verseno">54 </SPAN>The person chewing My physical body and drinking My blood has life that spans all time, and I will get him up at the last day.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:55"></A><SPAN class="verseno">55 </SPAN>You see, My physical body is a valid dinner, and My blood is a valid drink.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:56"></A><SPAN class="verseno">56 </SPAN>The person chewing My physical body and drinking My blood stays in Me and I in him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:57"></A><SPAN class="verseno">57 </SPAN>Just as the living Father sent Me out on a mission and I live because of the Father, that person chewing Me also will live because of Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:58"></A><SPAN class="verseno">58 </SPAN>This is the Bread that stepped down from heaven. Unlike how the fathers ate and died, the person chewing this Bread will live for the span of time."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:59"></A><SPAN class="verseno">59 </SPAN>He said these things as He was teaching in a synagogue in Capernaum.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:60"></A><SPAN class="verseno">60 </SPAN>So when many from among His students heard it, they said, "This message is harsh. Who is able to be listening to it?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:61"></A><SPAN class="verseno">61 </SPAN>Realizing that His students were grumbling about this, Jesus asked them, "Are you stumbling on this?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:62"></A><SPAN class="verseno">62 </SPAN>So what if you watch the Son of the Person step up to where He was before?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:63"></A><SPAN class="verseno">63 </SPAN>The spirit is what gives life. The physical body is not a benefit in any way. The statements that I have spoken to you, they are spiritual statements and they are life.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:64"></A><SPAN class="verseno">64 </SPAN>But there are some from among you who don't trust." You see, from the beginning Jesus realized who were the ones not trusting and who was the one who would turn Him in.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:65"></A><SPAN class="verseno">65 </SPAN>He also was saying, "This is why I stated to you that no one is able to come to Me unless it has been given to him from the Father."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:66"></A><SPAN class="verseno">66 </SPAN>From this, many of His students went off to the <I>things they had left</I> behind and no longer walked around with Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:67"></A><SPAN class="verseno">67 </SPAN>"You don't also want to make your way back, do you?" Jesus asked the Twelve.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:68"></A><SPAN class="verseno">68 </SPAN>"Master," Simon Peter answered, "who will we go off to? You have statements of a life that spans all time.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:69"></A><SPAN class="verseno">69 </SPAN>And we have trusted and have known that You are God's Sacred One."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:70"></A><SPAN class="verseno">70 </SPAN>"Didn't I select you, the Twelve," responded Jesus, "and one of you is an accuser?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 6:71"></A><SPAN class="verseno">71 </SPAN>He was talking about Judas (from Kerioth, Simon's son). You see, this man, one from the Twelve, was going to turn Him in.</P>
<TITLE>John 7</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 7:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>After these things, Jesus walked around in Galilee. You see, He didn't want to walk around in Judea because the Jewish people were looking to kill Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>The Jewish people's festival, the Tent-Setting-Up Festival, was near.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>So His brothers told Him, "Walk somewhere else away from here, and make your way back into Judea so that Your students will also see the things that you are doing.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>You see, no one does something in a hidden way and looks for it to be in a clear public statement. If You are going to do these things, do them where all the Jews are gathered, in Jerusalem. Show Yourself to the world."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>You see, His brothers weren't trusting in Him either. <I>They didn't think He knew what He was doing.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>"The right time for Me isn't here yet," Jesus told them, "but the right time for you is always ready.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>The world can't hate you, but it hates Me because I tell what I witness about it, that its actions are evil.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>You all walk up to the festival. I am not walking up to this festival because the right time for Me hasn't come yet."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>After He said these things, He stayed in Galilee.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Since His brothers walked up to the festival, at that time, He also walked up, not publicly, but as if it were in a hidden way.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>So the Jewish people were looking for Him during the festival and were saying, "Where is that Man?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>There was much whispering about Him among the crowds. The people were certainly saying that He is a good man. But others were saying, "No, He isn't. He is misleading the crowd."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>However, no one was speaking with a clear public statement about Him because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>When the festival was already halfway finished, Jesus walked up onto the temple grounds and was teaching.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>So they were amazed. "How does this Man know documents?" they said. "He doesn't have any theological training."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>"My teaching is not Mine," Jesus answered. "It is from the One who sent Me."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>If anyone wants to do what He wants, he will know whether My teaching is from God or I am speaking on My own.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>The person speaking out from himself looks for his own magnificence, but the person looking for the magnificence of the one who sent him, this person is valid, and there is no wrong in him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Hasn't Moses given you the law? And not even one from among you does the law. Why are you looking to kill Me?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>"You have a lesser deity," the crowd responded. "Who is looking to kill You?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Jesus answered by saying, "I did one thing, and everyone is amazed because of this.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers), and during the Sabbath you circumcise a man.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>If someone is circumcised during the Sabbath so that Moses' law won't be broken, why are you nasty to me because I made an entire person well during a Sabbath?</P>
