<P><A NAME="John 7:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Don't judge according to the eyes, but judge the right judgment."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>So some of the Jerusalemites were saying, "Isn't this who they are looking to kill?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>And look, He is speaking with a clear public statement. They aren't saying anything to Him. Perhaps the head people truly know that this is the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>But we have seen where this Man is from. Whenever the Anointed King comes, no one will know where He is from."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>"You have both seen Me and seen where I am from," Jesus yelled as He was teaching on the temple grounds. "And I have not come on My own, but what you have not seen is the True One who sent Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>I have seen Him because I am directly from Him, and that One sent Me out on a mission."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>So they were looking to arrest Him. And yet no one put a hand on Him because His hour had not yet come.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>Many from the crowd trusted in Him. They were saying, "When the Anointed King comes, He won't show more proofs than what this Man has shown, will He?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>The Separatists heard the crowd whispering these things about Him, and the head priests and the Separatists sent their underlings out to arrest Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>"I am still with you for a short time," said Jesus. "And I am making My way back to the One who sent Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>You will look for Me and won't find Me. You won't be able to go where I am."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>So the Jewish people said to themselves, "Where is this Man going to be traveling to that we won't find Him? He's not going to be traveling to <I>the Jews</I> scattered throughout <I>distant</I> Greek-speaking countries and teaching the Greeks, is He?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>What are these words that He said? 'You will look for Me and won't find Me. You won't be able to go where I am.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>During the festival's last day (the big day), Jesus had been standing <I>watching the ceremonies</I>. "If anyone is thirsty," He yelled, "come to Me and drink.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>The person trusting in Me, just as the <I>Old Testament</I> writing said, 'Rivers of living water will flow from his belly.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>(He said this about the Spirit which those who trust in Him were going to be receiving. You see, the Spirit was not there yet because Jesus had not yet been elevated to His place of magnificence.)</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>So people from the crowd who listened to these messages were saying, "Truly this is the Preacher that Moses said would come."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>Others were saying, "This is the Anointed King." But some were saying, "You see, the Anointed King does not come from Galilee, does He?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>Didn't the <I>Old Testament</I> writing say that the Anointed King is from David's seed and comes out of Bethlehem (the village where David was <I>born</I>)?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>So there became a rift in the crowd because of Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>Some from among them were wanting to arrest Him, but no one put their hands on Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>The underlings returned to the head priests and Separatists. "Why didn't you bring Him here?" they asked them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>"No one ever spoke like this Man," answered the underlings.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>"You haven't also been misled, have you?" responded the Separatists.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:48"></A><SPAN class="verseno">48 </SPAN>"None of the head people or Separatists have trusted in Him, have they?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:49"></A><SPAN class="verseno">49 </SPAN>But this crowd that doesn't know the law is cursed."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:50"></A><SPAN class="verseno">50 </SPAN>Nicodemus (the one who went to Jesus before) was one of them. He told them,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:51"></A><SPAN class="verseno">51 </SPAN>"Our law doesn't judge the person unless it first hears directly from him and knows what he does, does it?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:52"></A><SPAN class="verseno">52 </SPAN>"You aren't also from Galilee, are you?" they answered. "Examine the <I>Old Testament</I> writings and you will see that a preacher does not come up from Galilee."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 7:53"></A><SPAN class="verseno">53 </SPAN>[[They each traveled to their houses.</P>
<TITLE>John 8</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 8:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Jesus traveled to the Mount of Olives <I>(a hill just east of Jerusalem)</I> and spent the night there.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>At daybreak again, He showed up on the temple grounds, and the entire group was coming to Him. After He was seated, He was teaching them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>The Old Testament transcribers and the Separatists brought a woman who had been caught cheating on her husband. They stood her up in the middle</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>and told Him, "Teacher, this woman was caught in the very act of cheating on her husband.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>In the law, Moses demanded us to attack these types of women with stones. So what do You say?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>They were saying this to harass Him so that they may have a complaint to level against Him. But Jesus stooped down and wrote in the soil with His finger.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Since <I>they stayed there and</I> kept asking, He stood up straight and told them, "Your first sinless person must throw a stone at her."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>And again He stooped down and wrote in the soil.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>After they heard this, they were leaving one by one beginning with the older ones. He was left there alone with the woman still standing in the middle.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Jesus stood up straight and asked, "Ma'am, where are they? Didn't anyone bring a charge against you?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>"No one, Master," she said. "I don't bring a charge against you either," said Jesus. "Go home, and from now on, don't sin anymore."]] <I>Beginning double brackets are in John 7:53.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>So again Jesus spoke to them. "I am the world's light. The person who follows Me won't in any way walk around in the dark, but He will have life's light."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>So the Separatists told Him, "<I>When You say things like that,</I> You are telling what You witness about Yourself. Your witness account is not valid."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>"Even if I should be telling what I witness about Myself," answered Jesus, "My witness account is valid because I realize where I came from and where I am making My way back to. But you don't know where I come from or where I am making My way back to.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>You judge as the physical body judges, <I>unaware of the spiritual world</I>. I don't judge anyone.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Even if I judge, My judgment is true because I am not alone. <I>The Father</I> who sent Me <I>stands with Me</I>. It is I and the Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>And in your law, it has been written, 'The witness account of two people is valid' <I>(Deuteronomy 17:6; 19:15)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>I am a witness about Myself, and He, the Father who sent Me, is a witness about Me."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>"Where is Your Father?" they were asking Him. Jesus answered, "You don't know Me or My Father either. If you knew Me, you would also know My Father."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>He spoke these statements in the treasury area as He taught on the temple grounds. No one arrested Him because His hour hadn't come yet.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>So He again told them, "I am making My way back to where I came from, and you will look for Me and die in your sin. You can't go to where I am making My way back to."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>So the Jewish people were saying, "He won't kill Himself, will He? Because He says, 'You can't go to where I am making My way back to.'"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>He was also telling them, "You are from below. I am from above. You are from this world. I am not from this world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>This is why I told you, 'You will die in your sins.' You see, if you don't trust that 'I am', you will die in your sins."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN><I>'I am' is a name of God, but it also was commonly used to say 'I am him'. Was Jesus saying that He is God? They didn't know.</I> So they were asking Him, "You, who are you?" "Primarily, what I also am speaking to you," Jesus told them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>"There are many things for Me to speak and judge about you all, but I don't. The One who sent Me is valid and I am speaking these things that I heard directly from Him to the world."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>They didn't know that He was telling them of the Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>So Jesus told them, "When you put the Son of the Person up high <I>(as in 'up high on a cross')</I>, at that time, you will know that 'I am', and I do nothing on My own, but just as the Father taught Me, I am speaking these things.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>The One who sent Me is with Me. He doesn't leave Me and make Me face things alone because I always do the things that He likes."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>As He was speaking these things, many trusted in Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>So Jesus was saying to the Jewish people who had trusted Him, "If you stay in My message, you truly are My students.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>And you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>Some people responded, "We are Abraham's seed and haven't been slaves at any time to anyone. How are you saying, 'You will become free?'"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>"Amen, amen, I tell you," answered Jesus, "that everyone committing a sin is a slave of that sin.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>The slave doesn't stay in the Master's house for the entire span of time. <I>When his time of service is finished, he leaves.</I> But the son stays for the entire span of time.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>So if the Son sets you free, you will really be free.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>I realize that you are Abraham's seed, but you are looking to kill Me because there is no room in you for My message.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>I am speaking what I have seen beside My Father, so you also are doing what you heard beside your father."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>"Our father is Abraham," they responded. "If you were Abraham's children," Jesus told them, "you would be doing the kind of things that Abraham did.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>But now you are looking to kill Me, a person who--I have spoken the truth to you that I heard directly from God. This is something Abraham didn't do.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>You are doing the kind of things that your father did." "We weren't born as a result of sexual sin," they told Him. "We have one Father, God."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>"If God were your Father," Jesus told them, "you would be loving Me. You see, I came out from God, and I have arrived. I didn't come on My own either. That One sent me out on a mission.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>Why don't you know what I am speaking? Because you aren't able to hear My message.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>You are from your father, the Accuser, and you want to do your father's desires. That accuser was a people-killer from the beginning and was not standing in the truth because truth is not in him. Whenever he speaks the lie, he speaks it on his own because he is a liar and its father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>But because I tell the truth, you don't trust Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>Is there even one person from among you who reprimands Me for a sin? No. If I tell the truth, why don't you trust Me?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>The person who is from God listens to God's statements. This is why you don't listen, because you aren't from God."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:48"></A><SPAN class="verseno">48 </SPAN>The Jewish people responded by telling Him, "Don't we put it nicely when we say that you are a Samaritan and you have a lesser deity?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:49"></A><SPAN class="verseno">49 </SPAN>"I don't have a lesser deity," responded Jesus. "I value My Father, and you belittle Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:50"></A><SPAN class="verseno">50 </SPAN>I'm not looking for My own magnificence. My Father is the One looking for it, and He is judging.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:51"></A><SPAN class="verseno">51 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you, if anyone keeps My message, he won't in any way see death for the span of time."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:52"></A><SPAN class="verseno">52 </SPAN>"Now we know that you have a lesser deity," the Jewish people told Him. "Abraham and the preachers died, and You are saying, 'If anyone keeps My message, he won't in any way taste death for the span of time.'</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:53"></A><SPAN class="verseno">53 </SPAN>You are not greater than our father Abraham, someone who is dead, are You? The preachers also died. Who are You making Yourself out to be?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:54"></A><SPAN class="verseno">54 </SPAN>"If I make Myself out to be magnificent," Jesus answered, "My magnificence is nothing. My Father is the One who elevates Me to a place of magnificence. You say that He is your God,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:55"></A><SPAN class="verseno">55 </SPAN>and yet you haven't known Him. But I have seen Him. If I even say that I haven't seen Him, I'll be like you, a liar, but I have seen Him, and I keep His message.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:56"></A><SPAN class="verseno">56 </SPAN>Your father Abraham was excited to see My day. He saw it and was happy."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:57"></A><SPAN class="verseno">57 </SPAN>"You aren't even fifty years old yet," the Jewish people told Him, "and You have seen Abraham?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:58"></A><SPAN class="verseno">58 </SPAN>"Amen, amen, I tell you," Jesus told them, "before <I>it was time</I> for Abraham to come into existence, 'I am'."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 8:59"></A><SPAN class="verseno">59 </SPAN><I>Now it was obvious that Jesus had used 'I am' to say that He is God,</I> so they got stones to throw at Him, but Jesus hid from them and left the temple grounds.</P>
<TITLE>John 9</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 9:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>As He passed by, He saw a man who had been blind since birth.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>"Rabbi," His students asked Him, "who sinned and caused this person to be born blind, this person or his parents?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>"This person didn't sin, and his parents <I>didn't sin</I> either," Jesus answered. "He was born blind so that God might show His work in him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>While it is day, we must work on the things that the One who sent Me wants us to work on. Night is coming when no one can work.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>I am the world's light whenever I am in the world."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>After He said this, He spat on the ground, made mud from the spit, and smeared it on his eyes.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>"Make your way back," He told him, "and wash in Siloam's swimming pool." <I>Siloam is Hebrew and</I> is interpreted as 'having been sent out'. So he went off, washed, and came seeing.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>So his neighbors and the people who had seen him begging before were saying, "Isn't this the one who sits and begs?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Some were saying, "This is him." Others were saying, "No, but he looks like him." That man was saying, "I am him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>"So how were your eyes opened?" they were asking him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>He answered, "The Man, the One they call Jesus, made mud, smeared it on my eyes, and told me, 'Make your way back into Siloam and wash.' So after I went off and washed, I could see."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>"Where is that Man?" they asked him. "I don't know," he said.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>They took the person who used to be blind to the Separatists.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>So again the Separatists were also asking him how he could see. He told them, "He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and now I can see."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>So some of the Separatists were saying, "This Man is not directly from God because He doesn't keep the Sabbath, <I>a day of rest</I>." Others were saying, "How is a sinful person able to be doing these types of proofs?" And there was a rift among them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>So they asked the blind person again, "What do you say about Him because He opened your eyes?" "He is a preacher," he said.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>So the Jewish leaders didn't trust this about him, that he had been blind and that it was only now that he could see, that is, until they hollered for his parents.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>"Is this your son whom you say was born blind?" they asked them. "So how is it that now he can see?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>"We know that this is our son and that he was born blind," his parents answered.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>"But how is it that he can now see? We don't know. Or who opened his eyes? We don't know. Ask him. He is of age. He will speak for himself."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders. You see, the Jewish leaders had already come to the agreement that if anyone acknowledged Him as the Anointed King, he would be excommunicated from the synagogue.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Because of this, his parents said, "He is of age. Ask him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>So they hollered a second time for the man who had been blind and told him, "Give the magnificence to God, not to this Man. We know that this Man is sinful."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>"Whether He is sinful or not, I don't know," that man responded, "but one thing I do know is that I, a blind person, now see."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>"What did He do to you?" they asked him. "How did He open your eyes?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>"I already told you, and you didn't listen," he answered. "Why do you want to listen to it again? You aren't wanting to also become His students, are you?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>They put him down and said, "You are that Man's student, but we are Moses' students.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>We know that God has spoken to Moses, but we don't even know where this Man is from."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>The man responded and said to them, "You see, that is amazing. You don't know where He is from. He opened my eyes!</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>We know that God doesn't listen to sinful people, but if anyone is a God-worshipper and does what He wants, God listens to him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>Throughout the span of time, no one has ever heard of anyone opening the eyes of someone who has been born blind.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>If this Man weren't directly from God, He wouldn't be able to do anything."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>"You were born in sins, every part of you," they responded, "and you are teaching us?" They threw him out.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>When Jesus heard that they threw him out, He found him and said, "Do you trust in the Son of the Person?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>That man answered by asking, "Who is He, Master, so that I might trust in Him?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>"You have both seen Him," Jesus told him, "and the One speaking with you is that One."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>"I trust, Master," he was declaring, and he bowed down to Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>"I came into this world <I>to prepare it</I> for judgment," said Jesus, "so that the people who don't see may see and the seeing people might become blind."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>When some of the Separatists who were with Him heard these things, they said to Him, "We aren't also blind, are we?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 9:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>"If you were being <I>like</I> blind people," Jesus told them, "it might be that you were not having sin. But now you say, 'We see.' Your sin stays."</P>
<TITLE>John 10</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 10:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>"Amen, amen, I tell you, the person who doesn't go through the door when he goes into the sheep's yard but climbs up some other way, that person is a thief and a bandit.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>The one going in through the door is the sheep's shepherd.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>The doorkeeper opens the door to this one, and the sheep listen to his voice. He hollers for his own sheep by name and leads them out.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Whenever he takes all of his own sheep out, he travels in front of them, and the sheep follow him because they know his voice.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>They won't in any way follow another sheep's shepherd. They will run away from him because they don't know the voice of the other sheep's shepherds."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Jesus told them this analogy, but they didn't know what He was speaking to them about.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>So again Jesus said, "Amen, amen, I tell you, I am the sheep's door.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>All the people, as many as came before Me, were thieves and bandits, but the sheep didn't listen to them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>I am the door. If anyone comes in through Me, he will be rescued. And he will go in and out, and find pasture.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>The thief only comes so that he might steal, kill, and ruin. I came so that they may have life and have much more.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I am the Nice Shepherd. The Nice Shepherd gives His soul for the sheep.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>The hired worker isn't even a shepherd and doesn't have his own sheep. When he sees the wolf coming, he leaves the sheep and runs away. The wolf snatches some and scatters the rest.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>He runs away because he is a hired worker and isn't concerned about the sheep.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>I am the Nice Shepherd, I know My sheep, and My sheep know Me,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father. I give My soul for the sheep.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>I also have other sheep that aren't from this yard. It is necessary for Me to lead those sheep too. They will listen to My voice and become one flock, one Shepherd.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>The Father loves Me for giving my soul so that I might get it back again.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>No one takes it away from Me. I give it on My own. I have the authority to give it, and I have the authority to get it back again. <I>There is a demand that gives me this authority.</I> I got this demand directly from My Father."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>A rift again happened among the Jewish people because of these messages.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Many of them were saying, "He has a lesser deity. He's crazy. Why are you listening to Him?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Others were saying, "These are not the statements of someone who has a lesser deity. A lesser deity is not able to open the eyes of blind people, is it?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Then the initiations <I>(Hanukkah)</I> came. There was a storm in Greater Jerusalem,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>and Jesus was walking around in Solomon's Columned Shelter on the temple grounds.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>So the Jewish people surrounded Him. "How long will You keep our soul in suspense?" they were asking Him. "If You are the Anointed King, tell us with a clear public statement."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>"I told you," Jesus answered them, "and you don't trust. The things that I do in My Father's name, these are witnesses about Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>But you don't trust because you aren't from My sheep.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>My sheep listen to My voice, I know them, and they follow Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>And I give them life that spans all time, they won't in any way be ruined for the span of time, and no one will snatch them from My hand.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>My Father who has given them to Me is greater than everyone, and no one can snatch them from the Father's hand.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>I and the Father are one."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>Again the Jewish people hauled up stones so that they might attack Him with them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>"I showed you many nice actions from the Father," responded Jesus. "For which of these are you attacking Me?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>"We aren't attacking You for a nice thing that You did," the Jewish people answered, "but for insulting God and because even though You are a human, You are making Yourself God."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>"Hasn't it been written in your law, 'I said, You are gods?' <I>(Psalm 82:6)</I>," Jesus responded.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>"If He called those people gods, the people God's message came to, and the <I>Old Testament</I> writing can't be undone,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>how are you telling the One the Father made sacred and sent out into the world, 'You are insulting God,' because I said that I am a son of God?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>If I am not doing My Father's actions, don't trust Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>But if I am doing them, even if you don't trust Me, trust the actions so that you may come to know and keep on knowing that the Father is in Me and I am in the Father."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 10:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>They were looking to arrest Him again, and He got away from them.</P>

<TITLE>John 11</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 11:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>There was a certain man who was in frail health. He was Lazarus out of Bethany. He was from the village that Mary and her sister Martha lived in.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Mary was the one who dabbed perfume on the Master and wiped His feet dry with her hair. Her brother Lazarus was in frail health.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>So the sisters sent someone out to Jesus with this message: "Master, look, someone whom You are fond of is in frail health."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>When Jesus heard it, He said, "This frail condition will not end in death. It is for God's magnificence so that God's Son might be elevated to a place of magnificence through it."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Jesus was loving Martha, her sister, and Lazarus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>So since He heard that Lazarus was in frail health, at that time He certainly stayed for two days in the place where He was.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Following that, He told the students, "We may lead the way into Judea again."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>"Rabbi," said the students, "the Jewish people were just now looking to attack You with stones. Are You actually making Your way back there again?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>"Are there not twelve hours in the day?" answered Jesus. "If anyone walks around during the day, he doesn't trip because he sees this world's light.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>But if anyone walks around at night, he trips because he doesn't have the light."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>He said these things, and then He told them, "Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am traveling there so that I might wake him up."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>"Master," the students told Him, "if he has fallen asleep, he will be rescued, <I>and he will get better</I>."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Jesus had made this statement about his death, but those students thought He was talking about dozing off and going to sleep.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>So at that time, Jesus told them with a clear public statement, "Lazarus died,</P>

<P><A NAME="John 11:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>So Thomas (the one called Twin) told his fellow students, "Let's also lead the way so that we can die with Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>When Jesus got there, He found out that he had already been in the burial vault for four days.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Bethany was close to Greater Jerusalem, less than 2 miles away.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Many of the Jewish people had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them concerning their brother.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Martha heard that Jesus was coming, so she went out to meet Him. But Mary was sitting in the house.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>So Martha said to Jesus, "Master, if You were here, my brother wouldn't have died.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>But I realize even now that whatever You ask God for, He will give it to You."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>"Your brother will come back to life again," Jesus told her.</P>

<P><A NAME="John 11:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>"I am the Return Back to Life," Jesus told her, "and the Life. The person trusting in Me, even if he were dead, he will live.</P>

<P><A NAME="John 11:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>After she said this, she left and went back <I>to her house</I>. She got her sister Mary's attention in a way that no one would notice and told her, "The Teacher is nearby and asking for you."</P>

<P><A NAME="John 11:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>So when the Jewish people who were in the house with her and were comforting her saw that Mary quickly got up and left, they followed her thinking that she was making her way back to the burial vault so that she might cry there.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>So as Mary came to where Jesus was, when she saw Him, she fell at His feet. "Master," she said, "if You were here, my brother wouldn't have died."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>So Jesus was stern in His spirit and agitated Himself as He saw her and the Jewish people who came together with her crying.</P>

<P><A NAME="John 11:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>So they took the stone away. Jesus looked up and said, "Father, I thank You for listening to Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>I know that You always listen to Me, but I said this because of the crowd standing around Me, so that they might trust that You sent Me out on a mission."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>After He said these things, He loudly yelled, "Lazarus, come out here."</P>

<P><A NAME="John 11:45"></A><SPAN class="verseno">45 </SPAN>Many of the Jewish people who came with Mary and saw what He did trusted in Him.</P>

<P><A NAME="John 11:49"></A><SPAN class="verseno">49 </SPAN>A certain one from among them, Caiaphas, who was the head priest that year, told them, "You don't know anything.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 11:50"></A><SPAN class="verseno">50 </SPAN>You also aren't considering that it is to your advantage that one person die on behalf of the ethnic group <I>so that</I> the whole nation won't be ruined."</P>

<P><A NAME="John 12:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>There were some Greeks among the people walking up to Jerusalem. They were going there so that they could bow down <I>to God at the temple</I> during the festival.</P>

<P><A NAME="John 12:46"></A><SPAN class="verseno">46 </SPAN>I have come--a light into the world--so that everyone trusting in Me might not stay in the dark.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 12:47"></A><SPAN class="verseno">47 </SPAN>And if anyone listens to My statements and doesn't observe them, I don't judge Him. You see, I didn't come to judge the world. I came to rescue the world.</P>
