<TITLE>John 13</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 13:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Before the Passover Festival, after Jesus had seen that the hour had come for Him to step away from this world and go to the Father, He loved His own people in the world, and He loved them to the conclusion.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>As the feast was happening, the Accuser had already put into Judas' heart (<I>the Judas</I> from Kerioth, Simon's son) to turn Jesus in.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Even though Jesus had seen that the Father had put everything in His hands, that He came out from God, and that He was making His way back to God,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>He got up from the feast, put His robe to the side, and <I>did what the slave is supposed to do</I>. He took a linen towel, and tied it around His waist. </P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>After that, He put water in the large bowl and began to wash the students' feet and wipe them dry with the linen towel that was tied around His waist.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>So when He came to Simon Peter, Simon Peter said to Him, "Master, are You washing my feet?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>"You don't know what I am doing now," answered Jesus. "But you will know after I am done."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>"You won't in any way wash my feet for the span of time," Simon Peter told Him. "If I won't wash you, you have no part in Me," answered Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>"Master," Simon Peter told Him, "not just my feet, but also my hands and head."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>"The person who has taken a bath only needs to wash his feet," Jesus told him. "You are clean, but not all of you."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>You see, He knew the one who would turn Him in. Because of this, He said, "Not all of you are clean."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>So after He washed their feet, picked up His robe, and settled down in His place again, He said to them, "Do you know what I have done to you?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>When you holler at Me, you say 'Teacher' and 'Master', and you are nice to say that. You see, that is what I am.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>So if I, the Master and the Teacher, washed your feet, you are obligated to also be washing each other's feet.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>You see, I demonstrated this to you so that you may also do just as I did to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you, a slave is not greater than his master, and a missionary isn't greater than the one who sent him out either.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>If you know these things, you are blessed if you do them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>I am not talking about all of you. I know who I selected, but <I>I selected him</I> so that the <I>Old Testament</I> writing might be accomplished, 'The one chewing My bread raised up his heel against Me' <I>(Psalm 41:9)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>From now on, I am telling you before it happens so that when it happens, you might trust that I am Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you, the person who receives whoever I sent receives Me. The person who receives Me receives the One who sent Me."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>After Jesus said these things, He was uneasy in His spirit. And He told them what He had witnessed, "Amen, amen, I tell you that one from among you will turn Me in."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>The students were looking at each other, not sure what to think about what He said.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>One student from His students was reclining beside Jesus close to His chest (this was the student that Jesus kept loving).</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>So Simon Peter gestured to this student to inquire who it could be that He is talking about.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>So when that student leaned back like that on Jesus' chest, he said to Him, "Master, who is it?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>"I will dip a piece <I>of bread in the sauce</I> for him and give it to him," Jesus answered. So after He dipped the piece, He took it and gave it to Judas (<I>the Judas</I> from Kerioth, Simon's son).</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>And after He gave him the piece <I>of bread</I>, at that time, the Opponent entered that student. So Jesus told him, "Do what you are doing faster."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>None of the others reclining there knew why He said this to him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>You see, some thought that since Judas had the money box, that Jesus told him, "Buy what we need for the festival," or that he should give something to the poor.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>So after that student took the piece of bread, right away, he left. It was night.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>After he left, Jesus said, "It is time now for the Son of the Person to be elevated to a place of magnificence and for God to also be elevated to a place of magnificence in Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>If God is elevated to a place of magnificence in Him, God will also elevate Him to a place of magnificence in Him, and right away He will elevate Him to a place of magnificence.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>Little children, I will <I>only</I> be with you for yet a little while. You will look for Me, and just as I said to the Jewish people, I am also telling you now: 'You are not able to go to where I am making My way back to.'</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>I am giving you a new demand so that you may also love each other: Love each other just as I loved you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>In this way, everyone will know that you are students studying Me if you have love among each other."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>"Master, where are you making your way back to?" asked Simon Peter. Jesus answered, "You can't follow Me now to where I am making My way back to, but you will follow later."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>"Master, why can't I follow You now?" asked Peter. "I will give my soul for You."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 13:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>"Will you give your soul for Me?" responded Jesus. "Amen, amen, I tell you, a rooster won't in any way crow until you flatly deny Me three times."</P>
<TITLE>John 14</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 14:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>"Your heart must not be uneasy. You trust in God. Also trust in Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>There are many places to stay in My Father's house. If I may not have told you before, <I>I am telling you now</I> that I am traveling there to get a place ready for you all.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And if I travel and get a place ready for you, I am coming again. And I will take you along with Me so that you may also be where I am.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>You know the way to where I am making My way back to."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>"Master, we don't know where You are making Your way back to," Thomas told Him. "How can we know the way?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>"I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life," Jesus told him. "No one goes to the Father except through Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>If you have known Me, you will also know My Father. From now on, you know Him and have seen Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>"Master, show us the Father," Philip told Him, "and it is enough."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>"Have I spent so much time with you, Philip," Jesus told him, "and you haven't known Me? Anyone who has seen Me has seen the Father. How are you saying, 'Show us the Father'?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Don't you trust that I am in the Father, and the Father is in Me? The statements that I tell you, I don't speak them on My own. It is the Father who stays in Me. He is doing His work, <I>His actions</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Trust Me because I am in the Father and the Father is in Me, but if you can't do that, trust Me because of the very actions that I do.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you, the person who trusts in Me, that person will also do the actions that I do, and he will do greater things than these because I am traveling to the Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Whatever you ask in My name <I>and on My behalf</I>, I will do so that the Father might be elevated to a place of magnificence in the Son.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>If you ask Me for anything in My name <I>and on My behalf</I>, I will do it.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>If you love Me, you will keep My demands.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>I will ask the Father, and He will give you another Encourager so that He may be with you for the span of time.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>He is the Spirit of Truth. The world can't receive Him because it does not see or know Him. You know Him because He stays beside you and will be in you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>I will not leave you <I>and make you</I> orphans. I am coming to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>In a little while the world won't see Me anymore, but you will. You will live because I live.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>In that day you will know that I am in My Father, you are in Me, and I in you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>The person who has My demands and keeps them is the one who loves Me. The one who loves Me will be loved by My Father, I will love him, and I will show Myself explicitly to him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Judas (not the one from Kerioth) asked Him, "Master, what has happened that You are going to be showing Yourself explicitly to us and definitely not to the world?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>"If anyone loves Me," answered Jesus, "he will keep My message, My Father will love him, We will come to him, and We will make a place to stay beside him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>The person who doesn't love Me, doesn't keep My messages. And the message that you hear isn't Mine, but the Father's who sent Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>I have spoken these things to you while I am staying beside you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>But that Encourager (the Sacred Spirit that the Father will send in My name <I>and on My behalf</I>) will teach you all kinds of things and will quietly remind you of everything that I said to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>I am leaving peace with you. I am giving you My peace. I am not giving it to you as the world gives it. Your heart must not be uneasy, and it must not be cowardly either.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>You heard Me say that I am making My way back <I>to the Father</I> and coming to you. If you were loving Me, you would be happy that I am traveling to the Father because the Father is greater than Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>And now I have stated it to you before it happens so that when it happens you might trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>I won't speak much to you anymore. You see, the head of the world is coming, and he has nothing in Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 14:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>But <I>the things that are going to happen will happen</I> so that the world might know that I love the Father and I do what the Father demanded Me to do. Get up. Let's lead the way out of here."</P>
<TITLE>John 15</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 15:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>"I am the True Vine, and My Father is the Farmer.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>He takes off every vine branch in Me that doesn't have fruit, and He prunes every vine branch that does have fruit so that it can have more fruit.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>You are already clean because of the message that I have spoken to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>You must stay in Me and I in you. Just as the vine branch can't have fruit if it doesn't stay in the vine, so you also can't have fruit if you don't stay in Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>I am the Vine. You are the vine branches. The one staying in Me and I in him has much fruit because without Me you can't do anything.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>If anyone doesn't stay in Me, he is thrown out as a cut-off vine branch is. <I>A cut-off vine branch</I> shrivels up (they gather them together, they throw them in the fire), and it is burned.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>If you stay in Me and My statements stay in you, you must ask for whatever you want, and it will happen to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>This elevates My Father to a place of magnificence so that you may have much fruit and become students of Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>I loved you just as the Father loved Me. Stay in My love.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>If you keep My demands, you will stay in My love, just as I have kept My Father's demands and I stay in His love.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I have spoken these things to you so that My happiness may be in you and your happiness might be full.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>This is My demand, that you should be loving each other, just as I loved you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>No one has a greater love than this, that someone would give his soul for his friends.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>You are My friends if you do the things that I demand you to do.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>I am no longer saying that you are slaves because a slave isn't aware of what his master is doing, but I have stated that you are My friends because I am letting you know about everything that I heard directly from My Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>You didn't select Me. I selected you and placed you here so that you may make your way back, have fruit, and your fruit stay. That way the Father will give you whatever you ask Him for in My name <I>and on My behalf</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>I am demanding you to do these things so that you may love each other.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>If the world hates you, you know that it has hated Me first over you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>If you were from the world, the world would be fond of its own thing. But because you aren't from the world, but I selected you from the world, the world hates you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>You must remember the message that I told you: 'A slave is not greater than his master.' If they pursued Me, your Master, they also will pursue you. And if they kept My message, they also will keep yours.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>But the people who pursue you will do all these things to you because of My name <I>and who I am</I> and because they don't know the One who sent Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>If I hadn't come and spoken to them, they wouldn't be harboring sin. But now the sham that they put up around their sin <I>to hide it</I> no longer <I>hides it</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>The person hating Me also hates My Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>If I hadn't done what no other person has done among them, they wouldn't be harboring sin. But now they have even seen and hated both Me and My Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>But this is so that the message that has been written in their law might be accomplished, 'They hated Me for nothing' <I>(Psalm 35:19; 69:4)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>I will send the Encourager directly from the Father to you. He is the Spirit of Truth that travels directly out from the Father. When He comes, He will be a witness about Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 15:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>You also are witnesses because you have been with Me from the beginning."</P>
<TITLE>John 16</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 16:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>"I have spoken these things to you all so that you won't stumble.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>They will excommunicate you from the synagogue. An hour is coming when everyone who kills you will think that it is a way to offer up a sacrifice ritual to God.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>They will do these things because they don't know the Father or Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>But I have spoken these things to you so that when their hour comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn't tell you these things at the beginning because I was with you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Now I am making My way back to the One who sent Me, and none of you are asking Me, 'Where are you making Your way back to?'</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>But because I have spoken these things to you, sadness has filled your heart.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>I am telling you the truth. It is to your advantage that I go away. You see, if I don't go away, the Encourager won't come to you. If I travel away, I will send Him to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>When that Encourager comes, He will reprimand the world concerning sin, concerning the right way, and concerning judgment.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>He will certainly reprimand the world concerning sin because they don't trust in Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>But He will also reprimand the world concerning the right way because I am making My way back to the Father and you won't see Me anymore. <I>I won't be here to show which way is the right way. The Encourager will do that.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>He will also reprimand the world concerning judgment because the head of this world has been judged.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>I still have many things to say to you, but you aren't able to haul those things with you now.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>When that Encourager, the Spirit of Truth, comes, He will guide you into every truth. You see, He won't speak on His own, but whatever He will hear He will speak, and as these things come, He will announce them to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>That Encourager will elevate Me to a place of magnificence because He will receive from Me and announce it to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Everything the Father has is Mine. This is why I said that the Encourager receives from Me and will announce it to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>A little bit and you won't see Me anymore, and again a little bit and you will look at Me."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>So some among His students said to each other, "What is this that He is telling us, 'A little bit and you won't see Me, and again a little bit and you will look at Me,' and 'Because I am making My way back to the Father'?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>So they were saying, "What is He saying? What is this 'little bit' thing? We don't know what He is speaking about."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Jesus knew that they were wanting to ask Him about it. "Are you looking with each other," Jesus asked them, "for what I meant when I said, 'A little bit and you won't see Me, and again, a little bit and you will look at Me'?</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Amen, amen, I tell you that you will cry and wail. The world will be happy. You will be sad. But your sadness will turn into happiness.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>When a woman is delivering, she is sad because her hour <I>for labor and delivery</I> has come, <I>and it is hard</I>. But when the young child is born, she doesn't remember the hard part anymore because of the happiness she feels knowing that a human being has been born into the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>So you also certainly have sadness now, but I will see you again. Then your heart will be happy, and no one will take your happiness away from you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>And in that day, you won't ask Me anything. Amen, amen, I tell you, if you ask the Father for anything, He will give it to you in My name <I>and on My behalf</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Up until now you all haven't asked for anything in My name <I>and on My behalf</I>. You must ask and you will receive so that your happiness may be full.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>I have been using analogies when I speak about these things. An hour is coming when I won't speak to you in analogies anymore, but I will report to you with a clear public statement about the Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>In that day, you all will ask for things in My name <I>and on My behalf</I>. I'm not telling you that I'll ask the Father about it for you.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>You see, the Father Himself is fond of you because you have been fond of Me and have trusted that I came directly from God.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>I came directly from the Father and have come into the world. <I>I am making that transition once</I> again, <I>the other way</I>. I am leaving the world and traveling to the Father."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>"Look, now you are speaking in a clear public statement," said His students. "You aren't using any analogies.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>Now we realize that You have seen everything. You don't need anyone to ask You questions <I>because You already know what their questions are</I>. We trust that You came from God."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>"Do you trust now?" responded Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>"Look, an hour is coming, in fact, that hour is here, when you will be scattered. Each of you will go your own way and leave Me alone. And yet I am not alone because the Father is with Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 16:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>I have spoken these things to you so that you may have peace in Me. In the world, you have hard times, but be courageous, I have conquered the world."</P>
<TITLE>John 17</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 17:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Jesus spoke these things and then looked up to the sky. "Father," He said, "the hour has come. Elevate Your Son to a place of magnificence so that the Son might elevate You to a place of magnificence,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>just as You gave Him the authority of every physical body so that He might use everything that You have given Him to give them life that spans all time.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN><I>This life that spans all time is</I> so that they may know You (the only true God) and the One that You sent out on a mission (Jesus, the Anointed King).</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>I elevated You to a place of magnificence on the earth as I completed the work that You gave Me to do.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>And now, You, Father, elevate Me to a place of magnificence next to Yourself with the magnificence that I had next to You before the world existed.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>I showed Your name <I>(who You are)</I> to the people that You gave Me from the world. They were Yours, You gave them to Me, and they have kept Your message.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Now they have known that everything You have given Me is directly from You</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>because the statements that You gave Me I have given to them. They received them, they truly knew that I came directly from You, and they trusted that You sent Me out on this mission.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>My request concerns them. It doesn't concern the world. It concerns the ones that You have given Me because they are for You.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>All My things are Yours and Your things are Mine. I have been elevated to a place of magnificence among Your people.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I won't be in the world anymore. They are in the world, and I am coming to You, Sacred Father. Keep them in Your name <I>(in who You are)</I>, the name that You have given to Me, so that they may be one, just as We <I>are one</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>When I was with them, I was keeping them in Your name <I>(in who You are)</I>, the name that You have given to Me. I guarded them, and not one of them was ruined except ruin's son so that the <I>Old Testament</I> writing might be accomplished.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Now I am coming to You. I am speaking these things in the world so that Your people may have My complete happiness in themselves.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>I have given them Your message, and the world hated them because they aren't from the world, just as I'm not from the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>I'm not asking You to take them from the world, but to keep them from the evil one.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>They aren't from the world, just as I'm not from the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Make them sacred in the truth. Your message is truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Just as You sent Me out on a mission into the world, I also sent them out on a mission into the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>And I make Myself sacred for them so that they themselves may also be made sacred in truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>My request not only concerns these people, but also the people trusting in Me through their message</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>so that all may be one, just as You, Father, are in Me and I in You, so that they also may be in Us, so that the world may trust that You sent Me out on a mission.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>And I have given them the magnificence that You have given Me so that they may be one, just as We are one.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>I in them and You in Me so that they may be complete by being one, so that the world may know that You sent Me out on a mission and You loved them, just as You loved Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Father, what You have given Me is what I want for those people too, that they may be with Me where I am. That way they may see My magnificence that You have given to Me. You have given it to Me because You loved Me before the world was formed.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Father, You do what is right. Even though the world didn't know You, I knew You, and these people knew that You sent Me out on a mission.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 17:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>I let them know Your name <I>and who You are</I>, and I will keep letting them know it so that the love that You loved Me with may be in them and I in them.</P>
<TITLE>John 18</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 18:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>After Jesus said these things, He went out together with His students to the other side of the stormwater basin of the Kidron where there was a garden. He and His students went into <I>the garden</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Judas (the one turning Him in) also knew the place because Jesus had gathered there with His students many times.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>So Judas took the regiment and underlings from the head priests and Separatists and came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Since Jesus knew everything that was going to happen to Him, He went out to meet them. "Who are you looking for?" He asked.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>"Jesus, the Nazarene," they answered. "I am Him," He told them. Judas (the one turning Him in) had also stood with them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>So since He told them, "I am Him," they went off into the things behind them, and fell on the ground.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Again He asked them, "Who are you looking for?" "Jesus, the Nazarene," they said.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>"I told you that I am Him," replied Jesus. "So if you are looking for Me, let these people make their way back."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>He said this to accomplish the words that He had said <I>before</I>, 'I didn't ruin any of these that You have given to Me.'</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Simon Peter pulled out the dagger that he had and struck the head priest's slave. He chopped off his right earlobe. The slave's name was Malchus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>"Put the dagger back into its sheath," said Jesus to Peter. "The Father has given Me this cup to drink. Shouldn't I at least drink it?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>The regiment, the commanding officer, and the Jewish leaders' underlings apprehended Jesus and tied Him up.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>First, they took Him to Annas. You see, Annas was Caiaphas' father-in-law. <I>He had previously been the head priest and still had influence.</I> Caiaphas was that year's head priest.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>It was Caiaphas who was strongly advising the Jewish people that it was to their advantage that one person die instead of the ethnic group.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Simon Peter and another student were following Jesus. That student was known to the head priest, and so he went into the head priest's courtyard together with Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Peter had been standing outside near the door. So the other student (the one known to the head priest) went out, talked to the doorkeeper, and brought Peter in.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>So the doorkeeper, a servant girl, said to Peter, "You aren't also from the students of this Man, are you?" That Peter said, "I am not."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>The slaves and the underlings had been standing there warming themselves around a bed of hot coals that they had made because it was cold. Peter also was standing with them warming himself.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>So the head priest asked Jesus about His students and about His teaching.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>"I have spoken with a clear public statement to the world," answered Jesus. "I always taught in a synagogue and on the temple grounds where all the Jewish people come together. I spoke nothing in a hidden way.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Why do you ask Me? Ask the people who have heard what I spoke to them. Look, these people here know what I said."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>When He said this, one of the underlings who had been standing nearby slapped Jesus. "Are you answering the head priest like this?" he said.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>"If I spoke something bad," answered Jesus, "tell what bad thing you witnessed. If I spoke nicely, why did you hit Me?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>So Annas had Him tied up and sent out to Caiaphas, the head priest.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Simon Peter had been standing and warming himself. So they asked him, "You aren't also from His students, are you?" That Peter denied it and said, "I am not."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>One slave there from the head priest's slaves was related to the slave whose earlobe Peter chopped off. He said, "Didn't I see you in the garden with Him?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>So again Peter denied it. Right away a rooster crowed.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>So they led Jesus out from Caiaphas into the Roman palace. It was morning, and they didn't go into the Roman palace so that they wouldn't be desecrated by it. They wanted to eat the Passover <I>later that day, and they wouldn't have been able to if they had been desecrated</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>So Pilate came outside to them. "What criminal complaint are you bringing against this man?" he declared.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>"If this man wasn't doing anything bad, we wouldn't have turned Him over to you," they answered.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>"You must take Him and judge Him according to your law," Pilate told them. "We are not allowed to kill anyone," said the Jewish leaders to him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>(Jesus had indicated what kind of death He was going to die, <I>that He would die on a cross. That is a Roman punishment, not a Jewish one.</I> Jesus' words were accomplished <I>by the Jewish leaders when they turned Him over to the Roman leader to be killed</I>.)</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>Pilate went into the Roman palace again and hollered for Jesus. "Are You the Jewish people's king?" he asked Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>"Are you asking this on your own, or did others tell you this about Me?" answered Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>"I'm not Jewish, am I?" Pilate replied. "Your nation and the head priests turned You over to me. What did You do?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>"My monarchy isn't from this world," answered Jesus. "If My monarchy were from this world, My underlings would have been struggling to keep Me from being turned over to the Jewish people. But now, My monarchy isn't from here."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>"So aren't You a king?" Pilate asked Him. "You are saying that I am a king," answered Jesus. "I have been born so that I might tell what I witnessed of the truth. I have come into the world for this. Everyone who is from the truth hears My voice."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>"What is truth?" Pilate told Him. Once he said this, he went out again to the Jewish people. "I haven't found even one accusation that He can be charged with," he told them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>"But it is a policy with you that I should dismiss one prisoner to you during the Passover. So is it your intention that I would dismiss the Jewish people's king to you?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 18:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>So they yelled again and said, "Not this Man, but Barabbas." Barabbas was a bandit.</P>
<TITLE>John 19</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 19:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>So at that time Pilate took Jesus and whipped Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>After the soldiers wove an award wreath from thorns, they placed it on His head and threw a purple robe around Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>They were coming to Him and saying, "Happy to meet You, King of the Jewish people." And they were slapping Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Pilate came outside again and told them, "Look, I am bringing Him outside to you so that you might know that I haven't found even one accusation to charge Him with."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>So Jesus came outside wearing the thorny award wreath and the purple robe. Pilate told them, "Look, the Man."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>When the head priests and underlings saw Him, they yelled, "Nail Him to a cross! Nail Him to a cross!" Pilate told them, "You must take Him and nail Him to a cross. You see, I haven't found an accusation to charge Him with."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>"We have a law," responded the Jewish leaders, "and according to our law He ought to die because He made Himself a son of God."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>When Pilate heard these words, he was more fearful.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>He went into the Roman palace again. "Where are You from?" he asked Jesus. But Jesus didn't give him an answer.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>"Are You not speaking to me?" Pilate said to Him. "Don't You realize that I have the authority to dismiss You and I have the authority to nail You to a cross?"</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Jesus answered, "You don't have even one bit of authority against Me unless it had been given to you from above. Because of this, the one who turned Me over to you has a bigger sin."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>From this time on, Pilate was looking for a way to dismiss Him, but the Jewish leaders yelled, "If you dismiss this Man, you aren't Caesar's friend. Everyone who makes himself a king is opposing Caesar."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>So when Pilate heard these words, he took Jesus outside and sat at the judicial bench in a place called "Paved with Stone" (in Hebrew <I>it is called</I> Gabbatha).</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>It was the Passover's preparation day. It was around noon. He said to the Jewish people, "Look, your King."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Those people yelled, "Take Him away! Take Him away! Nail Him to a cross!" Pilate said, "Will I nail your King to a cross?" "We don't have a king except Caesar," answered the head priests.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>So at that time, he turned Him over to the soldiers so that they could nail Him to a cross. They took Jesus along.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>He was hauling His cross as He went out to the place called "Place of a Skull" (in Hebrew it is called Golgotha).</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN><I>This is</I> where they nailed Him to a cross with two others: one on one side and one on the other, but Jesus in the middle.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Pilate also wrote a placard and placed it on the cross: "Jesus, the Nazarene, the Jewish people's king."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Many of the Jewish people read this placard because the place where they nailed Jesus to a cross was near the city and it had been written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>The Jewish people's head priests were telling Pilate, "Don't write, 'The Jewish people's king,' but 'That Man said, I am a king of the Jewish people'."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Pilate answered, "What I have written, I have written."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>When the soldiers nailed Jesus to the cross, they took His clothes and divided them into four piles, one pile for each soldier. His long undershirt was left over. It didn't have any seams. It had been woven from the top throughout the whole piece.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>"We shouldn't tear it up," they told each other. "We should throw dice to decide who will get it." This is what the <I>Old Testament</I> writing said would be accomplished, "They divided up my clothes for themselves and threw dice on my garment" <I>(Psalm 22:18)</I>. The soldiers certainly did this.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>His mother, His mother's sister, Mary (Clopas' wife), and Mary (the Magdalene) had stood beside Jesus' cross.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>So when Jesus saw His mother and the student that He kept loving standing nearby, He said to His mother, "Ma'am, look, your son."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>After that He told the student, "Look, your mother." And within that hour, the student took her to his own <I>place</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>After this, when Jesus had seen that all things had already been finished, He said, "I am thirsty," to complete the <I>Old Testament</I> writing <I>in Psalm 69:21</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>A container full of sour wine was lying there. So they put a sponge full of the sour wine around a hyssop stick and brought it up to His mouth.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>After Jesus took the sour wine, He said, "It has been finished." He put His head down and gave up His spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>Since that day was a preparation day <I>(the day before a Sabbath that is spent preparing food and setting up for the next day, a day of rest)</I>, so that the bodies wouldn't stay on the cross during the Sabbath (you see, the day of that Sabbath was big), the Jewish leaders asked Pilate to break their legs and take them down.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>So the soldiers went and certainly broke the legs of the first man and the other man that were nailed to the crosses together with Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>But when they came up to Jesus, since they saw that He had already died, they didn't break His legs.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>But one of the soldiers stabbed Him in the side with a spear, and right away blood and water came out.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>The one who has seen it has told what he witnessed, and his witness account is true. That person knows that the things that he is saying are valid. He is saying them so that you also might trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>You see, these things happened so that what the <I>Old Testament</I> writing says, might be accomplished: "None of his bones will be crushed" <I>(Exodus 12:46 and Psalm 34:20)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>And again a different <I>Old Testament</I> writing says, "They will look at a person that they impaled" <I>(Zechariah 12:10)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>After these things, Joseph from Arimathaea asked Pilate if he could take Jesus' body. Joseph was a student of Jesus, but he had stayed hidden because he was afraid of the Jewish leaders. Pilate gave him permission. Joseph went and took His body.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>Nicodemus (the one who came to Jesus the first time at night) also came. He brought a mixture of about seventy-five pounds of myrrh <I>(an expensive fragrant resin)</I> and aloe <I>(another fragrant resin)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>They took Jesus' body and bound it with linen strips with the fragrant resins. They followed the Jewish custom for preparing a corpse for burial.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>There was a garden at the place where they nailed Him to a cross. In the garden, there was a new burial vault that no one had been placed in yet.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 19:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>They put Jesus there because it was the Jewish people's preparation day and because the burial vault was near.</P>
<TITLE>John 20</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 20:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>On Day One <I>(which is Sunday)</I> after the Sabbaths, Mary (the Magdalene) came to the burial vault in the morning while it was still dark and saw that the stone had been taken away from the burial vault's entrance.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>So she ran off and went to Simon Peter and the other student whom Jesus kept being fond of. "They took the Master from the burial vault," she told them, "and we don't know where they put Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>So Peter and the other student left and were going to the burial vault.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>The two were both running. The other student ran ahead faster than Peter and came to the burial vault first.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>When he stooped and peered in, he saw the linen strips lying there, and yet he didn't go in.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Simon Peter came following him. He went into the burial vault. He also saw the linen strips lying there.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>The towel that was on His head wasn't lying with the linen strips. It was separate from them. It had been wound up into one place.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>So at that time, the other student, the one who came first, also went into the burial vault. He looked and trusted. <I>He didn't know what had happened, but he trusted that whatever it was, it was something God had done.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>You see, they didn't yet realize that the <I>Old Testament</I> writing says He must come back to life from the dead.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>So the students again went off to <I>where</I> they <I>were staying</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>But Mary had stood outside facing the burial vault crying. As she was crying, she stooped, peered into the burial vault,</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>and saw two angels in white sitting inside. One was toward the head and one was toward the feet of where Jesus' body had been lying.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Those angels said to her, "Ma'am, why are you crying?" "Because they took my Master away," she told them, "and I don't know where they put Him."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>After she said these things, she turned to look behind her and saw Jesus who had been standing there. She didn't realize that it was Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>"Ma'am, why are you crying?" asked Jesus. "Who are you looking for?" That Mary thought that He was the gardener and so she said to Him, "Master, if you hauled Him off, tell me where you put Him, and I will take Him away."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>"Mary," Jesus said to her. When that Mary turned around, she said to Him in Hebrew, "Rabboni" <I>(which means Great Rabbi). Rabboni</I> is said in place of teacher.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>"Don't touch Me," Jesus told her. "You see, I haven't stepped up to the Father yet. Travel off to My brothers, and tell them I am stepping up to My Father, your Father, My God, and your God."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Mary (the Magdalene) went and reported it to the students. "I have seen the Master," she said. She also told them the things that He had said to her.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>In the evening of that day, Day One <I>(which is Sunday)</I> after the Sabbaths, the students had closed up the doors where they were because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders. Jesus went and stood in the middle of the room. "Peace to you," He told them.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>After He said this, He showed His hands and side to them. The students were happy when they saw the Master.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>"Peace to you," Jesus again told them. "Just as the Father has sent Me out on a mission, I am also sending you."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>When He said this, He puffed on them. "Receive the Sacred Spirit," He said.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>"If you forgive anyone's sins, they are forgiven to them. If you hold on to anyone's sins, they are held on to."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Thomas, one from the Twelve, the one called Twin, was not with them when Jesus came.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>So the other students were telling him, "We have seen the Master." But Thomas told them, "Unless I see the shape of the spikes in His hands, put my finger into the shape of the spikes, and put my hand into His side, I won't in any way trust."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>After eight days, His students were again inside with the doors closed. This time Thomas was with them. Jesus went, stood in the middle of the room, and said, "Peace to you."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>After that He told Thomas, "Bring your finger here, and see My hands. And bring your hand and put it into My side. Don't become someone who won't trust, but become someone who trusts."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>"My Master and My God," responded Thomas.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>"You have trusted," Jesus told him, "because you have seen Me. The people who trust when they can't see are blessed."</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>There certainly are many other proofs that Jesus did in front of His students that haven't been written in this scroll.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 20:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>These things have been written so that you might trust that Jesus is the Anointed King, the Son of God, and so that as you trust, you may have life in His name <I>(in who He is)</I>.</P>
<TITLE>John 21</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="John 21:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>After these things, Jesus showed Himself again to His students on <I>the Sea of Galilee (which is also called</I> the Sea of Tiberias). This is how He showed Himself.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 21:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Simon Peter, Thomas (the one called Twin), Nathanael (the one from Cana, Galilee), Zebedee's sons, and two other students were together at the same place.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 21:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>"I am making my way back to fishing," Simon Peter told them. "We're going with you too," they told him. They went out, climbed on board the boat, and caught nothing that night.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 21:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>When it already had become morning, Jesus stood on the beach. However, the students didn't realize that it was Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 21:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>So Jesus said to them, "Young children, you don't have anything for Me to eat with My bread, do you?" "No," they answered.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 21:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>"Throw the net from the boat into the right sections," Jesus told them, "and you'll find some." So they threw it, and they captured such a large number of fish that they weren't having the strength to pull it <I>back into the boat</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 21:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>That student that Jesus kept loving told Peter, "It's the Master." When Simon Peter heard that it was the Master, he tied a jacket around himself (you see, he only had an undershirt on), and threw himself into the sea.</P>
<P><A NAME="John 21:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The other students came to shore in the small boat dragging the net of fish. You see, they weren't a long way away from land, only about 300 feet away. </P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 3:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Peter and John were walking up to the temple grounds at the hour of prayer, 3 p.m.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 3:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>There was a certain man who had been crippled <I>since he came</I> out of his mother's belly. <P><A NAME="Acts 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>While he was holding on to Peter and John, the entire group ran together to where they were at the columned shelter called Solomon's. They were puzzled.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 3:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>And now, brothers, I realize that because you were not aware of what was going on, you repeatedly did exactly what your head people also did.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 3:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>This is how God accomplished what He previously proclaimed through the mouth of all the preachers: that His Anointed King would suffer.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 3:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Moses certainly said, 'The Master, your God, will stand a preacher up for you from your brothers as me. You will listen to Him and to all the things that He speaks to you, whatever they might be.</P>

<TITLE>Acts 4</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Acts 4:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>As they were speaking to the group, the priests, the captain of the temple grounds, and the Sadducees stood over them.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 4:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>On the next day, the head people, the older men, and their Old Testament transcribers happened to be gathered together in Jerusalem.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 4:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>As they watched the clear public statement of Peter and John, and when they took down that they were uneducated and lower-class people, they were amazed and were recognizing them because they were together with Jesus.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 4:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>But when Peter and John responded, they told them, "Whether it is right in the sight of God to be listening to you rather than God, you must judge.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 4:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>After they threatened them more, they dismissed them. They couldn't find a way to curtail them because of the group. Everyone was praising God's magnificence for what had happened.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 4:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>You see, the man that had experienced this miraculous proof of the cure was more than forty years old. <I>He had been crippled that long and many people had known him for a long time.</I></P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 4:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>The heart and soul of the large number of people who trusted were one. And not even one person was saying that any of the things he had were his own, but they shared absolutely everything that they had.</P>

<TITLE>Acts 5</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>A certain man named Ananias together with his wife, Sapphira, sold property <I>that he had given to the group</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>and secretly kept a certain part of the money for himself. His wife was also aware of it. He brought a certain amount and placed it at the missionaries' feet.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>But Peter said, "Ananias, how was the Opponent able to fill your heart with this idea of lying to the Sacred Spirit and secretly keeping part of the parcel of land's money?</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>As it remained, wasn't it remaining with you <I>(or in other words, while you owned it, wasn't it up to you what happened to it)?</I> And when it was put up for sale, it was under your authority. What is this thing that you placed in your heart? You didn't lie to people. You lied to God."</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>As Ananias heard these words, he fell down and stopped breathing. A great fear came on everyone listening.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>The younger men got up, wrapped up his body, carried it out, and put it in a burial vault.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>There happened to be an interval of about three hours, and his wife came in. She didn't know what had happened.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Peter replied to her, "Tell me if you gave the parcel of land away for this amount." "Yes," she said, "for that amount."</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>"How is it," Peter said to her, "that you harmoniously agreed to harass the Master's Spirit? Look, the feet of the people who buried your husband are at the door. And they will carry you out."</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>At once, she fell down next to his feet and stopped breathing. When the young lads came in, they found her dead. They carried her out and put her in the burial vault facing her husband.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>A great fear came on the whole assembly and on all the people who heard these things.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Many proofs and incredible things were happening in the group through the missionaries' hands, and absolutely everyone was unanimous in Solomon's Columned Shelter.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>None of the rest of the students dared to join the missionaries. Instead, the group was making them great.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>More were trusting and being added to the Master, large numbers of both men and women.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>They were even carrying the frail out into the plazas and placing them on cots and mattresses so that as Peter went by, his shadow might just fall on some of them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Even the large number of cities around there were coming together to Jerusalem carrying people in frail health and people crowded by spirits that are not clean. Every single one was healed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>When the head priest and all the people together with him (the sect made up of the Sadducees) got up, they were full of hostile passion.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>They put their hands on the missionaries and placed them in a public holding cell.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>That night the Master's angel opened the jail's doors and led them out.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>"Travel back to the temple grounds," he said. "Stand up and speak to the group. Tell them all the statements of this life."</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>After hearing this, they went onto the temple grounds just as the sun was about to come up and were teaching. When the head priest and the people together with him showed up to the council hall, they called the council and all the senate of Israel's sons together and sent <I>underlings</I> out to the prison to bring the missionaries there.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>When the underlings showed up to the jail, they didn't find them there. They returned and reported it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>"We found that the prison had been securely locked up," they said, "and that the jailers were standing at the doors. But when we opened it up, we found no one inside."</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>Hearing these words, both the captain of the temple grounds and the head priests were dumbfounded about what happened.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>But then someone showed up and reported to them, "Look, the men that you put in jail are on the temple grounds. They have been standing there and are teaching the group."</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>At that time, the captain went off together with the underlings and brought them back without force. You see, they were afraid of the group. They didn't want to be attacked with stones.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>When they brought them in, they stood in the council. The head priest asked them,</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 5:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>You see, before these days, Theudas stood up saying that he was somebody. A number of men, about four hundred, gravitated toward him. He was executed, and all who were being persuaded by him dissipated and became nothing.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>After this, Judas, the Galilean, stood up in the days of the registration. He <I>convinced</I> a group to back off <I>and follow</I> behind him. That one ruined himself, and all who were being persuaded by him dispersed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 5:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>And the things happening now, I tell you, back off from these people and leave them alone because if these people's intentions or this work is from people, it will be torn down.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 7:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>"<I>Tell us,</I> if this is how these things are," said the head priest.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Stephen was declaring, "Men, brothers and fathers, listen. Our father Abraham saw the God of magnificence as he was in Mesopotamia <I>(an area within the Tigris/Euphrates river system primarily in Iraq)</I> before he lived in Haran <I>(a city in southeastern Turkey)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And He said to him, 'Leave your land and your relatives, and come here into the land that I will show you.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Then he left the land of the Chaldeans <I>(in southern Mesopotamia)</I> and lived in Haran. From there, after his father died, God resettled him in this land that you now live in.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>He didn't give him an inheritance in it, not even one footstep. He promised to give it to him for a permanent possession and to his seed <I>(his descendants)</I> after him. At that time, he didn't have a child.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>God spoke like this: that for four hundred years his seed <I>(his descendants)</I> would be a foreign resident in land belonging to others, and they would make <I>his seed</I> a slave and do bad to it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>God said, 'I will judge whatever nation they will be slaves to. And after these things, they will come out and minister to Me in this place.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>He offered him a <I>verbal</I> deal <I>and he accepted it through</I> circumcision. So he fathered Isaac, and he circumcised him on his eighth day. Isaac <I>did the same thing to</I> Jacob. And Jacob <I>did the same thing to his sons,</I> the twelve head fathers.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>When the head fathers got mad at Joseph, they gave him away to Egypt, and God was with him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>He took him out of all his hard times and gave him generosity and insight directly in front of Pharaoh, the king of Egypt. He put him in charge as a leader over Egypt and over his whole house. </P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>But a famine went through all of Egypt and Palestine. It was a very hard time. Our fathers couldn't find any feed for their cattle.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>When Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent our fathers off the first <I>time</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>During their second <I>trip to Egypt</I>, Joseph revealed himself to his brothers, and Joseph's family ended up being shown to Pharaoh.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>Joseph sent his brothers out with supplies and wagons and summoned his father Jacob and all of the relatives. <I>There were seventy-five of them,</I> seventy-five souls.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Jacob walked down to Egypt, and he and our fathers passed away.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>They transferred their corpses to Shechem <I>(which was back in the promised land)</I> and placed them in the grave that Abraham purchased with a certain amount of silver directly from Emmor's sons in Shechem.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>As the time that God acknowledged to Abraham in His promise <I>(four hundred years)</I> was coming near, the ethnic group grew and increased in Egypt</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>till a different king stood up over Egypt who didn't know Joseph.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>This king swindled our family and did a bad thing to our fathers when he made their babies be put out <I>in the river</I> so that they wouldn't survive.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>In this period, Moses was born and he was a well-behaved <I>baby</I> to God. He was raised three months in his father's house.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>When he was placed out <I>in the river</I>, Pharaoh's daughter took him up and raised him herself for a son.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Moses was disciplined in all of the insight <I>(the science and technology)</I> of the Egyptians. He was competent with words and with his actions.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>As he accomplished the <I>first</I> forty-year period <I>of his life, the idea</I> stepped up in his heart to keep an eye on his brothers, the sons of Israel.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>When he saw someone being hurt, he fended for him and retaliated against the Egyptian. He struck the Egyptian who was oppressing him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>He had been assuming that his brothers understood that God was going to rescue them through his hand, but the <I>brothers</I> didn't understand that.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>And on the following day, he appeared as two of them were arguing. He was driving them together into peace. 'Men, you are brothers,' he said. 'Why are you hurting each other?'</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>The one who was hurting the <I>brother</I> near him pushed him away. 'Who put you in charge,' he said. 'Who made you a head person and referee over us?</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>Are you wanting to execute me the way you executed the Egyptian yesterday?'</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>Because of these words, Moses ran away and became a foreign resident in the land of Midian where he fathered two sons.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 7:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>When he accomplished <I>another</I> forty years <I>of his life</I>, an angel appeared to him in the backcountry of Mount Sinai in a blaze of fire in a bush.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 23:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>So according to what had been specifically arranged with them, the soldiers certainly picked up Paul and took him through the night to Antipatris <I>(a town about 30 miles from Jerusalem and about halfway to Caesarea)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 23:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>On the next day they allowed the horsemen to go off <I>to Caesarea</I> together with him, and they returned to the barracks.</P>

<TITLE>Acts 25</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Acts 25:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>So Festus stepped <I>into his role</I> over the province <I>in Caesarea</I>. After three days he walked up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 25:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>So Festus certainly responded that Paul would be kept at Caesarea, but that he himself was going to be traveling out quickly.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 25:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>"So when the capable people among you walk down together," he declared, "if there is anything out of place in the man, they must level a complaint against him."</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 25:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>"Having stood before the judicial bench of Caesar," said Paul, "I am where I need to be judged. I did nothing wrong to Jewish people as you also correctly understand more nicely now.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 25:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>So if I certainly do what is wrong and <I>if</I> I have repeatedly done something deserving of death, I do not refuse to die, but if nothing exists of the things these people level against me, no one is able to give me to them as an act of generosity. <P><A NAME="Acts 25:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>I answered them that it is not a custom with Romans to give any person as an act of generosity before the defendant may even have the complainants right in front of his face and he may be given a chance to defend himself concerning the charge.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 25:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>So after they came here together, I did not make even one delay. The next day when I was seated on the judicial bench, I gave the order for the man to be brought in.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 25:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>When the complainants were stood up, they were not even bringing one accusation about him of evil things that I suspected.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 25:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Since I wasn't sure what to think about their questioning of these things, I was asking if he intends to be traveling to Jerusalem and there to be judged concerning these things.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 25:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>But when Paul called on being kept for the scrutiny of The Worshipped One, I gave the order for him to be kept until I will send him up to Caesar."</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 25:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>I took down that he had repeatedly done nothing deserving of death, but when this man himself called on The Worshipped One, I decided to send him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 25:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>I don't have anything certain to write to the master about him. <P><A NAME="Acts 26:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>So certainly all the Jewish people realize that my way of life from my youth up, <I>my way of life</I> out from the beginning, happened in my nation and in Greater Jerusalem.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 26:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>They know me from before, from the top, if they want to tell what they were a witness to: that I lived aligned with the strictest sect of our religion, a Separatist.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 26:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Our twelve family lines minister in intensity night and day for this <I>anticipation</I> and they anticipate to make it <I>to a time when God will bring their dead bodies back to life</I>. It is about this same anticipation, King, that the Jewish people brought this charge against me.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 26:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>I even did them in Greater Jerusalem. Also after receiving authority directly from the head priests, I locked many of the sacred people up in jails and threw down my pebble <I>as a vote against them</I> as they were being executed.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 26:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>After we all fell down to the ground, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew dialect, 'Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting Me? Isn't it hard for you to kick against cattle prods?'</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 26:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>'Who are you, Master?' I said. 'I am Jesus,' said the Master, 'that you persecute.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 26:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Get up and stand on your feet. You see, the reason I was seen by you was so that I could ordain you beforehand as an underling and a witness both of when you saw Me and when you will see Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 26:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>As I take you out of the ethnic group and the non-Jews, I am sending you out on a mission to them</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 26:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>The king, the leader, Bernice, and the people sitting together with them got up.</P>

<TITLE>Acts 27</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Since it was decided that they would sail us off to Italy, they were turning both Paul and some different inmates over to a lieutenant named Julius. He was in The Worshipped One's <I>(Caesar's)</I> regiment.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>After he climbed up on board an Adramyttium boat <I>(a boat made in Adramyttium, a city on the northwestern coast of Turkey)</I> that was going to be sailing to places along Western Turkey, we took off. A traveling companion of Paul, Aristarchus (a Thessalonian Macedonian), was together with us.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>On a different day, we landed at Sidon <I>(70 miles north of Caesarea)</I>. Julius behaved benevolently to Paul and gave him permission to travel to his friends and obtain care.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>From there, we set sail and sailed under Cyprus, <I>on the sheltered side,</I> because the wind was blowing against us.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>After sailing across the deep part along Cilicia <I>(the southeastern coast of Turkey)</I> and Pamphylia <I>(the southern coast of Turkey)</I>, we went down to Myra, Lycia <I>(a city on the southern coast of Turkey)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>There the lieutenant found an Alexandrian boat <I>(a boat made in Alexandria, a city in Egypt on the western edge of the Nile River Delta)</I> sailing to Italy and boarded us onto it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>We were sailing slowly for an adequate amount of days.
