<P><A NAME="Acts 27:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>And since it was taking a lot of effort for us to pass by it, we went to a certain place called Nice Harbors that was near Lasea City <I>(on the southern coast of Crete)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>An adequate amount of time had elapsed and the voyage was already hazardous because even the time of the Fast <I>(Yom Kippur, in September or October)</I> had already gone by. So Paul was suggesting</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>and telling them, "Men, I see that there is going to be injury and much loss in <I>the next part of our</I> voyage, not only loss of the load and the boat, but also of our souls."</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>But the lieutenant was being persuaded by the helmsman and the shipowner rather than by what Paul said.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>The majority of them were set in their intention to set sail from there because the harbor was not suitable for spending the storm season in it. Their intention was to somehow be able to make it <I>to the other side of the island</I> to Phoenix and spend the storm season in a harbor of Crete facing <I>northeast and southeast which is downwind of</I> Lips <I>(the southwest wind)</I> and Choros <I>(the northwest wind)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>When the wind softly blew from the south, their plan seemed to have merit, so they took off and were passing by Crete closer than usual.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>But not very long after that, a hurricane-like wind violently blew down from the <I>east-northeast. It was</I> called Euros <I>(the east wind)</I> Aquilo <I>(the northeast wind)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>It seized the boat, and the boat wasn't able to face into the wind. So we gave up, and the wind was carrying us off.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>After running under a certain small island called Clauda <I>(which blocked some of the wind for a while)</I>, with a lot of effort, we were strong enough to pull up the dinghy and secure it to the boat.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>After it was taken up, they were using things, <I>like ropes and chains,</I> to help tie up the underside of the boat. They were afraid of falling into the Syrtis <I>Major (the Gulf of Sidra located off the northern coast of Africa) and running aground on the vast constantly shifting beds of sand there.</I> So they lowered the gear on the mast, but they were still being driven along.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Since we were in a terrible storm, on the next day they were throwing things out.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>And on the third day, they tossed the boat's furniture out with their own hands.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>When both the sun and the constellations didn't shine for several days and it was obvious that this was more than a small storm bearing down on us, for the rest of the time, any anticipation of us being rescued was being taken away all around us.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>When it had been a long time since anyone had eaten, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, "It was certainly necessary for you who were loyal to me, O men, not to take off from Crete and gain this injury and loss.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>And now I suggest that you cheer up. You see, there won't be even one casualty of a soul among you other than the boat.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>An angel from the God that I belong to and that I minister to stood by me last night.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>He said, 'Don't be afraid, Paul. It is necessary for you to stand up next to Caesar and, look, as an act of generosity, God has given you all the people sailing with you.'</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>For this reason, cheer up, men. You see, I trust God that this is how it will be: it will be aligned with the way that the angel has spoken to me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>But it is necessary for us to run ashore on a certain island."</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>On the fourteenth night of us being carried along <I>by the wind</I> in the Adriatic Sea, throughout the middle of the night the crewmen were suspecting that some land was approaching them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>When they measured the depth <I>of the water</I>, they found it to be twenty fathoms <I>(about 120 feet) deep. A fathom is the span of a man's outstretched arms.</I> After a <I>little</I> bit <I>of time</I> went by, they measured the depth again and found it to be fifteen fathoms <I>(about 90 feet) deep</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>They were afraid that we might run ashore somewhere along rugged terrain, so they put down four anchors from the back of the boat and were wishing for it to become day.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>The crewmen were looking to escape from the boat. So they were lowering the dinghy into the sea acting as if they were going to be putting anchors out from the front of the boat.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>"If these people don't stay in the boat," Paul said to the lieutenant and the soldiers, "you can't be rescued."</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:32"></A><SPAN class="verseno">32 </SPAN>Then the soldiers chopped off the ropes of the dinghy and allowed it to fall off.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:33"></A><SPAN class="verseno">33 </SPAN>From then til day was about to come, Paul was encouraging absolutely everyone to take a share of the food, saying, "Today is the fourteenth day that we have expected this to end. You are thoroughly finishing the day without eating any grain. You haven't taken in anything.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:34"></A><SPAN class="verseno">34 </SPAN>For this reason, I encourage you to take a meal with me. You see, this will strengthen you for your rescue. Not even one of you will lose a hair from your head."</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:35"></A><SPAN class="verseno">35 </SPAN>After he said these things, he took bread and thanked God in the sight of everyone. He split it and began to eat.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:36"></A><SPAN class="verseno">36 </SPAN>Everyone cheered up and also took in a meal.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:37"></A><SPAN class="verseno">37 </SPAN>We were all the souls on the boat, two hundred seventy-six.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:38"></A><SPAN class="verseno">38 </SPAN>After they were stuffed from the meal, they were lightening the boat, throwing the grain out into the sea.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:39"></A><SPAN class="verseno">39 </SPAN>When it became day, they didn't recognize the land, but they were taking a close look at a certain bay that had a beach. They were advising that if they were able, they should push the boat out into it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:40"></A><SPAN class="verseno">40 </SPAN>They released all the anchors around the boat and were allowing the anchors to remain in the sea. <P><A NAME="Acts 27:41"></A><SPAN class="verseno">41 </SPAN>When they were swept into a place where two currents meet <I>forming a shallow sandbank</I>, they ran the ship aground. The front of the boat certainly got stuck and stayed there undisturbed, but the back of the boat was being broken up by the force of the swells.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:42"></A><SPAN class="verseno">42 </SPAN>It became the intention of the soldiers that they should kill the inmates so that no one would swim away and completely escape.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:43"></A><SPAN class="verseno">43 </SPAN>But the lieutenant intended to keep Paul safe, so he kept them from what they intended to do. He gave the order that those who could swim should jump off and be the first out on the land.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 27:44"></A><SPAN class="verseno">44 </SPAN>The rest should go, some on boards and others on some of the things from the boat. And this is how it happened that everyone ended up safe on the land.</P>
<TITLE>Acts 28</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Acts 28:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Once we were safe, then we correctly understood that the island is called Melita <I>(present day Malta)</I>.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 28:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>After Paul bunched a large number of dry sticks together and placed them on the bonfire, a poisonous snake came out of the heat and clamped down on his hand.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 28:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>We landed at Syracuse <I>(a city on the southeastern coast of Sicily, an island off the southern tip of Italy)</I> and stayed over for three days.</P>
<P><A NAME="Acts 28:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>From there, we tacked <I>the boat,</I> and made it to Rhegium <I>(a city on the southern tip of Italy)</I>. After one day, a south wind came again, and we second-day people went to Puteoli <I>(200 miles up the Italian coast)</I>.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 28:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>The brothers from there til Appii Forum and Three Shacks <I>(two towns on the Appian Way, a road going to Rome)</I> heard the news about us and came to meet us face-to-face. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and received courage.</P>

<P><A NAME="Acts 28:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>After three days, he happened to call together the Jewish people's most important ones. <P><A NAME="Acts 28:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>After some of them investigated me, they were intending to dismiss me because of the fact that there was not even one accusation of death in me.</P>

<P><A NAME="Romans 1:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN><I>It is</I> about His Son (the One who, regarding the physical body, came from David's seed,</P>

<P><A NAME="Romans 1:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Through Him, we received generosity and a mission to distribute the obedience of trust among all the nations on behalf of His name.</P>

<P><A NAME="Romans 1:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN><I>For the people who won't trust, God's right way brings punishment.</I> You see, God's punishment is uncovered from heaven on all godlessness and wrong of people, the ones holding down the truth in wrong.</P>

<TITLE>Romans 2</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>This is why you are defenseless, O person, every person who judges. You see, the thing that you judge to be wrong in the other person is the very thing that you yourself are guilty of. You, the person who judges, repeatedly do the same things.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>We realize that God's judgment of the people who repeatedly do these types of things is based on the truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>O person, the one who judges the people repeatedly doing these types of things and who also does them, are you considering that you will <I>possibly</I> escape out of God's judgment?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Or do you ignore the wealth of His kindness, tolerance, and patience, unaware that God's kindness leads you into a change of ways?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Your hardness and stubborn heart cause you to stockpile punishment for yourself until a day of punishment and a day when God's right judgment is uncovered.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>In that day, what He gives out to each person will align with that person's actions:</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>to the people who persist to do good and look for magnificence, value, and the thing that doesn't deteriorate, He will certainly give back life that spans all time;</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>but to the people who are contentious about doing what is good and don't even believe the truth, but believe the wrong way, He will give back punishment and anger.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Hard times and difficulty are on every person's soul that is working on and completing what is bad (both the soul of a Jewish person first and of Greek).</P>

<P><A NAME="Romans 2:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>You see, appearances don't matter beside God.</P>

<P><A NAME="Romans 2:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>When the non-Jews (who by nature don't have a law) do the law's things, these who don't have a law are a law to themselves.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>They display the action of the law written in their hearts. <I>In their hearts,</I> their conscience concurs with <I>the law</I> as their reasonings interact between each other (leveling complaints against each other or even defending each other).</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>There will be a day when God judges the people's hidden actions aligned with my good news through the Anointed King Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>If you have identified yourself as Jewish, you also relax based on the law, you brag about God,</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>you know what God wants, and you approve the substantial things being echoed down from the law.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>And you have been confident that you yourself are a guide of blind people, a light for the people in darkness,</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>a discipliner of distracted people, a teacher of infants, someone who has the framework of knowledge and the truth in the law.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>So, you who teach a different person, don't you teach yourself? You who speak publicly about not stealing, do you steal?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>You who tell someone not to cheat on their spouse, do you cheat on your spouse? You who are disgusted with the idols, do you pilfer idol temples?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Do you who brag about the law belittle God through your violation of the law?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>You see, the non-Jews insult God's name because of you, just as the Bible says <I>in Isaiah 52:5 and Ezekiel 36:22-23</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Circumcision certainly is a benefit if you constantly obey the law, but if you are a violator of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>So if <I>the non-Jew,</I> the uncircumcision, observes the right paths of the law, won't his uncircumcision be considered as circumcision?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>And the uncircumcision (which is how everyone is born) that finishes the law will judge you, the violator of the law (who has the law's document and circumcision).</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>You see, what is important is not that the person is Jewish visibly or that he is circumcised visibly, in the physical body.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 2:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>But what is important is that a person is Jewish invisibly and that his heart is circumcised in spirit, not in some document. This person doesn't get high praise from people. His high praise is from God.</P>
<TITLE>Romans 3</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>So what is the thing <I>that makes</I> the Jewish person much better <I>than the person who is not Jewish?</I> Or what is the benefit of the circumcision?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>In every way, there is much. You see, first is certainly that they were trusted with God's utterances.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN><I>God trusted them, but</I> you see, what if some of them did not trust Him? Their distrust won't make the trust of God useless, will it?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>No, it could not happen. <I>When people disagree with God,</I> God is valid and every person is a liar. <I>This is</I> just as <I>David</I> wrote, "in order that You <I>(God)</I> might be made right in Your messages and <I>so that</I> You will conquer in what You decide" <I>(Psalm 51:4)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>If we <I>insist on</I> standing our wrong way up together with God's right way, what will we be stating? God isn't wrong for bringing on the punishment, is He? (I am talking as a human might).</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>No, it could not happen. Or else how will God judge the world?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>If my fabrication caused God's truth to overflow into His magnificence <I>(we're stating a hypothetical scenario here)</I>, why am I still even judged as a sinful person is?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>And <I>would it</I> not be just like the insults people say about us? <I>Would it not be</I> just as some declare us to be saying: "We should do the bad things so that the good things might come?" The judgment that those people make is reasonable: <I>It is always wrong to do bad, even when it seems to accomplish something good.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>So what about the Jewish people? Are we Jewish people held in a better position? Not by any means. You see, we already accused everyone, both Jewish people and Greeks, to be under sin.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>This is just what the Bible says: "There is not a person who does what is right, not even one."</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>"There is no one who understands. There is no one who is intensively searching for God."</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>"All slid away. They went bad at the same time. There is no one showing kindness. There isn't so much as one" <I>(Psalm 14:1-3; 53:1-3)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>"Their throat is an open grave. They were deceiving people with their tongues" (Psalm 5:9). "The venom of cobras is under their lips" <I>(Psalm 140:3)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>"Their mouth is packed full of cursing and bitterness" <I>(Psalm 10:7)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>"Their feet spill out blood quickly.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Disaster and misery are on their roads,</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>and they didn't know a road of peace" <I>(Isaiah 59:7-8)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>"There isn't a fear of God up in front of their eyes" <I>(Psalm 36:1)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>We realize that as much as the law says, it speaks to the people in the law so that every mouth might be shut and the entire world might become legally liable to God</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>because doing what the law says won't make even one physical body right in His sight. You see, the law gives people a correct understanding of sin.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>But right now, God's right way has been shown separate from the law. The Law and the Preachers witnessed it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>God's right way is through a trust of Jesus, the Anointed King. It is for all the people trusting. You see, there is no difference between Jew and non-Jew.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>All <I>who trust</I> sinned and lack God's magnificence.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>They are made right for free by His generosity through the paid release in the Anointed King Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>God put the Anointed King in public view as a remedy (through the trust in His blood) for a display of God's right way. <I>This is</I> because of the way He passed by the sins that have already happened.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>With God's tolerance, the display of His right way in the present time shows that He is right and He is the One who makes the person who trusts in Jesus right.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>So where is the bragging? It was excluded. What kind of law excluded it? A law <I>that gets people to</I> do things? No, a law <I>that gets people to</I> trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>You see, we consider a person with trust to be made right separate from the law's actions.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>Or is He only the God of Jewish people? Is He not also the God of non-Jews? Yes, also of non-Jews</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>if it is true that God is one God. <I>Since God is the one and only God over everyone,</I> He will make circumcision right from trust and uncircumcision right through the same trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 3:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>So do we make the law useless through this trust? No, it could not happen. On the contrary, we establish the law.</P>
<TITLE>Romans 4</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>So what will we state that Abraham, our forefather, has found regarding the physical body?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>You see, if Abraham was made right from things he did, he has something to brag about, but not to God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>You see, what does the <I>Old Testament</I> writing say? "But Abraham trusted God, and God considered him to be right <I>because of that</I>" <I>(Genesis 15:6)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>For the person working, the pay is not considered to be the result of generosity, it is considered to be what is owed to him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>But for the person who doesn't work but trusts the One who makes the person who is not godly right, God considers him to be right because of his trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>This is exactly what David also says is the blessedness of the person that God considers to be right despite the things he does:</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>"People whose crimes are forgiven and whose sins are covered up are blessed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>A man who has a master that won't ever consider sin is blessed" <I>(Psalm 32:1,2)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>So is this blessedness on the circumcision only? Or is it not also on the uncircumcision? You see, we say that God considered Abraham to be right because of the trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>So how was <I>it with Abraham when God</I> considered him to be right? Was he circumcised or uncircumcised? He was not circumcised. No, he was uncircumcised.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>And he received circumcision as proof and a seal of the right way of his trust, trust that he had while he was uncircumcised. That way he could be a father of all the uncircumcised people who trust (so that they will be considered right because of trust too).</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>And he could be a father of circumcision (not the people who are circumcised only, but the ones who also march in step with the footsteps of the trust that our uncircumcised father Abraham took).</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You see, the promise to Abraham or to his seed (the promise that he would inherit the world) is not through the law, but through the right way of trust."</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>If the inheritors are from the law, the trust has been meaningless and the promise has been rendered useless.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>The law works on and completes punishment, but where there is no law, there is no violation either.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Because of this, the right way is gained from trusting so that it is the result of generosity. That way the promise will be firm to every seed, not to the seed that is only from the law, but to the seed that also is from Abraham's trust, the Abraham who is a father of us all.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>This is just what the Bible says, "I have placed you as a father of many nations" <I>(Genesis 17:5)</I>. <I>This was said to Abraham as he was</I> directly facing the One that he trusted, God, the One who gives life to the dead and identifies the things that don't exist <I>yet</I> as if they do exist.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Beyond anticipation based on anticipation, Abraham trusted the promise that he would become a father of many nations. This matched up with what <I>God had stated after He told Abraham to look at the sky and see if he could count the stars. God</I> had stated: "This is how your seed will be" <I>(Genesis 15:5)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Even though he wasn't weak when it comes to trust, he took a close look at his own body. It already was as good as dead. He was almost a centenarian <I>(a hundred-year-old)</I>. And he took a close look at the deadness of Sarah's womb.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>But he didn't consider God's promise to be wrong and so not trust. No, he became competent with the trust when he gave magnificence to God</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>and was well-established in the conviction that God is also able to do what He has promised.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>For this reason, God considered him to be right.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>The Bible doesn't only say it (that God considered him to be right) because of him,</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>but also because of us, the ones that God is going to consider to be right for trusting the One who got Jesus, our Master, up from the dead.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 4:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Jesus was turned in because of our infractions and was gotten up because of our verdict declaring that we did the right thing.</P>
<TITLE>Romans 5</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>So since we have been made right from trust, we have peace with God through our Master Jesus, the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Through Him with the trust, we also have had the access into this generosity that we have been standing in, and we are optimistic based on an anticipation of God's magnificence.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Not only that, but we also are optimistic in the hard times realizing that the hard times work on and complete a persistence to do what is right,</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>the persistence to do what is right works on and completes a proven track record, and the proven track record works on and completes anticipation.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>We are not shamed by the anticipation because God's love has been spilled out in our hearts through the Sacred Spirit that was given to us.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN><I>His love is seen in the fact that</I> even though we were weak, the Anointed King still died at the appointed time on behalf of people who are not godly.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>You see, it may be difficult, but some will die on behalf of a person who does what is right. And some will possibly even dare to die on behalf of a good person.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>But God stands together with His own love for us, because the Anointed King died on our behalf while we were still sinful people.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>So, it is much more certain now that since we were made right in His blood, we will be rescued out of the punishment through Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You see, if we, who were enemies, were restored to God through His Son's death, it is much more certain that after we are restored, we will be rescued in His life.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Not only that, but we also are optimistic in God through our Master Jesus, the Anointed King. It is through Him that we now have received the restored relationship.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Because of this, <I>we should be aware of how that relationship died.</I> Even as sin came into the world through one person and death came through the sin <I>(not just physical death but also death of the relationship with God)</I>, so death also went through to everyone based on the fact that everyone sinned.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You see, sin was in the world before the law was given, but no one living then is found guilty of sinning since there was no law <I>telling them what is sin and what is not. There was only the story of Adam's violation.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>But death was still king during that time, from Adam up to Moses, even over the people who didn't sin in a similar way to Adam's violation. Adam is a type of the One that is going to come.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>But the gift from the One is not like Adam's infraction even though in some ways it is. You see, if many died with the one person's infraction, it is much more certain that God's generosity and that One Person's free handout overflowed to the many from His generosity. That One Person is Jesus, the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>And the free gift is not like what is through one person who sinned. You see, the judgment certainly goes from one person into a guilty verdict, but the gift goes from many infractions into the right path.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>If death was king through the one person with his infraction, it is much more certain that the people receiving the overflow of the generosity and <I>the overflow</I> of the free handout of the right way will be kings in life through the One, Jesus, the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>So clearly, as through one person's infraction, a guilty verdict is for all people, so also through one Person's right path, a verdict declaring that a person has done what is right is for all people, a verdict of life.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>You see, even as one person's noncompliance caused many to be classified as sinful people, so also will the One's obedience cause many to be classified as people who do what is right.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>The law quietly came in so that the infraction might increase. But where the sin increased, the generosity overflowed even more.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 5:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>That way even as the sin was king in the death, so also might the generosity be king through the right way for life that spans all time through Jesus, the Anointed King, our Master.</P>
<TITLE>Romans 6</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>So what will we state <I>when we realize that where sin increases, generosity overflows even more?</I> Should we stay over in the sin so that the generosity might increase?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>No, it should not happen. How will we, the ones who died to the sin, still live in it?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Or are you not aware that as many of us as were submerged into the Anointed King Jesus, were submerged into His death?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>So through the submersion, we were buried together with Him into death so that even as the Anointed King was gotten up from the dead through the Father's magnificence, so also we might walk around in newness of life.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>You see, if we have become integrated into the likeness of His death, we also will be a part of the return back to life.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>We know that our former person was nailed to a cross together with Him so that the body of sin might be rendered useless. <I>It is rendered useless</I> so that we won't be a slave to sin anymore.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>You see, the one who died with the Anointed King has been made right. <I>He has been taken</I> out of sin.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>If we died together with the Anointed King, we trust that we also will live together with Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>We have seen that the Anointed King who was gotten up from the dead doesn't die anymore. Death isn't a master over Him anymore.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You see, when He died for sin, He died all at once, but as He lives, He is living for God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>This is how you also must consider yourselves to certainly be dead people for sin, but people living for God in the Anointed King Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>So sin must not be a king in your dying body. Do not obey its desires.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Don't offer your body parts to sin either, to be weapons of the wrong way. But offer yourselves to God (as if you are living out of the dead) and your body parts to God to be weapons of the right way.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>You see, sin won't be your master. You aren't under the law, you are under generosity.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>So what <I>should we do?</I> Should we sin because we aren't under the law, but under generosity? No, it should not happen.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Haven't you seen that you are slaves to what you offer yourselves to be obedient slaves to, to what you obey, whether you are slaves of sin for death, or slaves of obedience for the right way?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Thank God that even though you were sin's slaves, from your heart you obeyed the type of teaching that you were handed over to.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>After being set free out of sin, you were made slaves to the right way.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>I am telling this human analogy because of your physical body's weakness. You see, in the same way that you offered your body parts to be slaves to what is not clean and to the crime for the crime, so also now offer your body parts to be slaves to the right way for sacredness.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>When you were sin's slaves, you were free from the right way.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>So what fruit were you having at that time? You are ashamed of those things now. You see, their conclusion is death.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>But right now, you have been set free out of sin, but after being made slaves to God, you have your fruit for sacredness. The conclusion is life that spans all time.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 6:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>You see, the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is life that spans all time in the Anointed King Jesus, our Master.</P>
<TITLE>Romans 7</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Or are you not aware, brothers, (you see, I am speaking to people who know the law) that the law is a master over a person as long as he lives?</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>You see, the 'under-a-husband' woman <I>(a married woman)</I> has been tied to the living husband by the law. But if the husband dies, she becomes exempt from the law <I>that ties her to</I> the husband.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>So clearly, as the husband is living, if she ends up with a different man, she will be labeled as a cheating wife. But if the husband has died, she is free from the law, and she is not a cheating wife when she ends up with a different man.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>In such a way, my brothers, the Anointed King's body also made you dead to the law so that you may end up with a different <I>man</I>, the <I>Man</I> who was gotten up from the dead. That way we can produce fruit for God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>You see, when we were in the physical body, sins' hardships (the hardships through the law) were active in our body parts producing fruit for death.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>But right now when we die in what was holding us down, we are rendered exempt from the law. That way we may be slaves in newness of spirit and not in the outdated nature of a document.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>So what will we state? That the law is sin? It could not happen. No, I didn't know sin except through the law. You see, I hadn't even seen desire <I>for my neighbor's things</I>, except the law was saying, "You will not desire <I>your neighbor's house, his wife, his servants, his ox, and etc." (Exodus 20:17)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>But sin received an opportunity through the demand, and it worked on and completed all kinds of desire in me. You see, separate from a law, sin is dead.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>In the past, I was living separate from a law, but when the demand came, sin came back to life. I died.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>And I found that this demand that is for life is for death.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>You see, when sin received an opportunity through the demand, it completely fooled me, and through this killed me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>In such a way, the law certainly is sacred, and the demand is sacred, right, and good.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 7:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>So did the thing that is good for me become death? No, it could not happen. <TITLE>Romans 12</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Romans 12:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>So through God's compassion, brothers, I encourage you to offer your bodies as a sacrifice that is living, sacred, well-liked by God, and your logical sacrifice ritual.</P>
<P><A NAME="Romans 12:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And don't be conformed to this span of time, but be transformed by renewing your way of thinking. That way you can prove what is the good, well-liked, and complete thing that God wants.</P>

<P><A NAME="First Corinthians 9:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>If others take part in your authority, shouldn't we more? But we don't make use of this authority. No, we put up with all things so that we might not interrupt the good news of the Anointed King in any way.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Corinthians 9:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Don't you realize that the people working with the temple things eat the <I>things</I> from the temple grounds? The ones attending to the altar receive an allotment of <I>the sacrifices offered on</I> the altar.</P>

<P><A NAME="First Corinthians 9:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>But I haven't made use of any of these things. I didn't write these things so that it might happen to me like this. You see, it would be nice for me instead to die, than...--no one will make my bragging meaningless.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Corinthians 9:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>You see, <I>the fact that</I> I share good news is not what I brag about. <I>I am obligated to share it and that</I> obligation is lying on me. What a tragedy it would be to me if I didn't share good news.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Corinthians 9:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>If I constantly do this voluntarily, I get pay, but if I am doing it involuntarily, it is because I have been trusted to be a manager <I>of the good news</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Corinthians 9:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>So what is my pay? <I>My pay is</I> that as I share good news, I might make it available with no cost <I>to anyone</I>. I don't want to overuse my authority in the good news <I>by making money off it</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Corinthians 9:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>You see, even though I am free from everyone, I make myself a slave to everyone so that I might gain more of them.</P>

<P><A NAME="First Corinthians 9:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>With the criminals, I became like a criminal (not being a criminal to God, but a lawful obeyer of the Anointed King) so that I might gain the criminals.</P>

<P><A NAME="Second Corinthians 1:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>because we realize that as you receive your share of the hardships, so you also receive your share of the encouragement.</P>

<TITLE>Second Corinthians 2</TITLE>

<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>The magnificence for the spans of time of the spans of time <I>belongs</I> to our God. Amen.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>I am amazed at how quickly you are transferring away from the One who generously invited you, the Anointed King, to a different good news.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>It is not another good news. It is just that there are some people agitating you and wanting to alter the good news of the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>But even if we or an angel from heaven should share good news with you contrary to what we shared with you, he must be doomed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>As we have stated before, I even now say again, "If anyone shares good news with you contrary to what you received in, he must be doomed."</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You see, am I now persuading people or God? Or am I looking to do what people would like? If I were still doing what people like, I would not be the Anointed King's slave.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>You see, I am letting you know, brothers, that the good news that I shared is not aligned with a person.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>And I didn't receive it directly from a person either. And I wasn't taught it either. But <I>I got it</I> through Jesus, the Anointed King, uncovering it <I>to me</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You see, you heard of my behavior in the past in Judaism. I was pursuing God's assembly even more than others and damaging it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>I was progressing in Judaism above many my own age in my family. I had much more passion for the traditions passed down by my fathers.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>But when it seemed like a good idea to the God who isolated me from my mother's belly and invited me through His generosity</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>to uncover His Son in me so that I may share the good news of Him among the non-Jews, I didn't consult with anyone right away, no one with a physical body and blood.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>I didn't go up into Jerusalem to the <I>people who were</I> missionaries before me either. But I went off into Arabia and returned again into Damascus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Following that, after three years, I went up into Jerusalem to visit Cephas <I>(Aramaic for Peter)</I>. And I stayed over with him for fifteen days.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>I didn't see a different one of the missionaries except James, the brother of the Master.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>The things that I am writing to you, look, in the sight of God, I am not lying.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Following that, I went to the slopes of Syria and Cilicia <I>(the southeastern coastal region of Turkey where Tarsus is, Paul's birthplace).</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Judea's assemblies in the Anointed King were unaware of my face.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>They were only hearing, "The one pursuing us in the past is now sharing the good news of the trust that in the past he was damaging,"</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 1:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>and from me, they were praising God's magnificence.</P>
<TITLE>Galatians 2</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Fourteen years following that, I walked up to Jerusalem again with Barnabas. We also took Titus along together with us.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>I walked up there regarding what had been uncovered to me. And I laid out to them the good news that I speak about publicly among the non-Jews. But I <I>spoke</I> privately to the people who seem to be something <I>and showed them</I> how what I am running for and what I ran for is not meaningless. <I>I have run for our freedom in the Anointed King.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>But they did not compel Titus, the Greek, a non-Jew who was together with me, to be circumcised either.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>We spoke to them privately because of the undetected counterfeit brothers. They are the ones that have quietly come in to spy out and plot against our freedom that we have in the Anointed King Jesus. <I>They do this</I> so that they will make us complete slaves.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>We didn't give in to them or comply with them for even an hour so that the truth of the good news might stay through to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>It is not substantial to me to be something from the people seeming to be something, whatever kind of people they were in the past. God does not receive a person based on his appearance. You see, the people seeming to be something imposed nothing on me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>But just the opposite, they saw that I had been trusted with the good news of the uncircumcision <I>(the non-Jews)</I>, just as Peter had been trusted with the good news of the circumcision <I>(the Jews)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>You see, the One who was active with Peter for his mission to the circumcision, was also active with me for my mission to the non-Jews.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>After knowing the generosity that God had shown to me, James, Cephas, and John (the ones seeming to be pillars) shook right hands with me and Barnabas <I>to confirm our</I> partnership. They agreed that we would go to the non-Jews and they would go to the circumcision.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>They only asked that we would remember the poor. This very thing was something that I also made every effort to do.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>But when Cephas came to Antioch, I stood in opposition to him right in front of his face because of what had been known against him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>You see, before certain people came out from James, he was eating together with the non-Jews. But when they came, he was backing off and isolating himself from the non-Jews because he was afraid of the people from the circumcision.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>And the rest of the Jewish people also faked it together with him <I>and acted like they don't eat with the non-Jews</I>. Even Barnabas was led away together with their faked behavior.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>But when I saw that they are not straight-footed toward the truth of the good news, I said to Cephas in front of everyone, "If you, being Jewish, are living like the non-Jews and definitely not like the Jews, how are you compelling the non-Jews to become Jews?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>We are Jewish by birth. We are not sinful from non-Jews.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>We realize that a person is not made right from doing what the law says if it is not through trusting Jesus, the Anointed King. And we trusted in the Anointed King Jesus so that we might be made right from our trust of the Anointed King and not from doing what the law says. No physical body will be made right from doing what the law says.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>But if, as we were looking to be made right in the Anointed King, we ourselves were actually found to be sinful <I>because we ate with non-Jews</I>, so what would the Anointed King be? A servant of sin? It could not happen.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>You see, if I again build these things that I tore down, I myself stand together with a violator.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Through the law, I died to the law so that I might live for God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>I have been nailed to a cross together with the Anointed King. I no longer live, but the Anointed King lives in me. What I now live in a physical body, I live in trust of God's Son who loved me and turned Himself in on my behalf.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 2:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>I don't disregard God's generosity. You see, if the right way is through the law, clearly the Anointed King died for nothing.</P>
<TITLE>Galatians 3</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>O unobservant Galatians, who tricked you? Right in front of your eyes, it was openly written to you that Jesus, the Anointed King, had been nailed to a cross.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>I only want to learn this from you, did you receive the Spirit from doing what the law says or from what you heard about trust?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>This is how you are unobservant. After beginning in the Spirit, now you are finishing yourselves up with the physical body.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Did you suffer so many things for no reason, if it definitely even is for no reason?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>So the One who is supplying more than the Spirit to you and who is active with abilities among you, does He come from doing what the law says or from what you heard about trust?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Just as "Abraham trusted God, and it was considered to him for the right way" <I>(Genesis 15:6)</I>,</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>clearly you must know that these people from trust are Abraham's sons.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>When the <I>Old Testament</I> writing saw beforehand that God makes the non-Jews right from trust, it shared this good news with Abraham before it happened, "All the non-Jews will be conferred with blessings in you" <I>(Genesis 22:18)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>And so the people from trust are conferred with blessings together with the Abraham who trusted God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You see, as many as are <I>trying to</I> do what the law says are under a curse. The Bible says, "Everyone is cursed who does not stay in <I>and do</I> all the things that have been written in the scroll of the law" <I>(Deuteronomy 27:26)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>It is obvious that not one person is made right beside God in the law because, "The person who does what is right will live from trust" <I>(Habakkuk 2:4)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>The law is not from trust. No, the person who does the things written in the law will live in them <I>(Leviticus 18:5)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>The Anointed King purchased us from the law's curse after becoming a curse on our behalf because the Bible says, "Everyone who hangs on a wooden pole is cursed" <I>(Deuteronomy 21:23)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>That way Abraham's conferring of blessing would come to the non-Jews in the Anointed King Jesus so that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through the trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Brothers, I am saying that this is also true when it comes to a person. Once a deal from a person is made official, no one invalidates it or adds to it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>The promises were stated to Abraham and to his seed. He does not say, "and to the seeds," as if the promises would be based on many seeds, but as if they would be based on one seed, "and to your seed." That seed is the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>What I am saying is this: The law (that happened 430 years after the deal) does not nullify the deal (that has been made official by God <I>long</I> before <I>the law appeared</I>). The law does not make the promise useless.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>You see, if the inheritance is from the law, it is no longer from a promise. But it is through a promise that God, in an act of generosity, has given the inheritance to Abraham.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>So why does the law exist? <I>The law exists</I> thanks to the violations. It was added till the seed would come: the Anointed King that had been promised. The law was specifically arranged through angels in the hand of a middleman, <I>Moses</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>The middleman is not a middleman of one. <I>He keeps the different parties separate.</I> But God is one. <I>God made the promise directly to Abraham with no middleman.</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>So is the law against the promises of God? It could not happen. You see, if a law that can give life was given, the right way really would have been from the law.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>But the <I>Old Testament</I> writing closed everything up under sin so that the promise that comes from trusting Jesus, the Anointed King, might be given to the people trusting.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Before the time for the trust to come, the law was watching over us. We were being closed up into the trust that was going to be uncovered.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>And so the law has become a babysitter of us for the Anointed King so that we might be made right from trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>But after the trust comes, we are no longer under a babysitter.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>You see, you are all God's sons through trust in the Anointed King Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>As many of you as were submerged into the Anointed King have put the Anointed King on.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>There is not Jewish or Greek. There is not slave or free. There is not male and female. You see, you all are one in the Anointed King Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 3:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>If you are the Anointed King's, clearly you are Abraham's seed, inheritors aligned with a promise.</P>
<TITLE>Galatians 4</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>I am saying this: For as much time as the inheritor is an infant, he is nothing more substantial than a slave though he is master of them all.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>But he is under administrators and managers till the time that has been predetermined by the father.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>This is how we also, when we were infants, were made slaves by the world's conventional practices.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>But when the time had fully come, God sent off His Son. His Son came from a woman and came under the law.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>That way He could purchase the people under the law from the conventional practices so that we could fully receive the adoption.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>And because you are sons, God sent off the Son's Spirit into our hearts yelling, "Daddy, the Father!"</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>And so you are no longer a slave, but a son. If you are a son, you are also an inheritor through God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>But at that time, when you certainly didn't know God, you were slaves to the things that by their very nature are not gods.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Now, after knowing God, rather, after being known by God, how are you turning back to the weak and poor conventional practices again and wanting to be slaves to them all over again?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You closely watch days, months, certain times, and years.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I am afraid when it comes to you that somehow I have labored for you for no reason.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Become like me because I also am like you, brothers. I plead with you. You didn't harm me in any way.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You realize that because of a weakness of the physical body I shared good news with you previously.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>You <I>were</I> troubled by my physical body, but you didn't treat it as a bad thing. You didn't despise it. No, as if you were God's angel, you accepted me as if I were the Anointed King Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>So where is your blessedness? You see, I am a witness to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>And so, have I become your enemy because I am truthful with you?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>They are not passionate about you in a nice way. But they want to exclude you from everything else so that you may be passionate about them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>It is nice to always be passionate in a nice way and not only during the time that I am close beside you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>My children, again I am in labor with you until the Anointed King is formed in you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>I was wanting to be close beside you now and change my voice because I am not sure what to think about you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>You who want to be under the law, tell me, don't you hear the law?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>You see, the Bible says that Abraham had two sons: one from the servant girl and one from the free woman <I>(Genesis 16:3; 21:2)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>But the son from the servant girl certainly has been born aligned with a physical body, and the son from the free woman has been born through a promise.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>These things have another meaning. You see, these are two deals. One is certainly out of Mount Sinai. It gives birth to slavery. This is the one that is the servant girl, Hagar.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia. She is now marching in step together with Jerusalem. You see, she is a slave with her children.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>The one from above is free Jerusalem. This is the one that is our mother.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>You see, the Bible says, "Celebrate, infertile woman who doesn't give birth to children! Burst out and shout, the woman who hasn't been in labor, because the uninhabited <I>woman</I> has many children, more than the woman who has the husband" <I>(Isaiah 54:1)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>You, brothers, are aligned with Isaac. You are children of promise.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>But even as it was at that time, so it also is now. The one who was born aligned with a physical body was persecuting the one aligned with the Spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:30"></A><SPAN class="verseno">30 </SPAN>But what does the <I>Old Testament</I> writing say? "Throw out the servant girl and her son. You see, the servant girl's son will not in any way inherit anything with the free woman's son" <I>(Genesis 21:10)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 4:31"></A><SPAN class="verseno">31 </SPAN>For this reason, brothers, we are not the servant girl's children. We are the free woman's children.</P>
<TITLE>Galatians 5</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>The Anointed King set us free so that we can be free. So stand and don't be held in by a crossbeam of slavery again.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Look, I, Paul, tell you that if you all <I>think that you should</I> be circumcised, the Anointed King will in no way benefit you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Again, I am a witness to every person being circumcised that he is obligated to do the whole law.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Any of you who <I>think that you</I> are made right in the law have pushed the Anointed King away and made it so that He is useless to you. You have fallen from God's generosity.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>You see, we have the Spirit from trust. We patiently wait for the good that we anticipate from the right way.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>In the Anointed King Jesus, circumcision doesn't have any strength and uncircumcision doesn't either. But <I>what has strength is</I> trust that is active through love.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>You were running nicely. Who interrupted you to not be persuaded by the truth?</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The persuasion <I>that you have</I> is not from the One who invited you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>A little yeast causes the whole batch to rise.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>I have been persuaded that you will stay in the Master and not focus on anything else. The one agitating you will haul the judgment, whoever he may be.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I, brothers, if I am still speaking publicly <I>in favor of</I> circumcision, why am I still being persecuted? <I>If I am in favor of being a slave to the law,</I> I have clearly made <I>the freedom of</I> the cross that they stumble on useless.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>If only the people upsetting you would also chop themselves off from you.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You see, you were invited based on freedom, brothers. Only <I>it is</I> not the freedom <I>that gives</I> the physical body an opportunity <I>to do whatever it wants</I>. No, <I>it is the freedom that allows</I> you to be slaves to each other through love.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>The entire law has been accomplished in one message, in the <I>message that says</I>, "You will love the person near you as yourself."</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>If you bite and eat up each other, look out, you might be consumed by each other.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>I say, "Walk around in the Spirit, and you will not in any way finish the physical body's desire."</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>You see, what the physical body desires is against the Spirit, and what the Spirit desires is against the physical body. These lie in opposition to each other so that you don't do whatever you may want to do.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>If you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>The kind of things the physical body does are apparent. These are the things that are sexual sin, anything that is not clean, indulgent activity,</P>
<P><A NAME="Galatians 5:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>idol worship, drug abuse, hostile relationships, fighting, hostile passion, bursts of anger, contentions, factions, splinter groups,</P>
