<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 1:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>We are always thankful to God about all of you. We make mention of you on our prayers.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 1:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>We constantly remember your work of trust, your labor of love, and your persistence to anticipate good from our Master Jesus, the Anointed King, in front of our God and Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 1:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>We have seen that God has selected you, brothers, you who have been loved by God,</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 1:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>because our good news didn't come to you in message only, but also in ability, in the Sacred Spirit, and in a way that fully accomplished much. Just as <I>we have seen that God selected you, so</I> you have seen what kind of people we became among you because of you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 1:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>And you became imitators of us and the Master when in very hard times you accepted the message with happiness of the Sacred Spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 1:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>And so you became an example to everyone who trusts in Macedonia <I>(northern Greece)</I> and in Achaia <I>(southern Greece)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 1:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>You see, the Master's message has reverberated out from you, not only in Macedonia and in Achaia, but in every place your trust toward God has gone out to. <I>It is</I> so <I>effective</I> that we don't need to speak anything.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 1:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>They report about us. <I>They report</I> what kind of inroad we had to you and how you turned back to God from the idols to be slaves to the living and true God</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 1:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>and to stay and wait for His Son from the heavens, the Son that He got up from the dead, Jesus, the One saving us from the coming punishment.</P>
<TITLE>First Thessalonians 2</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>You see, you yourselves, brothers, realize that our inroad to you has not become something that is meaningless.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>No, after we previously suffered and were injured in Philippi (just as you know), we made clear public statements in our God to speak God's good news to you in a great struggle.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>You see, our encouragement, <I>the encouragement that we give out,</I> is not from a misleading lie, or from what is not clean, or in deception.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>But just as we have been approved by God to be trusted with the good news, so we speak, not as if we are doing what people would like, but as if <I>we are doing what</I> God <I>would like</I>, the One who approves our hearts.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>You see, in the past, we didn't come with a message of flattery either, just as you know, or in a sham of a desire for more (God is a witness),</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>or looking for magnificence from people (not from you, not from others). As the Anointed King's missionaries, we could have been a heavy weight on you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>But we became infants in the middle of you, as when a nursing mother keeps her own children warm.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Being closely attached to you like this, it seemed like a good idea to us to not only give out God's good news to you, but also our own souls, because you became people that we love.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>You see, brothers, you remember our labor and difficulty. As we worked night and day toward the <I>goal of</I> not being a burden on any of you, we spoke publicly to you about God's good news.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You and God are witnesses of how we became holy, right, and faultless to you who trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>You have seen exactly how <I>we were with</I> each one of you. <I>We were</I> like a father with his own children. We encouraged you. We comforted you. And we were witnesses to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN><I>We did this</I> so that you would walk around in a manner deserving of God, the One who invited you into His own monarchy and magnificence.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>And because of this, we also are constantly thankful to God because when you took in a message of what you heard directly from us, a message of God, you accepted it, not as a message of people, but, just as it truly is, a message of God, who also is active in you, the ones who trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>You see, you became imitators, brothers, of God's assemblies in Judea that are in the Anointed King Jesus. You actually suffered the same things under your own countrymen as they also <I>suffered</I> under the Jewish people.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN><I>Those Jewish people</I> even killed the Master Jesus and the preachers. They chased us out. They do not do what God would like. And they oppose all people</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>as they keep us from speaking to the non-Jews (<I>even though we are speaking to the non-Jews</I> so that they might be rescued). They always fill up their sins to the top. Their punishment for the conclusion already came on them.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>But when we were made orphans by being away from you, brothers, in presence, not in heart, for close to an hour's time, we made much more of an effort with much desire to see your face</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>because we, certainly I, Paul, wanted to come to you both once and twice, and the Opponent interrupted us.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>You see, what is our anticipation of good, or our happiness, or our bragging's award wreath? Is it not actually you in front of our Master Jesus during His arrival?</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 2:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>You are our magnificence and happiness.</P>
<TITLE>First Thessalonians 3</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>For this reason, since I wasn't able to stand it anymore, it seemed like a good idea to us for me to be left down in Athens alone.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And I sent Timothy (our brother and a co-worker for God in the Anointed King's good news) for the purpose of establishing you and encouraging you on behalf of your trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN><I>I did this</I> so that no one would be swayed in these hard times. You see, you yourselves have seen that we are placed here for this.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Even when we were facing you, we were telling you before it happened that we are going to be going through hard times, just as it also happened. And you have seen it.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>And because of this, since I wasn't able to stand it anymore, I sent Timothy to you to know your trust. <I>I sent him</I> in case somehow the one who tries to cause trouble was trying to cause trouble with you and our labor might turn into something that is meaningless.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Just now, Timothy came to us from you and shared with us the good news of your trust, your love, and that you always mention good things about us as you yearn to see us, exactly as we also yearn to see you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Because of this, brothers, we were encouraged from you in all our shortages and hard times by your trust</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>because now we live if you stand in the Master.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>You see, what thanks can we repay to God concerning you over all the happiness that we are happy with in front of our God because of you?</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>We plead night and day even much more to see your face and to fully develop the deficiencies of your trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>May our God and Father Himself and our Master Jesus direct our way to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>May the Master cause you to increase and overflow in your love for each other and for everyone, exactly as we also increase and overflow in our love for you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 3:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN><I>This will</I> establish your hearts as faultless in sacredness in front of our God and Father during the arrival of our Master Jesus with all His sacred people. Amen.</P>
<TITLE>First Thessalonians 4</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN><I>We told you</I> how you must walk around and do what God would like. <I>You received it in</I> directly from us. So for the rest of the time, brothers, we ask and encourage you in Master Jesus that just as you received it in and just as you walked around in it, you should overflow more.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>You see, you have seen what the orders are that we gave to you through the Master Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>This is what God wants: your sacredness. <I>He wants</I> you to keep yourselves away from sexual sin.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN><I>He wants</I> each of you to know <I>that you need</I> to get your own container <I>(your body)</I> in sacredness and value,</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>not in lust of desire (<I>which is</I> exactly how the non-Jews who don't know God <I>live</I>).</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>And <I>God wants each of you</I> not to step beyond and take advantage of his brother in the matter because the Master is a retaliator concerning all of these things. This is just as we also already told you and were a strong witness to.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>You see, God didn't invite us based on <I>something</I> that is not clean. No, He invited us in sacredness.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>So you see then, the person disregarding these things doesn't disregard a person but God, the One who also gives His Sacred Spirit to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>But I don't need to write to you about brotherly kindness. You see, you yourselves are God-taught to love each other.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You actually do it to all the brothers in all of Macedonia, but we encourage you, brothers, to overflow more,</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>to think that it is important to remain calm, to constantly do your own things, and to work with your own hands. This is just how we passed the order on to you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>That way you may walk around reputably toward the people outside and have need of nothing.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>We don't want you to be unaware, brothers, about the people who are asleep <I>(those who are dead)</I> so that you are not sad just as the rest <I>are sad</I> who actually have no anticipation of good.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>You see, if we trust that Jesus died and came back to life, in the same way through Jesus, God will also bring together with Him the people who fell asleep <I>(who died)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>This is what we are telling you in the Master's message, that we, the people living who are left around here for the Master's arrival, will not in any way precede the people who fell asleep</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>because the Master Himself when He gives the order (in the head angel's voice and in God's trumpet) will step down out of heaven, and the dead in the Anointed King will come back to life first.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Following that, we, the people living who are left around here, will be snatched up at the same time in clouds together with them for a face-to-face meeting of the Master in the air. And this is how we will always be together with the Master.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 4:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>And so encourage each other with these words.</P>
<TITLE>First Thessalonians 5</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Brothers, I don't need to write you about the amounts of time and the appointed times.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>You see, you yourselves accurately realize that the Master's day comes like this, as a thief in the night.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>When they say peace and certainty, then unexpected destruction stands over them, even as labor pain stands over the pregnant woman. And they will not in any way escape from it.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>But you, brothers, are not in darkness that the day might take you down as a thief <I>might</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>You see, <I>in the dark, you can't see anything. In the light, you see everything.</I> You all are sons of light and sons of day. We are not of night or of darkness.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>So clearly let's not sleep as the rest do, but let's stay awake and be sober.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>You see, the people who sleep, sleep at night, and the people who get drunk are drunk at night.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>But we who are of the day should be sober and put on an armored vest of trust and love, and head protection--anticipation of rescue.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Let's do this because God didn't place us into punishment. No, He placed us into acquiring rescue through our Master Jesus, the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>Our Master Jesus is the One who died for us so that whether we stay awake or whether we sleep, we might live at the same time together with Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>For this reason, encourage and build each other, one on one, just as you also are doing.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>We ask you, brothers, to realize who the people are that labor among you, that preside over you in the Master, and that caution you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Regard them with love even much more because of their work. Be peaceful among yourselves.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>We encourage you, brothers. Caution the defiant. Comfort the downhearted. Keep the weak in front of you. Be patient with everyone.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Look. No one should give bad back to anyone for bad, but always pursue the good thing both for each other and for all.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Always be happy.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Constantly pray.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>In everything, be thankful. You see, this is what God wants for you in the Anointed King Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>Don't extinguish the Spirit.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Don't treat the things that are said in a sermon as if they are nothing.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Check all things. Hold steady to the nice thing.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Keep yourselves away from every visual image of evil.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>May the God of peace Himself make you sacred so that you can be entirely complete people. And may your entirely whole spirit, soul, and body be kept without any faults during the arrival of our Master Jesus, the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>The One who invites you can be trusted. He will also do it.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>Brothers, also pray about us.</P>
<P><A NAME="First Thessalonians 5:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>Say hello to all the brothers with a sacred friendly gesture.</P>

<P><A NAME="Second Thessalonians 1:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN><I>We do this</I> in order that our Master Jesus' name <I>and who He is</I> might be made magnificent in you and you in Him aligned with the generosity of our God and Master Jesus, the Anointed King.</P>

<P><A NAME="Second Thessalonians 2:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>that you not be quickly disturbed away from your way of thinking or alarmed--not through a spirit, not through a message, not through a letter (even if it seems to be from us)--that the Master's day <I>has come and</I> has stood here.</P>

<P><A NAME="Second Thessalonians 2:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>And then the criminal will be uncovered. The Master Jesus will execute him with the Spirit of His mouth and will make him useless when He shows up at His arrival.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Thessalonians 2:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN><I>The criminal's arrival</I> is aligned with the Opponent's influence in every ability, in proofs, in incredible things of a lie,</P>

<P><A NAME="Second Thessalonians 2:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>And because of this, God sends them the influence of a misleading lie for <I>a reason,</I> so that they would trust in the lie.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Thessalonians 2:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>That way all the people will be judged who didn't trust the truth but were delighted with the wrong way.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Thessalonians 2:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>But we are obligated to always be thankful to God concerning you, brothers. You have been loved by the Master because God chose you to be a first-part-offering for rescue in sacredness of spirit and trust of truth.</P>

<P><A NAME="Second Thessalonians 2:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>May our Master Jesus Himself, the Anointed King, and God, our Father, who loved us and gave encouragement that spans all time and good anticipation in generosity,</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Thessalonians 2:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>encourage your hearts and establish you in every good action and message.</P>

<P><A NAME="James 1:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>For this reason, after you put away all filthiness and overflow of badness, in submissiveness, accept the implanted message that is able to rescue your souls.</P>

<TITLE>James 2</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="James 2:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>My brothers, have the trust of our Master Jesus, the Anointed King, the Magnificence, in an environment where appearances don't matter.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>You see, what if a man with a gold ring on his finger came into your synagogue in a dazzling outfit, but also a poor man in a filthy outfit came in?</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>You all may take a look at the person wearing the dazzling outfit, and say, "You sit here nicely," and you might say to the poor man, "You stand over there or sit down under my footrest?"</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>You didn't consider what is wrong among yourselves, and you became judges with evil ponderings.</P>

<P><A NAME="James 2:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>But you belittled the poor man. Don't the wealthy suppress you? And don't they themselves drag you into courts?</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Don't they themselves insult the nice name that was called over you?</P>

<P><A NAME="James 2:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>But if you are swayed by appearances, you are working on sin, and you are reprimanded by the law as violators.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You see, anyone who will keep the whole law but slip up in one point has become eligible to be sentenced for <I>breaking</I> all of it.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>The <I>same</I> One who said, "You will not cheat on your spouse," also said, "You will not commit murder." If you don't cheat on your spouse, but you commit murder, you have become a violator of the law.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>This is how you should speak and this is how you should do things--as people who are going to be judged through <I>a different law,</I> a law that frees people.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>You see, the judgment that has no forgiving kindness is for the person who didn't show forgiving kindness. Forgiving kindness brags about how much better it is than judgment.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>What benefit is it, my brothers, if someone says that he has trust, but he doesn't have its actions? The trust is not able to rescue him, is it?</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>What if a brother or sister is naked and lacks that day's meal?</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>Some from among you might say to them, "Make your way back in peace. Be warm, and be adequately fed." But if you won't give them the body's needful things, what is the benefit of that?</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>This is also how trust is dead by itself if it doesn't have actions.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>But someone will state that you have trust and I have actions. Show me your trust separate from the actions, and I will show you the trust from my actions.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>You trust that there is one God. You do nicely. Even the lesser deities trust and shudder.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Do you want to know, O empty person, that trust separate from the actions is idle?</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Wasn't Abraham, our father, made right from actions when he carried Isaac, his son, up onto the altar?</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Do you see that his trust was working together with his actions, and from the actions the trust was completed?</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>And the <I>Old Testament</I> writing that says, "Abraham trusted God, and it was considered to him for the right way" <I>(Genesis 15:6)</I>, was accomplished, and <I>in later writings,</I> he was called a friend of God <I>(Isaiah 41:8; 2 Chronicles 20:7)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 2:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>You <I>can</I> see that a person is made right from actions and not from trust only.</P>

<P><A NAME="James 2:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>You see, even as the body is dead when it is separate from the spirit, so also trust is dead when it is separate from actions.</P>

<P><A NAME="James 3:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Don't become many teachers, my brothers. Realize that <I>if we do,</I> we will receive greater judgment.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>You see, absolutely all of us slip up often. If anyone does not slip up in word, this person is a complete man. He is able to also bridle the whole body.</P>

<P><A NAME="James 3:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Look also at the boats being such big boats as these. They are driven by harsh winds. The boat is led about by the smallest rudder to where the sudden impulse of the person steering intends.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>This is also how the tongue is a little body part and brags about great things. Look, such a small fire starts such a large forest on fire.</P>

The tongue is classified among our body parts and stains the whole body, ignites the running wheel of the birth history, and is ignited by Hinnom Valley. (The Hinnom Valley ran along the southwestern edge of Jerusalem. At one time children were burned to death there as sacrifices to idols. It is symbolic of the eternal lake of fire.)</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>You see, the nature of a human tames and has tamed the nature of every <I>being</I>, of both wild animals and winged birds, of both reptiles and marine animals.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>But no one is able to tame the tongue of humans. It is inconsistent, bad, full of lethal poison.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>With it, we confer blessings on the Master and Father, and with it we put curses on the people who have become aligned with God's likeness.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>From the same mouth comes a conferring of blessing and a curse. My brothers, these things do not need to be happening like this.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>The spring doesn't emit sweet water and bitter water from the same opening, does it?</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>My brothers, a fig tree is not able to produce olives (or a vine, figs), is it? And salt water isn't able to produce sweet water either.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>Who is insightful and intelligent among you? He must show his actions from his nice behavior in submissiveness of insight.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>But if you have bitter hostile passion and contention in your heart, do not brag <I>about how much better you are</I> and lie against the truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="James 3:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>This insight does not come down from above. No, it is earthly, psychological, like lesser deities.</P>

<P><A NAME="James 3:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>The right way's fruit is seeded in peace for the ones who make peace.</P>

<P><A NAME="First Peter 2:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>So when you put away all badness, every deception, faked behaviors, envies, and all bad comments,</P>

<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>You see, this goes unnoticed by them, and they want it to go unnoticed, that from a long time ago, there were skies and land. The land stood together from water and through water with God's message.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Through it, the world at that time was ruined when it was flooded with water.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Now the skies and the land have been stockpiled with the same message. They are kept for fire in a day of judgment and ruin of the godless people.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>This one thing must not go unnoticed by you, loved ones--that one day beside the Master is as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>The Master of the promise is not slow as some regard slowness, but He is patient for you, not intending that anyone be ruined, but that all would make room for a change of ways.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>The Master's day will arrive as a thief. In that day, the skies will pass with a loud crash. As primary elements are on fire, they will be undone. Both the land and the actions in it will be found.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Since all these things are being undone like this, what kind of people must you be in sacred behaviors and expressions of godliness?</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Expect and hurry the arrival of God's day. Flaming skies will be undone, and primary elements on fire are melted because of it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>But we expect new skies and new land where the right way lives according to His promise.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>For this reason, loved ones, as you expect these things, make every effort to be found by Him in peace, unspotted and unblamed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>And regard the patience of our Master as a rescue, just as our loved brother Paul also wrote to you aligned with the insight given to him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>He speaks about these things in all <I>kinds of</I> letters. There are some hard-to-understand things in them. Unlearned and unestablished people pervert them as they also pervert the rest of the writings to their own ruin.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>So you, loved ones, since you know these things beforehand, beware so that you aren't led away together with the misleading lie of the noncompliant and so that you don't fall from your own established position.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second Peter 3:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>But grow in the generosity and information of our Master and Rescuer Jesus, the Anointed King. He has the magnificence both now and for a span of time's day. Amen.</P>
<TITLE>First John 1</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="First John 1:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>What was from the beginning, what we have heard, what we have seen with our eyes, what we viewed and our hands felt is about the message of life.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 1:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>The life was actually shown. We have seen it. We are telling what we witnessed. And we are reporting to you about the life that spans all time. This was <I>the life</I> that was pointing toward the Father and was shown to us.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 1:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>We are reporting what we have seen and heard to you too. That way you also may be in a sharing relationship with us, but our sharing relationship is also with the Father and with His Son Jesus, the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 1:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>And we are writing these things so that our happiness may be filled up.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 1:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>And this is the announcement that we have heard out from Him and are announcing to you: "God is light, and not even one bit of darkness is in Him." <I>(Light shows what exists--the way things are--the truth. Darkness hides it.)</I></P>
<P><A NAME="First John 1:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>If we said that we are in a sharing relationship with Him and we walk around in the dark, we lie and do not do the truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 1:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>But if we walk around in the light as He is in the light, we are in a sharing relationship with each other, and the blood of Jesus, His Son, cleans us off from every sin.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 1:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>If we say that we don't have sin, we mislead ourselves and the truth is not in us.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 1:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>If we acknowledge our sins, He can be trusted and He does what is right so that He will forgive us of the sins and clean us off from every wrong.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 1:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>If we say that we haven't sinned, we make Him a liar and His message is not in us.</P>
<TITLE>First John 2</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>My little children, I am writing these things to you so that you might not sin. And if anyone sins, we have an encourager pointing toward the Father who does what is right, Jesus, the Anointed King.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And He is a remedy covering our sins. Not only <I>is He</I> covering ours, but <I>He is</I> also covering the whole world's.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And it is in this that we know that we have known Him, if we keep His demands.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>The one who says, "I have known Him," and does not keep His demands is a liar. The truth is not in this.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>But whoever keeps His message, in this, God's love has truly been completed. In this, we know that we are in Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>The person who says that he is staying in Him is obligated to be walking around just as that One Himself also walked around.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Loved ones, it is not a new demand that I am writing to you. No, it is a former demand that you were having starting at the beginning. The former demand is the message that you heard.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>Again I am writing a new demand to you. It is valid. It is in Him and in you because the darkness is passing on by and the true light is already shining.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>The person who says that he is in the light and hates his brother is in the dark until now.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>The person who loves his brother stays in the light, and there is no obstacle in him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>But the person hating his brother is in the dark, walks around in the dark, and does not realize where he is making his way back to because the dark blinds his eyes.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>I am writing to you, little children, because you have been forgiven of your sins because of His name <I>and who He is</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>I am writing to you, fathers, because you have known the One who is from the beginning. I am writing to you, young lads, because you have conquered the evil one. I wrote to you, young children, because you have known the Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>I wrote to you, fathers, because you have known the One who is from the beginning. I wrote to you, young lads, because you are strong, God's message stays in you, and you have conquered the evil one.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Don't love the world, and <I>don't love</I> the things in the world either. If anyone loves the world, the Father's love is not in him</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>because everything in the world (the desire of the physical body, the desire of the eyes, and the ego of life on earth) is not from the Father. No, it is from the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>And the world and its desire passes on by. But the person who does what God wants stays for the span of time.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Young children, it is the last hour. And just as you heard that the Anointed King's opponent is coming, and now many have become the Anointed King's opponents, from this we know that it is the last hour.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>They went out from us, but they were not from us. You see, if they were from us, they would have stayed with us. But they went out so that it might be shown that all of them are not from us.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN><I>This</I> also <I>shows that</I> you have an anointing out from the Sacred One, and you all have seen it.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>I didn't write to you because you don't realize the truth, but because you realize it and that every lie is not from the truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>Who is the liar if it isn't the one denying that Jesus is the Anointed King? This one is the Anointed King's opponent, the one who denies the Father and the Son.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>Everyone who denies the Son does not have the Father either. The one who acknowledges the Son also has the Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>You--what you heard from the beginning must stay in you. If what you heard from the beginning stays in you, you also will stay in the Son and in the Father.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:25"></A><SPAN class="verseno">25 </SPAN>And the promise that He promised us is this, life that spans all time.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:26"></A><SPAN class="verseno">26 </SPAN>I wrote these things to you about the people misleading you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:27"></A><SPAN class="verseno">27 </SPAN>And you--the anointing that you received out from Him stays in you. You don't need someone to teach you. No, since His anointing teaches you about all things, since He is valid, since He is not a lie, you must stay in Him, just as He taught you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:28"></A><SPAN class="verseno">28 </SPAN>And now, little children, stay in Him so that if He is shown, we might have a clear public statement and not be shamed away from Him during His arrival.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 2:29"></A><SPAN class="verseno">29 </SPAN>If you have seen that He does what is right, you know that everyone who is also doing things the right way has been born from Him.</P>
<TITLE>First John 3</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Look at what kind of love the Father has given to us, that we might be called God's children (and we are). Because of this, the world does not know us, because it did not know Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Loved ones, now we are God's children, and it has not yet been shown what we will be. We realize that if it is shown, we will be like Him, that we will see Him just as He is.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And everyone who has this anticipation based on Him consecrates himself, just as that One is consecrated.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Everyone who is committing sin is also committing crime. Sin is crime.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>And you realize that that One was shown so that He might take away the sins, and sin is not in Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>Everyone who is staying in Him is not sinning. The one who is sinning has not seen Him or known Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Little children, no one must mislead you. The person who is doing things the right way is doing what is right, just as that One does what is right.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The person who is committing sin is from the Accuser because the Accuser sins from the beginning. It was for this that the Son of God was shown, so that He might undo the Accuser's actions.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>Everyone who has been born from God is not committing sin because a seed of His stays in him. It is not able to be sinning because it has been born from God.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>God's children and the Accuser's children are shown in this--everyone who is not doing things the right way and who is not loving his brother is not from God.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>This is the announcement that you heard from the beginning, that we should love each other.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>Just don't be like Cain. He was from the evil one and slaughtered his brother. And thanks to what did he slaughter him? Because his actions were evil, and his brother's actions were right.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>And don't be amazed, brothers, if the world hates you.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>We realize that we have stepped from death into life because we love the brothers. The person who is not loving stays in death.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Everyone who is hating his brother is a people-killer, and you realize that every people-killer does not have life that spans all time staying in him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>We have known love in this: because that One gave His soul for us. We are also obligated to give our souls for the brothers.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Whoever has the world's livelihood, watches his brother have a need, and closes off his feelings of sympathy from him, how is the love of God staying in him?</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>Little children, we should not love with a word, and not with the tongue either. No, <I>we should love</I> in action and truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>And we will know that we are from the truth and we will persuade our heart in front of Him in this:</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>because if our heart knows something against us, God is greater than our heart and knows all things.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Loved ones, if our heart doesn't know anything against us, we have a clear public statement facing God.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>And whatever we request, we receive out from Him because we keep His demands and do the things that are liked in His sight.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:23"></A><SPAN class="verseno">23 </SPAN>And this is His demand, that we should trust in the name of His Son Jesus, the Anointed King, and love each other, just as He gave us a demand.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 3:24"></A><SPAN class="verseno">24 </SPAN>And the one who is keeping His demands stays in Him and He in him. And it is in this that we know He stays in us, from the Spirit that He gave us.</P>
<TITLE>First John 4</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Loved ones, don't trust every spirit, but check the spirits as to whether a spirit is from God or not, because many counterfeit preachers have gone out into the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>It is in this that you know God's spirit--every spirit that acknowledges Jesus as the Anointed King who has come in a physical body is from God.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>And every spirit that doesn't acknowledge Jesus is not from God. This <I>refusal to acknowledge Jesus as the Anointed King</I> actually is the spirit of the opponent of the Anointed King that you have heard is coming and now is already in the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>You are from God, little children, and you have conquered them because the One in you is greater than the one in the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>They are from the world. Because of this, they speak from the world, and the world listens to them.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>We are from God. The one who knows God listens to us. The one who isn't from God doesn't listen to us. It is from this that we know the Spirit of Truth and the spirit of the misleading lie.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>Loved ones, let's love each other because love is from God and everyone who loves has been born from God and knows God.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The one who is not loving did not know God because God is love.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>It was in this that God's love was shown among us because God has sent His only biological Son out on a mission into the world so that we might live through Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN><I>The whole reason why</I> love is in this <I>is</I> not because we have loved God. No, <I>it is</I> because He loved us and sent His Son out as a remedy covering our sins.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Loved ones, if this is how God loved us, we also are obligated to be loving each other.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>No one has viewed God at any time. If we love each other, God stays in us, and His love has been completed in us.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>In this, we know that we stay in Him and He in us because He has given from His Spirit to us.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>And we have viewed and are telling what we witnessed--that the Father has sent the Son out on a mission to be a rescuer of the world.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Whoever acknowledges that Jesus is the Son of God, God stays in him and he in God.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>And we have known and have trusted the love that God has in us. God is love, and the one staying in love stays in God and God stays in him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Love has been completed with us in this so that we may have a clear public statement during the day of judgment because just as that One is, <I>so</I> also are we in this world.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>There is no fear in love. No, complete love throws the fear out because the fear has confinement. The person fearing has not been completed in love.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>We love because He first loved us.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>If anyone says, "I love God," and hates his brother, he is a liar. You see, the person who isn't loving his brother (that he has seen) is not able to be loving God (that he has not seen).</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 4:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>And we have this demand out from Him, that the person who is loving God should also love his brother.</P>
<TITLE>First John 5</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>Everyone who trusts that Jesus is the Anointed King has been born from God, and everyone who is loving the One who gave birth should also love the one that has been born from Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>We know that we love God's children in this--when we love God and do His demands.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>You see, this is God's love: that we should keep His demands. And His demands are not heavy</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>because everything that has been born from God conquers the world and this is the conquering element that conquered the world--our trust.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Who is the one conquering the world if it isn't the one who is trusting that Jesus is the Son of God?</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>This is the One who went through water <I>(submersion)</I> and blood <I>(martyrdom)</I>--Jesus, the Anointed King. He was not in the water only, but in the water and in the blood. And the Spirit tells what He witnessed because the Spirit is truth.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>There are the three that are telling what they witness:</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>the Spirit, the water <I>(it witnessed God speak from heaven at Jesus' submersion)</I>, and the blood <I>(at the cross, it witnessed God make it dark for three hours, cause an earthquake, raise the dead, and more)</I>. And the three are for the one thing<I>--to be a witness</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>If we receive people's witness account, God's witness account is greater because this is God's witness account that He has witnessed about His Son.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>The person who is trusting in the Son of God has the witness account in himself. The person who is not trusting God has made Him a liar because he has not trusted in the witness account that God has witnessed about His Son.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>And this is the witness account: that God gave us life that spans all time and this life is in His Son.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>The one who has the Son has the life. The one who doesn't have the Son of God doesn't have the life.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>I wrote these things to you who are trusting in the name of the Son of God <I>and in who He is</I> so that you may realize that you have life that spans all time.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>And this is the clear public statement that we have facing Him that if we request anything aligned with what He wants, He listens to us.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>And if we realize that He listens to us, whatever we request, we realize that we have the requests that we requested from Him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>If anyone has seen his brother sinning a sin not pointed toward death, he will request, and He will give life to him. This is for the people who are sinning a sin not pointed toward death. There is sin pointed toward death. I don't say that he should ask about that sin.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>Everything that is wrong is sin, and there is sin not pointed toward death.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>We realize that everyone who has been born from God is not sinning, but the One who was born from God keeps him, and the evil one does not touch him.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>We realize that we are from God and the whole world lies in the evil.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>We realize that the Son of God has arrived, He has given us a mind so that we may know the True One, and we are in the True One, in His Son Jesus, the Anointed King. This is the true God and life that spans all time.</P>
<P><A NAME="First John 5:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>Little children, guard yourselves away from the idols.</P>
<TITLE>Second John 1</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Second John 1:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>From: The older man. To: The select Kuria and her children. I, and not only I, but also all the people who have known the truth, love them in truth</P>
<P><A NAME="Second John 1:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>because of the truth staying in us. It will be with us for the span of time.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second John 1:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Generosity, forgiving kindness, and peace directly from Father God and directly from Jesus, the Anointed King, the Son of the Father, will be with us in truth and love.</P>
<P><A NAME="Second John 1:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>I was very happy to have found some of your children walking around in truth, just as we received a demand directly from the Father.</P>
