<P><A NAME="Revelation 3:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>because you say, 'I am wealthy, I have been wealthy, and I don't need anything.' But you have not seen that you are troubled, miserable, poor, blind, and naked.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 3:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>I strongly advise you to buy gold directly from Me that has been refined from fire (so that you might be wealthy), white robes (so that you might throw them around yourself and the shame of your nakedness might not be shown), and collyrium <I>(medicated eye wash)</I> to anoint in your eyes (so that you might see).</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 3:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>However many people that I am fond of, I reprimand and discipline. So be passionate and change your ways.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 3:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>Look, I have been standing at the door, and I am knocking. If anyone listens to My voice and opens the door, I will come in to him, eat dinner with him, and he with Me.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 3:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>The person who conquers, I will give him the right to be seated with Me in My throne, as I also conquered and was seated with My Father in His throne.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 3:22"></A><SPAN class="verseno">22 </SPAN>The person who has an ear must listen to what the Spirit says to the assemblies.'"</P>
<TITLE>Revelation 4</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>After these things I looked, and look, there was a door that had been opened in the sky. The first voice that I heard speaking with me that sounded like it was from a trumpet said, "Step up here, and I will show you what must happen after these things."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>Right away I entered a spiritual state, and look, a throne was situated in heaven and One was sitting on the throne.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>The One sitting was like the sight of a jasper stone <I>(speckled red)</I> and a sardius <I>(vibrant reddish-orange)</I>. A halo that surrounded the throne was like the sight of an emerald stone <I>(vibrant green)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>Twenty-four thrones were surrounding the throne, and twenty-four older men were sitting on the thrones. White robes had been thrown around <I>them</I>, and gold award wreaths were on their heads.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>Lightnings, sounds, and thunders travel out from the throne. Seven torches of fire burn in the sight of the throne. They are God's seven spirits.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>In the sight of the throne, there is something like a glassy sea that is like crystal. In the middle of the throne and circling the throne are four animals packed full of eyes, in front and behind.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>The first animal is like a lion. The second animal is like a calf. The third animal has the face as a human. And the fourth animal is like a flying raptor.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The four animals, each one of them, have six wings apiece. The wings are packed full of eyes surrounding them and on the inside. They don't have relief day and night from saying, "Sacred, sacred, sacred Master God, the All-Powerful One, the One who was, the One who is, and the One who is coming."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>When the animals will give magnificence, value, and thanks to the One who sits on the throne who lives for the spans of time of the spans of time,</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>the twenty-four older men will get down in the sight of the One who sits on the throne, bow to the One who lives for the spans of time of the spans of time, and throw their award wreaths in the sight of the throne. They will say,</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 4:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>"You, our Master and God, deserve to receive the magnificence, the value, and the ability because You created all things. They were existing and were created because that is what You wanted."</P>
<TITLE>Revelation 5</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>I saw a scroll on the right side of the One sitting on the throne. It had been written on the inside and on the back and had been sealed shut with seven seals.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>I saw a strong angel speaking publicly in a loud voice, "Who deserves to open the scroll and break its seals?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>No one in heaven, on the earth, or beneath the earth was able to open the scroll or look at it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>I was crying a lot because not even one deserving person was found to open the scroll or look at it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>One <I>older man</I> from the older men says to me, "Don't cry. Look, the Lion from the family line of Judah, the Root of David, conquered to open the scroll and its seven seals."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>And I saw in the middle of the throne and the four animals and in the middle of the older men, a lamb that had stood up. He was as a lamb that had been slaughtered. He had seven horns and seven eyes that are God's seven spirits that have been sent out on a mission into all the earth.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>He went and has taken the scroll from the right side of the One sitting on the throne.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>When He took the scroll, the four animals and the twenty-four older men got down in the sight of the Lamb. Each had a harp and gold bowls packed full of incense that are the prayers of the sacred people.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>They sing a new song. They say, "You deserve to take the scroll and to open its seals because You were slaughtered and You purchased people for God in Your blood from every family line, language, ethnic group, and nation.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>You made them a monarchy and priests to our God. They will be kings on the earth."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>I looked and heard the voice of many angels circling the throne, circling the animals, and circling the older men. Their number was tens of thousands of tens of thousands and thousands of thousands.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>They said with a loud voice, "The Lamb that has been slaughtered deserves to receive the ability, wealth, insight, strength, value, magnificence, and conferring of blessings."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>I heard every created thing that is in heaven, on the earth, beneath the earth, on the sea, and all the things in them saying, "To the One sitting on the throne and to the Lamb <I>belong</I> the conferring of blessings, the value, the magnificence, and the power for the spans of time of the spans of time."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 5:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>The four animals were saying, "Amen." And the older men got down and bowed.</P>
<TITLE>Revelation 6</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>I looked when the Lamb opened one <I>seal</I> from the seven seals. And I heard one <I>animal</I> from the four animals say as a voice of thunder, "Come."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And I looked, and, look, a white horse and the one sitting on it had a bow. An award wreath was given to him. He went out conquering and so that he might conquer.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>When He opened the second seal, I heard the second animal say, "Come."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>And another horse went out, a fiery horse. The one sitting on it was given the ability to take peace from the earth, even so that they will slaughter each other. And a large dagger was given to him.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>When He opened the third seal, I heard the third animal say, "Come." And I looked, and, look, a black horse and the one sitting on it had a beam balance in his hand.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>I heard what seemed like a voice in the middle of the four animals saying, "A quart of wheat for a denarius <I>(a coin equal to one day's wage)</I>, three quarts of barley for a denarius, and you should not harm the olive oil and the wine."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>When He opened the fourth seal, I heard the voice of the fourth animal say, "Come."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>And I looked, and, look, a green horse and the one sitting up on top of it. A name for him is Death. And Hades <I>(the underworld of the dead)</I> was following with him. Authority was given to them over the fourth part of the earth to kill with a sword, with famine, with death <I>(a plague)</I>, and by the wild animals of the earth.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>When He opened the fifth seal, I saw souls beneath the altar. These were the souls of the people who had been slaughtered because of God's message and because of the witness account that they were having.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>They yelled with a loud voice, saying, "Sacred and true Owner, how long are you not judging and retaliating against the people living on the earth for our blood?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>Each one of them was given a long white robe, and it was stated to them that they will relax for a short time yet until both their fellow slaves and their brothers (the ones that are going to be killed as they also had been) would be filled up.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>I looked when He opened the sixth seal. A large earthquake happened. The sun became black as sackcloth made of goat hair. The whole moon became as blood.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>The stars of the sky fell to the earth as a fig tree throws its unripe figs when it is shook by a strong wind.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>The sky was separated apart as a scroll being folded up. And every mountain and island was moved from their places.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>The kings of the earth, the greatest people, the commanding officers, the wealthy, the strong, and every slave and free person hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>They say to the mountains and the rocks, "Fall on us, and hide us away from the face of the One sitting on the throne and away from the punishment of the Lamb</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 6:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>because the great day of Their punishment came and who is able to stand?"</P>
<TITLE>Revelation 7</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>After this, I saw four angels that had stood on the four corners of the earth holding on to the four <I>directional</I> winds of the earth so that wind wouldn't blow on the earth, on the sea, or on any tree.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And I saw another angel stepping up out of the rising of the sun having a seal of the living God. He yelled with a loud voice to the four angels that were given <I>the ability</I> to harm the earth and the sea.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>He said, "You shouldn't harm the earth, the sea, or the trees till we will put a seal on the slaves of our God on their foreheads."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>And I heard the number of the ones that had been sealed. <I>There were</I> 144,000 that had been sealed from every family line of Israel's sons.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>From Judah's family line, 12,000 had been sealed. From Reuben's family line, 12,000; from Gad's family line, 12,000;</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>from Asher's family line, 12,000; from Naphtali's family line, 12,000; from Manasseh's family line, 12,000;</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>from Simeon's family line, 12,000; from Levi's family line, 12,000; from Issachar's family line, 12,000;</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>from Zebulon's family line, 12,000; from Joseph's family line, 12,000; from Benjamin's family line, 12,000 had been sealed.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>After these things, I looked, and, look, there was a big crowd that no one was able to number. People from every nation, from family lines, ethnic groups, and languages had stood in the sight of the throne and in the sight of the Lamb. Long white robes had been thrown around them, and palm branches are in their hands.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>And they are yelling with a loud voice, saying, "The rescue <I>belongs</I> to our God who sits on the throne and to the Lamb."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>All the angels had stood circling the throne, circling the older men, and circling the four animals. They got down on their faces in the sight of the throne and bowed to God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>They were saying, "Amen. The conferring of blessing, the magnificence, the insight, the thanks, the value, the ability, and the strength <I>belong</I> to our God for the spans of time of the spans of time. Amen."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>One <I>older man</I> from the older men responded and said to me, "Who are these people that the long white robes have been thrown around? And where did they come from?"</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>I have stated to him, "My master, you know." He said to me, "These are the people who come from the Great Hard Times. They rinsed their long robes and whitened them in the blood of the Lamb.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>Because of this, they are in the sight of God's throne, and they minister to Him day and night in His temple. The One sitting on the throne will camp over them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>They won't be hungry or thirsty anymore, and the sun or any burning heat won't fall on them either</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 7:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>because the Lamb that is up in the middle of the throne will shepherd them and guide them onto springs of waters of life. And God will dab off every tear from their eyes."</P>
<TITLE>Revelation 8</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>When He opened the seventh seal, there became a hush in heaven as if it were half an hour.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>And I saw the seven angels that had stood in the sight of God. Seven trumpets were given to them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Another angel went and was stood on the altar. He had a gold incense burner. And much incense was given to him so that he will give it on the gold altar with the prayers of all the sacred people in the sight of the throne.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>The smoke of the incense stepped up from the angel's hand with the prayers of the sacred people in the sight of God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>The angel has taken the incense burner. He filled it full of coals from the altar's fire and threw it to the earth. There became thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>The seven angels that had the seven trumpets got themselves ready to blow their trumpets.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>The first one blew his trumpet, and there became hail and fire that had been mixed in blood. It was thrown to the earth. The third <I>part</I> of the earth was burned up. The third <I>part</I> of the trees were burned up. And all green grass was burned up.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The second angel blew his trumpet, and something like a large mountain burning with fire was thrown into the sea. The third <I>part</I> of the sea became blood.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>The third <I>part</I> of the created things in the sea that had souls died. And the third <I>part</I> of the boats were devoured.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>The third angel blew his trumpet, and a large star fell from the sky that burned as a torch. It fell on the third <I>part</I> of the rivers and on the springs of the waters.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>The name of the star is called "The Absinthium." The third <I>part</I> of the waters turned into absinthium <I>(a very bitter herb)</I>. And many of the people died from the waters because they were bitter.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>The fourth angel blew his trumpet, and the third <I>part</I> of the sun, the third <I>part</I> of the moon, and the third <I>part</I> of the stars was affected so that the third <I>part</I> of them would be made dark. And the day would not shine for the third <I>part</I> of it, and the night likewise.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 8:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>I looked and heard one raptor flying in the middle of the sky. He said with a loud voice, "What a tragedy! What a tragedy! What a tragedy it will be for the people living on the earth because of the rest of the soundings of the three angels' trumpet that are going to be blowing."</P>
<TITLE>Revelation 9</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>The fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from the sky to the earth. The key of the shaft of the bottomless area was given to it.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>It opened the shaft of the bottomless area, and smoke stepped up from the shaft as the smoke of a large furnace. The sun and the air were darkened from the smoke of the shaft.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>Grasshoppers came out of the smoke to the earth, and they were given <I>the kind of</I> authority that scorpions have.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>It was stated to them that they won't harm the grass of the earth, or any green thing, or any tree. <I>They would</I> just <I>harm</I> the people, any people who don't have God's seal on their foreheads.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>They weren't given <I>the ability</I> to kill them. No, <I>they were given the ability</I> to torture them five months. The torture from them was as torture from a scorpion when it strikes a person.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>In those days, the people will look for death and won't in any way find it. They will desire to die, and death escapes away from them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>The grasshoppers' likenesses were like horses that have been readied for war. On their heads were <I>things</I> as award wreaths, like gold. Their faces were as people's faces.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>They had hair as women's hair. Their teeth were as lions'.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>They had vests as iron vests. The sound of their wings was as the sound of chariots of many horses running to war.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>They have tails like scorpions and stingers. And their authority to harm the people five months is in their tails.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>They have a king over them, the angel of the bottomless area. A name for him in Hebrew is Abaddon <I>(Ruin)</I>, and he has a name in the Greek <I>language</I>, Apollyon <I>(Ruiner)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:12"></A><SPAN class="verseno">12 </SPAN>The one tragedy went away. Look, two tragedies are still coming after these.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:13"></A><SPAN class="verseno">13 </SPAN>The sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard one voice from the four horns of the gold altar in the sight of God.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:14"></A><SPAN class="verseno">14 </SPAN>It said to the sixth angel that had the trumpet, "Release the four angels that have been locked up on the great Euphrates river."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:15"></A><SPAN class="verseno">15 </SPAN>The four angels were released that have been readied for the hour, day, month, and year so that they may kill the third <I>part</I> of the people.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:16"></A><SPAN class="verseno">16 </SPAN>The number of the military forces of the horse unit was <I>two hundred million</I> (twenty thousands of ten thousands). I heard the number of them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:17"></A><SPAN class="verseno">17 </SPAN>This is how I saw the horses in the sighting and the ones sitting on them. They have vests that are flaming, like a hyacinth <I>(a Greek god or a deep blue flower or mineral)</I>, and sulfurous <I>(a yellow combustible nonmetal element)</I>. The heads of the horses were as lions' heads. Fire, smoke, and sulfur travel out from their mouths.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:18"></A><SPAN class="verseno">18 </SPAN>The third <I>part</I> of the people were killed out of these three devastations: from the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur that traveled out from their mouths.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:19"></A><SPAN class="verseno">19 </SPAN>You see, the authority of the horses is in their mouth and in their tails. Their tails had heads like snakes, and they cause harm with them.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>The rest of the people who were not killed in these devastations did not even change their ways from the works of their hands so that they won't bow down to the lesser deities and the gold, silver, brass, stone, and wooden idols that are not able to see, hear, or walk around.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 9:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>And they did not change their ways from their murders, or from their drug use, or from their sexual sin, or from their thefts.</P>
<TITLE>Revelation 10</TITLE>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:1"></A><SPAN class="verseno">1 </SPAN>I saw another strong angel stepping down from the sky. A cloud has been thrown around him. The halo was on his head. His face was as the sun. His feet were as pillars of fire.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:2"></A><SPAN class="verseno">2 </SPAN>He had a little scroll in his hand that had been opened. He put his right foot on the sea, but the left on the land.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:3"></A><SPAN class="verseno">3 </SPAN>He yelled with a loud voice even as a lion roars. When he yelled, the seven thunders spoke their own voices.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:4"></A><SPAN class="verseno">4 </SPAN>When the seven thunders spoke, I was going to write. And I heard a voice from the sky say, "Put a seal on what the seven thunders spoke, and you will not write them."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:5"></A><SPAN class="verseno">5 </SPAN>The angel that I saw that had stood on the sea and on the land raised up his right hand to the sky.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:6"></A><SPAN class="verseno">6 </SPAN>He guaranteed with the One who lives for the spans of time of the spans of time (<I>the One</I> who created the sky and the things in it, the land and the things in it, and the sea and the things in it) that there will be no more time <I>left</I> <I>(no more delay)</I>.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:7"></A><SPAN class="verseno">7 </SPAN>But in the days of the sounding of the seventh angel, whenever he is going to be blowing the trumpet, God's secret was also finished. <I>It was</I> as the good news that He shared with His own slaves, the preachers.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:8"></A><SPAN class="verseno">8 </SPAN>The voice that I heard from the sky is speaking with me again and saying, "Make your way back, take the scroll that has been opened in the hand of the angel that has stood on the sea and on the land."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:9"></A><SPAN class="verseno">9 </SPAN>I went off to the angel and told him to give me the little scroll. He says to me, "Take, and eat it up. It will make your belly bitter, but in your mouth, it will be sweet as honey."</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:10"></A><SPAN class="verseno">10 </SPAN>I took the little scroll from the hand of the angel and ate it up. It was sweet as honey in my mouth. And when I ate it, my belly became bitter.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 10:11"></A><SPAN class="verseno">11 </SPAN>They say to me, "It is necessary for you to preach again on many ethnic groups, nations, languages, and kings."</P>

<P><A NAME="Revelation 22:20"></A><SPAN class="verseno">20 </SPAN>The One who is a witness to these things says, "Yes, I am coming quickly." Amen. Come, Master Jesus.</P>
<P><A NAME="Revelation 22:21"></A><SPAN class="verseno">21 </SPAN>May the generosity of the Master Jesus be with everyone.</P>
